135/// @brief Interpreta un número aceptando coma o punto decimal.
136double parseNumberText(const QString& text, bool* ok = nullptr) {
137 QString normalized = text.trimmed();
138 normalized.remove(' ');
139 normalized.replace(',', '.');
140 bool valid = false;
141 const double value = normalized.toDouble(&valid);
142 if (ok) *ok = valid;
143 return valid ? value : 0.0;
144}

151/// @brief Dibuja el recorrido de la herramienta, incluyendo viajes entre tramos.
152void setPathToolpaths(Canvas* canvas, const std::vector<std::vector<fc::Pt>>& paths) {
153 if (!canvas) return;
154 std::vector<Geom> moves;
155 fc::Pt last{0.0, 0.0};
156 bool hasLast = false;
157 for (const auto& path : paths) {
158 if (path.size() < 2) continue;
159 if (hasLast) moves.push_back(Geom::line({last, path.front()}));
160 moves.push_back(Geom::line(path));
161 last = path.back();
162 hasLast = true;
163 }
164 canvas->setToolpaths(moves);
165}

167/// @brief Devuelve la fracción de perímetro más cercana a un punto.
168double nearestFractionOnOutline(const Geom& outline, const Pt& point) {
169 Ring ring;
170 if (outline.typeId() == GEOS_POLYGON) {
171 const auto polygons = outline.polygons();
172 if (!polygons.empty()) ring = polygons.front().outer;
173 } else if (outline.typeId() == GEOS_MULTIPOLYGON ||
174 outline.typeId() == GEOS_GEOMETRYCOLLECTION) {
175 double best = -1.0;
176 for (int i = 0; i < outline.numGeometries(); ++i) {
177 const Geom part = outline.geometryN(i);
178 Ring candidate;
179 if (part.typeId() == GEOS_POLYGON) {
180 const auto polygons = part.polygons();
181 if (!polygons.empty()) candidate = polygons.front().outer;
182 }
183 if (candidate.size() > 1 && candidate.size() > ring.size()) ring = candidate;
184 (void)best;
185 }
186 }
187 if (ring.empty()) ring = outline.coords();
188 if (ring.size() < 2) return 0.0;
189
190 double total = 0.0;
191 double bestCumulative = 0.0;
192 double bestDistance = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();
193 double cumulative = 0.0;
194 const auto project = [&](const Pt& a, const Pt& b) {
195 const double dx = b.x - a.x;
196 const double dy = b.y - a.y;
197 const double len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
198 const double len = std::sqrt(len2);
199 double t = len2 > 0.0
200 ? ((point.x - a.x) * dx + (point.y - a.y) * dy) / len2
201 : 0.0;
202 t = std::clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0);
203 const double px = a.x + dx * t;
204 const double py = a.y + dy * t;
205 const double d = std::hypot(point.x - px, point.y - py);
206 if (d < bestDistance) {
207 bestDistance = d;
208 bestCumulative = cumulative + len * t;
209 }
210 cumulative += len;
211 total += len;
212 };
213 for (std::size_t i = 1; i < ring.size(); ++i) project(ring[i - 1], ring[i]);
214 if (ring.front().x != ring.back().x || ring.front().y != ring.back().y)
215 project(ring.back(), ring.front());
216 return total > 0.0 ? bestCumulative / total : 0.0;
217}

219/// @brief Dibuja el recorrido del taladrado en el orden de ejecución.
220void setDrillToolpaths(Canvas* canvas, const fc::DrillJob& job) {
221 if (!canvas) return;
222 std::vector<Geom> moves;
223 fc::Pt last{0.0, 0.0};
224 bool hasLast = false;
225 auto travelTo = [&](const fc::Pt& p) {
226 if (hasLast) moves.push_back(Geom::line({last, p}));
227 last = p;
228 hasLast = true;
229 };
230 for (const fc::DrillTool& tool : job.tools) {
231 const fc::Pt offset{tool.offsetX, tool.offsetY};
232 for (const fc::Pt& hole : tool.holes) {
233 travelTo({hole.x + offset.x, hole.y + offset.y});
234 }
235 for (const auto& [start, stop] : tool.slotSegments) {
236 const fc::Pt a{start.x + offset.x, start.y + offset.y};
237 const fc::Pt b{stop.x + offset.x, stop.y + offset.y};
238 travelTo(a);
239 moves.push_back(Geom::line({a, b}));
240 last = b;
241 }
242 }
243 canvas->setToolpaths(moves);
244}

262/// @brief Vista previa de un tema de visor.
263class ViewThemePreview : public QWidget {
264public:
265 explicit ViewThemePreview(QWidget* parent = nullptr) : QWidget(parent) {
266 setMinimumSize(300, 150);
267 }
268 void setTheme(const ViewTheme& theme) {
269 theme_ = theme;
270 update();
271 }
272
273protected:
274 void paintEvent(QPaintEvent*) override {
275 QPainter p(this);
276 p.fillRect(rect(), theme_.background);
277 p.setPen(QPen(theme_.grid, 1));
278 for (int x = 0; x < width(); x += 24) p.drawLine(x, 0, x, height());
279 for (int y = 0; y < height(); y += 24) p.drawLine(0, y, width(), y);
280 p.setPen(QPen(theme_.copper, 2));
281 p.setBrush(QColor(theme_.copper.red(), theme_.copper.green(), theme_.copper.blue(), 90));
282 p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(24, 28, width() - 48, height() - 56), 8, 8);
283 p.setPen(QPen(theme_.follow, 2));
284 p.drawLine(36, height() / 2, width() - 36, height() / 2);
285 p.setPen(QPen(theme_.toolpath, 2, Qt::DashLine));
286 p.drawLine(36, height() - 30, width() - 36, 30);
287 p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
288 p.setPen(QPen(QColor(128, 128, 128), 1));
289 p.drawRect(rect().adjusted(0, 0, -1, -1));
290 }
291
292private:
293 ViewTheme theme_;
294};

301int tclCmdExtractDrills(ClientData cd, Tcl_Interp* ip, int objc, Tcl_Obj* const objv[]) {
302 auto* w = static_cast<MainWindow*>(cd);
303 if (objc < 2 || objc > 2) {
304 Tcl_WrongNumArgs(ip, 1, objv, "maxDiameter");
305 return TCL_ERROR;
306 }
307 double maxDia = 3.0;
308 Tcl_GetDoubleFromObj(ip, objv[1], &maxDia);
309 Tcl_SetObjResult(ip, Tcl_NewIntObj(w->tclExtractDrills(maxDia)));
310 return TCL_OK;
311}

627/// @brief Convierte una lista de objetos Tcl en doubles a partir de `from`.
628static std::vector<double> tclDoubles(Tcl_Interp* ip, int objc, Tcl_Obj* const objv[], int from) {
629 std::vector<double> values;
630 for (int i = from; i < objc; ++i) {
631 double value = 0;
632 Tcl_GetDoubleFromObj(ip, objv[i], &value);
633 values.push_back(value);
634 }
635 return values;
636}

1008/**
1009 * @brief Asigna un tooltip al widget y a su etiqueta de formulario.
1010 * @param widget Control.
1011 * @param text Texto HTML del globo.
1012 */
1013void applyTip(QWidget* widget, const QString& text) {
1014 if (!widget) return;
1015 widget->setToolTip(text);
1016 if (auto* page = widget->parentWidget()) {
1017 if (auto* form = qobject_cast<QFormLayout*>(page->layout())) {
1018 if (QWidget* label = form->labelForField(widget)) label->setToolTip(text);
1019 }
1020 }
1021}
1022
1023/**
1024 * @brief Dibuja el icono circular de deshacer/rehacer.
1025 * @param redo `true` para rehacer (flecha espejada).
1026 */
1027QIcon historyIcon(bool redo) {
1028 constexpr int size = 32;
1029 QPixmap pix(size, size);
1030 pix.fill(Qt::transparent);
1031 QPainter painter(&pix);
1032 painter.setRenderHint(QPainter::Antialiasing, true);
1033 const QColor color(60, 60, 60);
1034 const double center = size / 2.0;
1035 const double radius = 10.5;
1036 painter.setPen(QPen(color, 3.0, Qt::SolidLine, Qt::RoundCap));
1037 painter.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
1038 // Leave a wide gap on the right for the arrow head.
1039 painter.drawArc(QRectF(center - radius, center - radius, radius * 2, radius * 2),
1040 35 * 16, 290 * 16);
1041
1042 const double angle = 35.0 * M_PI / 180.0;
1043 const QPointF tip(center + radius * std::cos(angle), center - radius * std::sin(angle));
1044 const QPointF tangent(-std::sin(angle), -std::cos(angle));
1045 const QPointF normal(-tangent.y(), tangent.x());
1046 QPolygonF head;
1047 head << tip + tangent * 3.5
1048 << tip - tangent * 8.0 + normal * 6.0
1049 << tip - tangent * 8.0 - normal * 6.0;
1050 painter.setPen(Qt::NoPen);
1051 painter.setBrush(color);
1052 painter.drawPolygon(head);
1053 painter.end();
1054
1055 if (!redo) return QIcon(pix);
1056 return QIcon(pix.transformed(QTransform().scale(-1, 1)));
1057}

1142/// @brief Carga un icono original de FlatCAM desde el `.qrc`.
1143/// @brief Aclara los trazos oscuros de un icono para el tema oscuro.
1144QPixmap lightenIconForDark(const QPixmap& source) {
1145 QImage image = source.toImage().convertToFormat(QImage::Format_ARGB32);
1146 for (int y = 0; y < image.height(); ++y) {
1147 auto* line = reinterpret_cast<QRgb*>(image.scanLine(y));
1148 for (int x = 0; x < image.width(); ++x) {
1149 const QRgb pixel = line[x];
1150 const int alpha = qAlpha(pixel);
1151 if (alpha == 0) continue;
1152 const int r = qRed(pixel);
1153 const int g = qGreen(pixel);
1154 const int b = qBlue(pixel);
1155 const int high = std::max({r, g, b});
1156 const int low = std::min({r, g, b});
1157 if (high - low <= 42 && high < 165) {
1158 // Trazo neutro oscuro: se reemplaza por gris claro.
1159 line[x] = qRgba(231, 233, 236, alpha);
1160 } else if (high < 110) {
1161 // Color muy oscuro: se aclara conservando el tono.
1162 const QColor lifted = QColor::fromRgb(pixel).lighter(190);
1163 line[x] = qRgba(lifted.red(), lifted.green(), lifted.blue(), alpha);
1164 }
1165 }
1166 }
1167 return QPixmap::fromImage(image);
1168}
1169
1170/// @brief Icono que adapta sus trazos al tema activo en tiempo de dibujo.
1171class ThemedIconEngine : public QIconEngine {
1172public:
1173 explicit ThemedIconEngine(QString name) : name_(std::move(name)) {}
1174
1175 QIconEngine* clone() const override { return new ThemedIconEngine(*this); }
1176
1177 QString key() const override {
1178 return QStringLiteral("fc-icon:%1:%2").arg(name_, fc::theme::isDark() ? "d" : "l");
1179 }
1180
1181 QPixmap pixmap(const QSize& size, QIcon::Mode mode, QIcon::State) override {
1182 QPixmap pixmap(":/icons/" + name_ + ".png");
1183 if (pixmap.isNull()) return pixmap;
1184 if (fc::theme::isDark()) pixmap = lightenIconForDark(pixmap);
1185 if (mode == QIcon::Disabled) {
1186 QImage image = pixmap.toImage().convertToFormat(QImage::Format_ARGB32);
1187 for (int y = 0; y < image.height(); ++y) {
1188 auto* line = reinterpret_cast<QRgb*>(image.scanLine(y));
1189 for (int x = 0; x < image.width(); ++x) {
1190 const QRgb pixel = line[x];
1191 line[x] = qRgba(qRed(pixel), qGreen(pixel), qBlue(pixel),
1192 qAlpha(pixel) * 45 / 100);
1193 }
1194 }
1195 pixmap = QPixmap::fromImage(image);
1196 }
1197 if (size.isValid() && !size.isEmpty() &&
1198 (pixmap.width() > size.width() || pixmap.height() > size.height())) {
1199 pixmap = pixmap.scaled(size, Qt::KeepAspectRatio, Qt::SmoothTransformation);
1200 }
1201 return pixmap;
1202 }
1203
1204 void paint(QPainter* painter, const QRect& rect, QIcon::Mode mode,
1205 QIcon::State state) override {
1206 painter->drawPixmap(rect, pixmap(rect.size(), mode, state));
1207 }
1208
1209private:
1210 QString name_;
1211};
1212
1213QIcon originalIcon(const QString& name) {
1214 return QIcon(new ThemedIconEngine(name));
1215}

1259/// @brief Genera el icono verde/gris de la columna Vis.
1260QIcon visibilityIcon(bool visible) {
1261 static QIcon yes;
1262 static QIcon no;
1263 QIcon& icon = visible ? yes : no;
1264 if (!icon.isNull()) return icon;
1265 QPixmap pix(16, 16);
1266 pix.fill(Qt::transparent);
1267 QPainter painter(&pix);
1268 painter.setRenderHint(QPainter::Antialiasing, true);
1269 painter.setBrush(visible ? QColor(46, 204, 113) : QColor(170, 170, 170));
1270 painter.setPen(QPen(visible ? QColor(30, 132, 73) : QColor(110, 110, 110), 1));
1271 painter.drawEllipse(1, 1, 14, 14);
1272 painter.setPen(QPen(Qt::white, 2));
1273 if (visible) {
1274 painter.drawLine(4, 8, 7, 11);
1275 painter.drawLine(7, 11, 12, 5);
1276 } else {
1277 painter.drawLine(5, 5, 11, 11);
1278 painter.drawLine(11, 5, 5, 11);
1279 }
1280 painter.end();
1281 icon = QIcon(pix);
1282 return icon;
1283}

1285class TreeDropFilter : public QObject {
1286public:
1287 QTreeWidget* tree = nullptr;
1288 std::function<void()> onReorder;
1289
1290 bool eventFilter(QObject* object, QEvent* event) override {
1291 if (event->type() == QEvent::DragEnter || event->type() == QEvent::DragMove) {
1292 event->accept();
1293 return true;
1294 }
1295 if (event->type() != QEvent::Drop) return QObject::eventFilter(object, event);
1296 auto* dropEvent = static_cast<QDropEvent*>(event);
1297 QTreeWidgetItem* dragged = tree ? tree->currentItem() : nullptr;
1298 if (!tree || !dragged) {
1299 dropEvent->ignore();
1300 return true;
1301 }
1302 const QPoint pos = dropEvent->position().toPoint();
1303 QTreeWidgetItem* target = tree->itemAt(pos);
1304 int from = tree->indexOfTopLevelItem(dragged);
1305 if (from < 0) {
1306 dropEvent->ignore();
1307 return true;
1308 }
1309 int to = target ? tree->indexOfTopLevelItem(target) : tree->topLevelItemCount() - 1;
1310 if (target) {
1311 const QRect rect = tree->visualItemRect(target);
1312 if (pos.y() > rect.center().y()) ++to;
1313 }
1314 if (to > from) --to;
1315 to = std::clamp(to, 0, tree->topLevelItemCount() - 1);
1316 if (to != from) {
1317 QTreeWidgetItem* item = tree->takeTopLevelItem(from);
1318 tree->insertTopLevelItem(to, item);
1319 tree->setCurrentItem(item);
1320 if (onReorder) onReorder();
1321 }
1322 dropEvent->acceptProposedAction();
1323 return true;
1324 }
1325};

1341/// @brief Heurística por extensión y cabecera para distinguir Excellon.
1342bool looksLikeExcellon(const QString& path) {
1343 const QString suffix = QFileInfo(path).suffix().toLower();
1344 if (suffix == "drl" || suffix == "xln" || suffix == "exc" || suffix == "ncd") return true;
1345
1346 QFile f(path);
1347 if (!f.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text)) return false;
1348 const QString head = QString::fromUtf8(f.read(4096));
1349 return head.contains("M48") || head.contains("METRIC,") || head.contains("INCH,") ||
1350 head.contains("T01C");
1351}

1353/// @brief Formatea un número sin ceros innecesarios.
1354QString formatDouble(double v) {
1355 std::ostringstream os;
1356 os.precision(6);
1357 os << v;
1358 return QString::fromStdString(os.str());
1359}

1566 };
1567 connect(objects_->model(), &QAbstractItemModel::rowsInserted, this,
1568 [this, syncLayerOrder](const QModelIndex&, int, int) {
1569 QTimer::singleShot(0, this, syncLayerOrder);
1570 });
1571 connect(objects_->model(), &QAbstractItemModel::rowsRemoved, this,
1572 [this, syncLayerOrder](const QModelIndex&, int, int) {
1573 QTimer::singleShot(0, this, syncLayerOrder);
1574 });
1575 objects_->setContextMenuPolicy(Qt::CustomContextMenu);
1576 connect(objects_, &QTreeWidget::customContextMenuRequested, this, [this](const QPoint& pos) {
1577 QTreeWidgetItem* item = objects_->itemAt(pos);
1578 if (!item) return;
1579 QMenu menu(this);
1580 QAction* duplicate = menu.addAction(tr("Duplicar objeto"));
1581 QAction* remove = menu.addAction(tr("Eliminar objeto"));
1582 QAction* chosen = menu.exec(objects_->mapToGlobal(pos));
1583 if (chosen == remove) {
1584 objects_->setCurrentItem(item);
1585 deleteSelectedObject();
1586 } else if (chosen == duplicate) {
1587 objects_->setCurrentItem(item);
1588 duplicateSelectedObject();
1589 }
1590 });
1591
1592 connect(properties_, &QTreeWidget::itemChanged, this, [this](QTreeWidgetItem* row, int column) {
1593 if (!row || column != 1) return;
1594 QTreeWidgetItem* item = objects_->currentItem();
1595 if (!item) return;
1596 const int layerId = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
1597 const auto props = objectProps_.find(layerId);
1598 if (props != objectProps_.end()) {
1599 const auto value = props->second.find(row->text(0));
1600 if (value != props->second.end()) {
1601 value->second = row->text(1);
1602 return;
1603 }
1604 }
1605 if (row->text(0) != tr("Nombre")) return;
1606 const QString oldName = item->text(1);
1607 const QString newName = row->text(1);
1608 if (oldName == newName) return;
1609 updatingTree_ = true;
1610 item->setText(1, newName);
1611 updatingTree_ = false;
1612 undoStack_->push(new LambdaCommand(
1613 [item, oldName] { item->setText(1, oldName); },
1614 [item, newName] { item->setText(1, newName); }, tr("Renombrar objeto")));
1615 });
1616
1617 connect(canvas_, &Canvas::layerPicked, this, [this](int layerId) {
1618 if (layerId <= 0) return;
1619 if (QTreeWidgetItem* item = findObjectItem(layerId)) {
1620 objects_->setCurrentItem(item);
1621 refreshProperties();
1622 }
1623 });
1624 connect(canvas_, &Canvas::layerActivated, this, [this](int layerId) {
1625 if (layerId <= 0) return;
1626 const BBox b = canvas_->layerBounds(layerId);
1627 if (b.valid) canvas_->fitTo(b);
1628 });
1629 connect(canvas_, &Canvas::cursorMoved, this, [this](double x, double y) {
1630 if (std::isnan(x) || std::isnan(y)) {
1631 coordsLabel_->setText(tr("X: — Y: —"));
1632 } else {
1633 coordsLabel_->setText(tr("X: %1 Y: %2")
1634 .arg(formatLength(x), formatLength(y)));
1635 }
1636 });
1637}

2394/// @brief Abre el diálogo para seleccionar un proyecto `.FlatPrj`.
2395void MainWindow::chooseProject() {

2402/// @brief Abre el diálogo de archivos y carga la selección.
2403void MainWindow::chooseFile() {
2404 const QStringList paths = QFileDialog::getOpenFileNames(
2405 this, tr("Abrir archivos"), lastDir_,
2406 tr("Archivos PCB (*.gbr *.ger *.gtl *.gbl *.gts *.gbs *.gko *.drl *.xln *.exc *.ncd "
2407 "*.svg *.dxf *.pdf *.hpgl *.hpg *.plt *.nc *.gcode);;Todos (*)"));
2408 if (!paths.isEmpty()) openFiles(paths);
2409}

2411/// @brief Abre un archivo individual detectando su tipo.
2412bool MainWindow::openPath(const QString& path) { return openFiles(QStringList{path}); }
2413
2414/// @brief Carga varios archivos como capas y actualiza el árbol.
2415bool MainWindow::openFiles(const QStringList& paths) {
2416 if (paths.isEmpty()) return false;
2417 lastDir_ = QFileInfo(paths.first()).absolutePath();
2418
2419 // A single .FlatPrj keeps its dedicated streaming loader.
2420 if (paths.size() == 1 && QFileInfo(paths.first()).suffix().compare("FlatPrj", Qt::CaseInsensitive) == 0)
2421 return openProject(paths.first());
2422
2423 lastExcellon_.reset();
2424 lastGerber_.reset();
2425 lastIsolation_.reset();
2426 lastCutout_.reset();
2427 lastNcc_.reset();
2428 lastPaint_.reset();
2429 lastDrillJob_.reset();
2430 gerberLayers_.clear();
2431 excellonLayers_.clear();
2432 projectPath_.clear();
2433 projectDirty_ = false;
2434 resetObjectGroups();
2435 canvas_->beginGeometry();
2436
2437 int loaded = 0;
2438 QStringList errors;
2439 for (const QString& path : paths) {
2440 if (QFileInfo(path).suffix().compare("FlatPrj", Qt::CaseInsensitive) == 0) {
2441 errors << tr("%1: abra los proyectos de a uno").arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName());
2442 continue;
2443 }
2444 try {
2445 const QString suffix = QFileInfo(path).suffix().toLower();
2446 const bool gcodeFile = suffix == "nc" || suffix == "gcode" || suffix == "tap" ||
2447 suffix == "ngc";
2448 const bool hpglFile = suffix == "hpgl" || suffix == "hpg" || suffix == "plt";
2449 bool ok = false;
2450 if (gcodeFile) ok = addGCodeLayer(path);
2451 else if (suffix == "pdf") ok = importPdfPath(path);
2452 else if (suffix == "svg" || suffix == "dxf")
2453 ok = importVectorPath(path, suffix == "svg");
2454 else if (hpglFile) {
2455 addVectorGeometry(QFileInfo(path).fileName(), importHpgl(path.toStdString()));
2456 ok = true;
2457 } else {
2458 ok = looksLikeExcellon(path) ? addExcellon(path) : addGerber(path);
2459 }
2460 if (ok) {
2461 ++loaded;
2462 recordRecent(path);
2463 }
2464 } catch (const std::exception& e) {
2465 errors << tr("%1: %2").arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName(), QString::fromUtf8(e.what()));
2466 }
2467 }
2468
2469 canvas_->endGeometry();
2470 canvas_->fitWithOrigin();
2471 canvas_->setToolpaths({});
2472 if (!objectItems().empty()) objects_->setCurrentItem(objectItems().front());
2473
2474 setWindowTitle(loaded == 1
2475 ? tr("FlatCAM C++ — %1").arg(QFileInfo(paths.first()).fileName())
2476 : tr("FlatCAM C++ — %1 archivos").arg(loaded));
2477 statusLabel_->setText(tr("%1 archivos · %2 objetos").arg(loaded).arg(objectItems().size()));
2478 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Cargados %1 archivos").arg(loaded), 5000);
2479
2480 if (!errors.isEmpty()) {
2481 info_->setPlainText(info_->toPlainText() + "\n--- ERRORES ---\n" + errors.join("\n"));
2482 QMessageBox::warning(this, tr("Algunos archivos no se cargaron"), errors.join("\n"));
2483 }
2484 return loaded > 0;
2485}
2486
2487/// @brief Carga un proyecto, sus objetos y sus opciones.
2488bool MainWindow::openProject(const QString& path) {
2489 try {
2490 projectPath_ = path;
2491 const ProjectInfo projectInfo = inspectProject(path.toStdString());
2492 if (!projectInfo.options.empty())
2493 loadToolTablesJson(QString::fromStdString(projectInfo.options));
2494 lastExcellon_.reset();
2495 lastGerber_.reset();
2496 lastIsolation_.reset();
2497 lastCutout_.reset();
2498 lastNcc_.reset();
2499 lastPaint_.reset();
2500 lastDrillJob_.reset();
2501 gerberLayers_.clear();
2502 excellonLayers_.clear();
2503 resetObjectGroups();
2504
2505 canvas_->beginGeometry();
2506 std::ostringstream os;
2507 os << "PROYECTO\n";
2508 os << "archivo : " << QFileInfo(path).fileName().toStdString() << "\n";
2509
2510 int index = 0;
2511 const auto summaries = fc::forEachProjectObject(
2512 path.toStdString(), [&](fc::ProjectObject&& obj) {
2513 const int layerId = canvas_->appendGeometry(obj.solids, obj.follows, false);
2514
2515 double area = 0.0;
2516 for (const fc::Geom& g : obj.solids) area += g.area();
2517
2518 addObjectRow(QString::fromStdString(obj.name), QString::fromStdString(obj.kind),
2519 QString::number(area, 'f', 2), layerId);
2520 if (!obj.text.empty()) objectText_[layerId] = QString::fromStdString(obj.text);
2521 if (!obj.properties.empty()) {
2522 const QJsonDocument doc = QJsonDocument::fromJson(
2523 QByteArray::fromStdString(obj.properties));
2524 if (doc.isObject()) {
2525 for (auto it = doc.object().begin(); it != doc.object().end(); ++it)
2526 objectProps_[layerId][it.key()] = it.value().toString();
2527 }
2528 }
2529 if (!obj.sourceFile.empty())
2530 sourcePaths_[layerId] = QString::fromStdString(obj.sourceFile);
2531
2532 if (obj.kind == "gerber" && !lastGerber_) {
2533 fc::GerberResult gerber;
2534 gerber.solids = obj.solids;
2535 gerber.follows = obj.follows;
2536 gerber.solid = fc::Geom::unionOf(obj.solids);
2537 gerber.bounds = gerber.solid.bounds();
2538 gerber.fileUnits = obj.units;
2539 lastGerber_ = gerber;
2540 }
2541
2542 ++index;
2543 QApplication::processEvents();
2544 return true;
2545 });
2546
2547 canvas_->endGeometry();
2548 canvas_->fitWithOrigin();
2549 canvas_->setToolpaths({});
2550 if (!objectItems().empty())
2551 objects_->setCurrentItem(objectItems().front());
2552
2553 os << "objetos : " << summaries.size() << "\n";
2554 for (const fc::ProjectObjectSummary& summary : summaries) {
2555 os << " [" << summary.kind << "] " << summary.name << " (" << fc::toString(summary.units)
2556 << ", área " << summary.area << ")\n";
2557 }
2558 setInfo(QString::fromStdString(os.str()));
2559
2560 setWindowTitle(tr("FlatCAM C++ — %1").arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName()));
2561 statusLabel_->setText(tr("%1 · %2 objetos").arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName()).arg(summaries.size()));
2562 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Proyecto cargado (objetos en streaming)"), 5000);
2563 recordRecent(path);
2564 projectDirty_ = false;
2565 return true;
2566 } catch (const std::exception& e) {
2567 showError(QString::fromUtf8(e.what()));
2568 return false;
2569 }
2570}

2572/// @brief Muestra la lista de objetos de un proyecto para abrir uno.
2573void MainWindow::chooseProjectObject() {
2574 QString path = projectPath_;
2575 if (path.isEmpty()) {
2576 path = QFileDialog::getOpenFileName(this, tr("Proyecto FlatCAM"), lastDir_,
2577 tr("Proyecto FlatCAM (*.FlatPrj);;Todos (*)"));
2578 if (path.isEmpty()) return;
2579 projectPath_ = path;
2580 }
2581
2582 try {
2583 const fc::ProjectInfo info = fc::inspectProject(path.toStdString());
2584 QStringList names;
2585 for (const fc::ProjectObjectInfo& obj : info.objects) {
2586 names << QString("[%1] %2").arg(QString::fromStdString(obj.kind),
2587 QString::fromStdString(obj.name));
2588 }
2589 if (names.isEmpty()) return;
2590
2591 bool ok = false;
2592 const QString chosen = QInputDialog::getItem(this, tr("Abrir objeto de proyecto"),
2593 tr("Objeto:"), names, 0, false, &ok);
2594 if (!ok) return;
2595 const int index = names.indexOf(chosen);
2596 if (index < 0) return;
2597
2598 const fc::ProjectObject obj =
2599 fc::loadProjectObject(path.toStdString(), static_cast<std::size_t>(index));
2600
2601 canvas_->setGeometryData(obj.solids, obj.follows);
2602 canvas_->setToolpaths({});
2603 lastIsolation_.reset();
2604 lastCutout_.reset();
2605 lastNcc_.reset();
2606 lastPaint_.reset();
2607
2608 std::ostringstream os;
2609 os << "OBJETO DE PROYECTO\n";
2610 os << "nombre : " << obj.name << "\n";
2611 os << "tipo : " << obj.kind << "\n";
2612 os << "sólidos: " << obj.solids.size() << " recorridos: " << obj.follows.size() << "\n";
2613
2614 if (obj.kind == "gerber") {
2615 fc::GerberResult gerber;
2616 gerber.solids = obj.solids;
2617 gerber.follows = obj.follows;
2618 gerber.solid = fc::Geom::unionOf(obj.solids);
2619 gerber.bounds = gerber.solid.bounds();
2620 gerber.fileUnits = obj.units;
2621 lastGerber_ = gerber;
2622 lastExcellon_.reset();
2623 os << "área : " << gerber.solid.area() << "\n";
2624 } else {
2625 lastGerber_.reset();
2626 lastExcellon_.reset();
2627 }
2628 setInfo(QString::fromStdString(os.str()));
2629 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Objeto cargado: %1").arg(QString::fromStdString(obj.name)), 5000);
2630 } catch (const std::exception& e) {
2631 showError(QString::fromUtf8(e.what()));
2632 }
2633}

2646/// @brief Reconstruye el panel de propiedades del objeto activo.
2647void MainWindow::refreshProperties() {
2648 if (!properties_) return;
2649 properties_->clear();
2650 QTreeWidgetItem* item = objects_->currentItem();
2651
2652 auto addRow = [this](const QString& key, const QString& value, bool editable = false) {
2653 auto* row = new QTreeWidgetItem(properties_);
2654 row->setText(0, key);
2655 row->setText(1, value);
2656 if (editable) row->setFlags(row->flags() | Qt::ItemIsEditable);
2657 };
2658
2659 if (!item) {
2660 addRow(tr("Estado"), tr("sin selección"));
2661 return;
2662 }
2663
2664 addRow(tr("Nombre"), item->text(1), true);
2665 addRow(tr("Tipo"), item->text(2));
2666 addRow(tr("Área"), item->text(3) + " mm²");
2667 addRow(tr("Visible"), item->data(0, Qt::UserRole + 1).toBool() ? tr("sí") : tr("no"));
2668
2669 const int layer = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
2670 const fc::BBox b = canvas_->layerBounds(layer);
2671 if (b.valid) {
2672 addRow(tr("X"), QString("%1 … %2").arg(formatLength(b.xmin, 3), formatLength(b.xmax, 3)));
2673 addRow(tr("Y"), QString("%1 … %2").arg(formatLength(b.ymin, 3), formatLength(b.ymax, 3)));
2674 addRow(tr("Ancho"), lengthText(b.width(), 3) + (displayInch_ ? " in" : " mm"));
2675 addRow(tr("Alto"), lengthText(b.height(), 3) + (displayInch_ ? " in" : " mm"));
2676 }
2677 const auto git = gerberLayers_.find(layer);
2678 if (git != gerberLayers_.end()) {
2679 const fc::GerberResult& g = git->second;
2680 addRow(tr("Unidades"), QString::fromStdString(fc::toString(g.fileUnits)));
2681 addRow(tr("Aperturas"), QString::number(g.apertures.size()));
2682 addRow(tr("Flashes"), QString::number(g.flashes));
2683 addRow(tr("Segmentos"), QString::number(g.segments));
2684 addRow(tr("Regiones"), QString::number(g.regions));
2685 addRow(tr("Sólidos"), QString::number(g.solids.size()));
2686 addRow(tr("Recorridos"), QString::number(g.follows.size()));
2687 addRow(tr("Área cobre"), QString::number(g.solid.area(), 'f', 3) + " mm²");
2688 for (const std::string& warning : g.warnings) addRow(tr("Aviso"), QString::fromStdString(warning));
2689 }
2690 const auto eit = excellonLayers_.find(layer);
2691 if (eit != excellonLayers_.end()) {
2692 const fc::ExcellonResult& e = eit->second;
2693 addRow(tr("Unidades"), QString::fromStdString(fc::toString(e.fileUnits)));
2694 addRow(tr("Taladros"), QString::number(e.drillCount));
2695 addRow(tr("Ranuras"), QString::number(e.slotCount));
2696 addRow(tr("Herramientas"), QString::number(e.tools.size()));
2697 for (const auto& [number, tool] : e.tools) {
2698 addRow(tr("T%1").arg(number),
2699 tr("Ø %1 %2 · %3 taladros · %4 ranuras")
2700 .arg(lengthText(tool.diameter, 3), displayInch_ ? "in" : "mm")
2701 .arg(tool.drills.size())
2702 .arg(tool.slotSegments.size()));
2703 }
2704 for (const std::string& warning : e.warnings) addRow(tr("Aviso"), QString::fromStdString(warning));
2705 }
2706 if (item->text(2) == "gcode") {
2707 addRow(tr("Recorridos"), QString::number(canvas_->layerFollows(layer).size()));
2708 }
2709 const auto props = objectProps_.find(layer);
2710 if (props != objectProps_.end()) {
2711 for (const auto& [key, value] : props->second) {
2712 if (key.startsWith("__")) continue;
2713 addRow(key, value, true);
2714 }
2715 }
2716}

2718/// @brief Elimina los objetos seleccionados con undo.
2719void MainWindow::deleteSelectedObject() {
2720 const auto selected = objects_->selectedItems();
2721 if (selected.isEmpty()) return;
2722 QStringList names;
2723 for (QTreeWidgetItem* row : selected) {
2724 const int id = row->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
2725 if (id > 0) names << row->text(1);
2726 }
2727 if (names.isEmpty()) return;
2728 const QString detail = names.size() == 1
2729 ? tr("¿Eliminar «%1» del proyecto?").arg(names.first())
2730 : tr("¿Eliminar %1 objetos del proyecto?").arg(names.size());
2731 if (QMessageBox::question(this, tr("Eliminar del proyecto"), detail,
2732 QMessageBox::Yes | QMessageBox::No, QMessageBox::No) !=
2733 QMessageBox::Yes)
2734 return;
2735 if (selected.size() > 1) {
2736 struct Entry {
2737 int id = 0;
2738 QString name;
2739 QString kind;
2740 QString area;
2741 bool visible = true;
2742 Canvas::LayerSnapshot snapshot;
2743 };
2744 std::vector<Entry> entries;
2745 for (QTreeWidgetItem* row : selected) {
2746 const int id = row->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
2747 if (id <= 0) continue;
2748 entries.push_back({id, row->text(1), row->text(2), row->text(3),
2749 row->data(0, Qt::UserRole + 1).toBool(),
2750 canvas_->layerSnapshot(id)});
2751 }
2752 if (entries.empty()) return;
2753 auto remove = [this, entries] {
2754 for (const Entry& entry : entries) {
2755 canvas_->removeLayer(entry.id);
2756 gerberLayers_.erase(entry.id);
2757 excellonLayers_.erase(entry.id);
2758 sourcePaths_.erase(entry.id);
2759 if (QTreeWidgetItem* row = findObjectItem(entry.id)) delete row;
2760 }
2761 refreshSourceCombos();
2762 refreshProperties();
2763 };
2764 auto restore = [this, entries] {
2765 for (const Entry& entry : entries) {
2766 canvas_->insertLayer(entry.snapshot);
2767 addObjectRow(entry.name, entry.kind, entry.area, entry.id, entry.visible);
2768 }
2769 refreshProperties();
2770 };
2771 undoStack_->push(new LambdaCommand(restore, remove, tr("Eliminar objetos")));
2772 return;
2773 }
2774 QTreeWidgetItem* item = objects_->currentItem();
2775 if (!item) return;
2776
2777 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
2778 if (id <= 0) return;
2779 const Canvas::LayerSnapshot snapshot = canvas_->layerSnapshot(id);
2780 const QString name = item->text(1);
2781 const QString kind = item->text(2);
2782 const QString area = item->text(3);
2783 const bool checked = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole + 1).toBool();
2784
2785 auto remove = [this, id] {
2786 canvas_->removeLayer(id);
2787 gerberLayers_.erase(id);
2788 excellonLayers_.erase(id);
2789 if (QTreeWidgetItem* candidate = findObjectItem(id)) delete candidate;
2790 refreshSourceCombos();
2791 refreshProperties();
2792 };
2793
2794 auto restore = [this, snapshot, name, kind, area, checked] {
2795 canvas_->insertLayer(snapshot);
2796 auto* restored = addObjectRow(name, kind, area, snapshot.id, checked);
2797 objects_->setCurrentItem(restored);
2798 refreshProperties();
2799 };
2800
2801 undoStack_->push(new LambdaCommand(restore, remove, tr("Eliminar objeto")));
2802}
2803
2804/// @brief Duplica el objeto activo y su geometría.
2805void MainWindow::duplicateSelectedObject() {
2806 QTreeWidgetItem* item = objects_->currentItem();
2807 if (!item) return;
2808
2809 const int sourceId = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
2810 if (sourceId <= 0) return;
2811 const QString name = item->text(1) + tr(" (copia)");
2812 const QString kind = item->text(2);
2813 const QString area = item->text(3);
2814 const bool checked = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole + 1).toBool();
2815 auto newId = std::make_shared<int>(0);
2816
2817 auto addCopy = [this, sourceId, newId, name, kind, area, checked] {
2818 const int id = canvas_->duplicateLayer(sourceId);
2819 if (id < 0) return;
2820 *newId = id;
2821 if (gerberLayers_.count(sourceId)) gerberLayers_[id] = gerberLayers_[sourceId];
2822 if (excellonLayers_.count(sourceId)) excellonLayers_[id] = excellonLayers_[sourceId];
2823 auto* duplicated = addObjectRow(name, kind, area, id, checked);
2824 objects_->setCurrentItem(duplicated);
2825 };
2826
2827 auto removeCopy = [this, newId] {
2828 canvas_->removeLayer(*newId);
2829 if (QTreeWidgetItem* candidate = findObjectItem(*newId)) delete candidate;
2830 refreshProperties();
2831 };
2832
2833 undoStack_->push(new LambdaCommand(removeCopy, addCopy, tr("Duplicar objeto")));
2834}
2835
2836// ============================================================================
2837// Editores y operaciones geométricas
2838// ============================================================================
2839
2840/// @brief Abre el editor de vértices de la geometría activa.
2841void MainWindow::editGeometry() {
2842 auto* item = objects_->currentItem();
2843 if (!item) {
2844 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Editor de geometría"), tr("Seleccione un objeto."));
2845 return;
2846 }
2847 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
2848 const std::vector<Geom> beforeSolids = canvas_->layerSolids(id);
2849 const std::vector<Geom> beforeFollows = canvas_->layerFollows(id);
2850 if (beforeSolids.empty() && beforeFollows.empty()) {
2851 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Editor de geometría"),
2852 tr("Este objeto no tiene geometría editable (por ejemplo, "
2853 "cargado desde un proyecto grande)."));
2854 return;
2855 }
2856
2857 struct ContourRef {
2858 int kind = 0; // 0 outer, 1 hole, 2 line
2859 std::size_t solid = 0;
2860 std::size_t part = 0;
2861 std::size_t hole = 0;
2862 std::size_t line = 0;
2863 QString label;
2864 };
2865
2866 std::vector<std::vector<PolygonContours>> parts(beforeSolids.size());
2867 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < beforeSolids.size(); ++i) parts[i] = beforeSolids[i].polygons();
2868
2869 std::vector<Ring> lines;
2870 for (const Geom& g : beforeFollows) {
2871 if (!g.valid() || g.empty()) continue;
2872 if (g.typeId() == GEOS_LINESTRING || g.typeId() == GEOS_LINEARRING) {
2873 lines.push_back(g.coords());
2874 } else {
2875 for (int k = 0; k < g.numGeometries(); ++k) {
2876 const Geom part = g.geometryN(k);
2877 if (part.typeId() == GEOS_LINESTRING || part.typeId() == GEOS_LINEARRING)
2878 lines.push_back(part.coords());
2879 }
2880 }
2881 }
2882
2883 std::vector<ContourRef> refs;
2884 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < parts.size(); ++i) {
2885 for (std::size_t p = 0; p < parts[i].size(); ++p) {
2886 ContourRef ref;
2887 ref.kind = 0;
2888 ref.solid = i;
2889 ref.part = p;
2890 ref.label = tr("Sólido %1 · contorno %2").arg(i).arg(p);
2891 refs.push_back(ref);
2892 for (std::size_t h = 0; h < parts[i][p].holes.size(); ++h) {
2893 ContourRef hole;
2894 hole.kind = 1;
2895 hole.solid = i;
2896 hole.part = p;
2897 hole.hole = h;
2898 hole.label = tr("Sólido %1 · agujero %2").arg(i).arg(h);
2899 refs.push_back(hole);
2900 }
2901 }
2902 }
2903 for (std::size_t l = 0; l < lines.size(); ++l) {
2904 ContourRef ref;
2905 ref.kind = 2;
2906 ref.line = l;
2907 ref.label = tr("Recorrido %1").arg(l);
2908 refs.push_back(ref);
2909 }
2910 if (refs.empty()) {
2911 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Editor de geometría"), tr("No hay contornos editables."));
2912 return;
2913 }
2914
2915 QDialog dialog(this);
2916 dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("Editor de geometría"));
2917 auto* layout = new QVBoxLayout(&dialog);
2918 auto* combo = new QComboBox(&dialog);
2919 for (const ContourRef& ref : refs) combo->addItem(ref.label);
2920 applyTip(combo, tr("Elegí el contorno o recorrido cuyos vértices querés editar."));
2921 layout->addWidget(combo);
2922
2923 auto* table = new QTableWidget(0, 2, &dialog);
2924 table->setHorizontalHeaderLabels({tr("X"), tr("Y")});
2925 table->horizontalHeader()->setStretchLastSection(true);
2926 applyTip(table, tr("Coordenadas de los vértices. Doble clic para editar; se reconstruye la "
2927 "geometría al aceptar."));
2928 layout->addWidget(table);
2929
2930 auto* buttonsRow = new QHBoxLayout();
2931 auto* addPoint = new QPushButton(tr("Añadir punto"), &dialog);
2932 auto* removePoint = new QPushButton(tr("Eliminar punto"), &dialog);
2933 auto* undoPoint = new QPushButton(tr("Deshacer"), &dialog);
2934 auto* redoPoint = new QPushButton(tr("Rehacer"), &dialog);
2935 applyTip(addPoint, tr("Agrega un vértice al final del contorno actual."));
2936 applyTip(removePoint, tr("Elimina la fila/vértice seleccionado."));
2937 buttonsRow->addWidget(addPoint);
2938 buttonsRow->addWidget(removePoint);
2939 buttonsRow->addWidget(undoPoint);
2940 buttonsRow->addWidget(redoPoint);
2941 layout->addLayout(buttonsRow);
2942
2943 auto* box = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::Ok | QDialogButtonBox::Cancel, &dialog);
2944 layout->addWidget(box);
2945 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::accepted, &dialog, &QDialog::accept);
2946 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &dialog, &QDialog::reject);
2947
2948 std::size_t current = 0;
2949
2950 auto ringFor = [&](std::size_t index) -> Ring& {
2951 const ContourRef& ref = refs[index];
2952 if (ref.kind == 0) return parts[ref.solid][ref.part].outer;
2953 if (ref.kind == 1) return parts[ref.solid][ref.part].holes[ref.hole];
2954 return lines[ref.line];
2955 };
2956
2957 auto loadTable = [&](std::size_t index) {
2958 const Ring& ring = ringFor(index);
2959 table->setRowCount(static_cast<int>(ring.size()));
2960 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < ring.size(); ++i) {
2961 table->setItem(static_cast<int>(i), 0, new QTableWidgetItem(QString::number(ring[i].x, 'f', 4)));
2962 table->setItem(static_cast<int>(i), 1, new QTableWidgetItem(QString::number(ring[i].y, 'f', 4)));
2963 }
2964 };
2965
2966 auto saveTable = [&](std::size_t index) {
2967 Ring& ring = ringFor(index);
2968 ring.clear();
2969 for (int i = 0; i < table->rowCount(); ++i) {
2970 auto* x = table->item(i, 0);
2971 auto* y = table->item(i, 1);
2972 if (!x || !y) continue;
2973 ring.push_back({parseNumberText(x->text()), parseNumberText(y->text())});
2974 }
2975 };
2976
2977 using GeometrySnapshot =
2978 std::pair<std::vector<std::vector<PolygonContours>>, std::vector<Ring>>;
2979 std::vector<GeometrySnapshot> history;
2980 int historyPos = -1;
2981 auto pushHistory = [&] {
2982 history.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(historyPos + 1));
2983 history.push_back({parts, lines});
2984 historyPos = static_cast<int>(history.size()) - 1;
2985 };
2986 auto restoreHistory = [&](int pos) {
2987 if (pos < 0 || pos >= static_cast<int>(history.size())) return;
2988 historyPos = pos;
2989 parts = history[static_cast<std::size_t>(pos)].first;
2990 lines = history[static_cast<std::size_t>(pos)].second;
2991 loadTable(current);
2992 };
2993 pushHistory();
2994 connect(undoPoint, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [&] {
2995 if (historyPos > 0) restoreHistory(historyPos - 1);
2996 });
2997 connect(redoPoint, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [&] {
2998 if (historyPos + 1 < static_cast<int>(history.size())) restoreHistory(historyPos + 1);
2999 });
3000
3001 loadTable(0);
3002 connect(combo, QOverload<int>::of(&QComboBox::currentIndexChanged), this,
3003 [&](int index) {
3004 if (index < 0) return;
3005 pushHistory();
3006 saveTable(current);
3007 current = static_cast<std::size_t>(index);
3008 loadTable(current);
3009 });
3010
3011 connect(addPoint, &QPushButton::clicked, &dialog, [&] {
3012 pushHistory();
3013 const int row = table->rowCount();
3014 table->insertRow(row);
3015 table->setItem(row, 0, new QTableWidgetItem("0"));
3016 table->setItem(row, 1, new QTableWidgetItem("0"));
3017 });
3018 connect(removePoint, &QPushButton::clicked, &dialog, [&] {
3019 pushHistory();
3020 const int row = table->currentRow();
3021 if (row >= 0) table->removeRow(row);
3022 });
3023
3024 if (dialog.exec() != QDialog::Accepted) return;
3025 saveTable(current);
3026
3027 std::vector<Geom> afterSolids;
3028 for (const auto& solidParts : parts) {
3029 std::vector<Geom> pieces;
3030 for (const PolygonContours& pc : solidParts) {
3031 if (pc.outer.size() < 3) continue;
3032 pieces.push_back(Geom::polygon(pc.outer, pc.holes).fixed());
3033 }
3034 if (!pieces.empty()) afterSolids.push_back(Geom::unionOf(pieces));
3035 }
3036 std::vector<Geom> afterFollows;
3037 for (const Ring& line : lines) {
3038 if (line.size() >= 2) afterFollows.push_back(Geom::line(line));
3039 }
3040
3041 auto apply = [this, id](const std::vector<Geom>& solids, const std::vector<Geom>& follows) {
3042 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, solids, follows);
3043 refreshProperties();
3044 };
3045
3046 undoStack_->push(new LambdaCommand([apply, beforeSolids, beforeFollows] {
3047 apply(beforeSolids, beforeFollows);
3048 },
3049 [apply, afterSolids, afterFollows] {
3050 apply(afterSolids, afterFollows);
3051 },
3052 tr("Editar geometría")));
3053}

3055/// @brief Abre el diálogo de operaciones geométricas (buffer, escalar...).
3056void MainWindow::geometryOperations() {
3057 auto* item = objects_->currentItem();
3058 if (!item) {
3059 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Operaciones de geometría"),
3060 tr("Seleccioná un objeto."));
3061 return;
3062 }
3063 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
3064 const std::vector<Geom> beforeSolids = canvas_->layerSolids(id);
3065 const std::vector<Geom> beforeFollows = canvas_->layerFollows(id);
3066 if (beforeSolids.empty() && beforeFollows.empty()) {
3067 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Operaciones de geometría"),
3068 tr("El objeto no tiene geometría editable."));
3069 return;
3070 }
3071
3072 QDialog dialog(this);
3073 dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("Operaciones de geometría"));
3074 auto* form = new QFormLayout(&dialog);
3075 auto* simplify = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
3076 simplify->setRange(0.0, 10.0);
3077 simplify->setDecimals(4);
3078 simplify->setValue(0.0);
3079 simplify->setSuffix(" mm");
3080 auto* buffer = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
3081 buffer->setRange(-20.0, 20.0);
3082 buffer->setDecimals(3);
3083 buffer->setValue(0.0);
3084 buffer->setSuffix(" mm");
3085 auto* scale = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
3086 scale->setRange(0.01, 100.0);
3087 scale->setDecimals(4);
3088 scale->setValue(1.0);
3089 auto* rotate = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
3090 rotate->setRange(-360.0, 360.0);
3091 rotate->setDecimals(2);
3092 rotate->setSuffix(" °");
3093 auto* skewX = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
3094 skewX->setRange(-10.0, 10.0);
3095 skewX->setDecimals(4);
3096 skewX->setValue(0.0);
3097 auto* skewY = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
3098 skewY->setRange(-10.0, 10.0);
3099 skewY->setDecimals(4);
3100 skewY->setValue(0.0);
3101 auto* booleanOp = new QComboBox(&dialog);
3102 booleanOp->addItems({tr("Ninguna"), tr("Unión"), tr("Diferencia"), tr("Intersección")});
3103 auto* comboB = new QComboBox(&dialog);
3104 std::vector<int> idsB;
3105 for (QTreeWidgetItem* row : objectItems()) {
3106 const int other = row->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
3107 if (other == id) continue;
3108 if (canvas_->layerSolids(other).empty()) continue;
3109 comboB->addItem(row->text(1), other);
3110 idsB.push_back(other);
3111 }
3112 form->addRow(tr("Simplificar:"), simplify);
3113 form->addRow(tr("Buffer/offset:"), buffer);
3114 form->addRow(tr("Escalar:"), scale);
3115 form->addRow(tr("Rotar:"), rotate);
3116 form->addRow(tr("Skew X:"), skewX);
3117 form->addRow(tr("Skew Y:"), skewY);
3118 form->addRow(tr("Booleana:"), booleanOp);
3119 form->addRow(tr("Objeto B:"), comboB);
3120 auto* box = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::Ok | QDialogButtonBox::Cancel, &dialog);
3121 form->addRow(box);
3122 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::accepted, &dialog, &QDialog::accept);
3123 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &dialog, &QDialog::reject);
3124 if (dialog.exec() != QDialog::Accepted) return;
3125
3126 Geom work = Geom::unionOf(beforeSolids);
3127 if (!work.valid() || work.empty()) {
3128 work = Geom::unionOf(beforeFollows);
3129 if (!work.valid()) return;
3130 }
3131 const BBox bounds = canvas_->layerBounds(id);
3132 const Pt center{bounds.valid ? (bounds.xmin + bounds.xmax) * 0.5 : 0.0,
3133 bounds.valid ? (bounds.ymin + bounds.ymax) * 0.5 : 0.0};
3134 if (simplify->value() > 0.0) work = work.simplify(simplify->value()).fixed();
3135 if (std::fabs(buffer->value()) > 1e-9) work = work.buffer(buffer->value(), 16);
3136 if (std::fabs(scale->value() - 1.0) > 1e-9)
3137 work = work.scale(scale->value(), scale->value(), center);
3138 if (std::fabs(rotate->value()) > 1e-9) work = work.rotateDeg(rotate->value(), center);
3139 if (std::fabs(skewX->value()) > 1e-9 || std::fabs(skewY->value()) > 1e-9) {
3140 const double sx = skewX->value();
3141 const double sy = skewY->value();
3142 work = work.transformXY([center, sx, sy](Pt p) {
3143 const double x = p.x - center.x;
3144 const double y = p.y - center.y;
3145 return Pt{center.x + x + sx * y, center.y + y + sy * x};
3146 });
3147 }
3148 if (booleanOp->currentIndex() > 0 && comboB->count() > 0) {
3149 const int other = comboB->currentData().toInt();
3150 const Geom b = Geom::unionOf(canvas_->layerSolids(other));
3151 if (b.valid() && !b.empty()) {
3152 if (booleanOp->currentIndex() == 1) work = work.unite(b);
3153 else if (booleanOp->currentIndex() == 2) work = work.difference(b);
3154 else work = work.intersection(b);
3155 }
3156 }
3157 if (!work.valid() || work.empty()) {
3158 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Operaciones de geometría"),
3159 tr("El resultado quedó vacío."));
3160 return;
3161 }
3162
3163 std::vector<Geom> afterSolids;
3164 std::vector<Geom> afterFollows;
3165 if (beforeSolids.empty()) {
3166 afterFollows.push_back(work);
3167 } else {
3168 for (const PolygonContours& pc : work.polygons()) {
3169 if (pc.outer.size() >= 3) afterSolids.push_back(Geom::polygon(pc.outer, pc.holes));
3170 }
3171 if (afterSolids.empty()) afterSolids.push_back(work);
3172 }
3173 if (!beforeFollows.empty()) {
3174 for (const Geom& g : beforeFollows) {
3175 Geom transformed = g;
3176 if (std::fabs(scale->value() - 1.0) > 1e-9)
3177 transformed = transformed.scale(scale->value(), scale->value(), center);
3178 if (std::fabs(rotate->value()) > 1e-9)
3179 transformed = transformed.rotateDeg(rotate->value(), center);
3180 if (std::fabs(skewX->value()) > 1e-9 || std::fabs(skewY->value()) > 1e-9) {
3181 const double sx = skewX->value();
3182 const double sy = skewY->value();
3183 transformed = transformed.transformXY([center, sx, sy](Pt p) {
3184 const double x = p.x - center.x;
3185 const double y = p.y - center.y;
3186 return Pt{center.x + x + sx * y, center.y + y + sy * x};
3187 });
3188 }
3189 afterFollows.push_back(transformed);
3190 }
3191 }
3192
3193 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, afterSolids, afterFollows);
3194 auto apply = [this, id](const std::vector<Geom>& solids, const std::vector<Geom>& follows) {
3195 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, solids, follows);
3196 refreshProperties();
3197 };
3198 undoStack_->push(new LambdaCommand([apply, beforeSolids, beforeFollows] {
3199 apply(beforeSolids, beforeFollows);
3200 },
3201 [apply, afterSolids, afterFollows] {
3202 apply(afterSolids, afterFollows);
3203 },
3204 tr("Operaciones de geometría")));
3205 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Geometría transformada"), 4000);
3206}

3208/// @brief Abre el diálogo de unión, diferencia e intersección.
3209void MainWindow::booleanDialog() {
3210 auto* item = objects_->currentItem();
3211 if (!item) {
3212 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Booleanas"), tr("Seleccione el objeto A."));
3213 return;
3214 }
3215 const int idA = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
3216 const std::vector<Geom> solidsA = canvas_->layerSolids(idA);
3217 if (solidsA.empty()) {
3218 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Booleanas"),
3219 tr("El objeto A no tiene geometría editable."));
3220 return;
3221 }
3222
3223 QDialog dialog(this);
3224 dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("Operaciones booleanas"));
3225 auto* form = new QFormLayout(&dialog);
3226
3227 auto* operation = new QComboBox(&dialog);
3228 operation->addItem(originalIcon("union"), tr("Unión (A + B)"));
3229 operation->addItem(originalIcon("subtract"), tr("Diferencia (A - B)"));
3230 operation->addItem(originalIcon("intersection"), tr("Intersección (A ∩ B)"));
3231 applyTip(operation, tr("Unión: suma A y B. Diferencia: quita B de A. Intersección: sólo lo común."));
3232 form->addRow(tr("Operación:"), operation);
3233
3234 auto* comboB = new QComboBox(&dialog);
3235 std::vector<int> idsB;
3236 for (const int otherId : canvas_->layerIds()) {
3237 if (otherId == idA) continue;
3238 if (canvas_->layerSolids(otherId).empty()) continue;
3239 for (QTreeWidgetItem* candidate : objectItems()) {
3240 if (candidate->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt() == otherId) {
3241 comboB->addItem(candidate->text(1));
3242 idsB.push_back(otherId);
3243 break;
3244 }
3245 }
3246 }
3247 if (comboB->count() == 0) {
3248 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Booleanas"),
3249 tr("No hay otro objeto con geometría editable."));
3250 return;
3251 }
3252 applyTip(comboB, tr("Segundo objeto con el que se combina el seleccionado."));
3253 form->addRow(tr("Objeto B:"), comboB);
3254
3255 auto* box = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::Ok | QDialogButtonBox::Cancel, &dialog);
3256 form->addRow(box);
3257 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::accepted, &dialog, &QDialog::accept);
3258 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &dialog, &QDialog::reject);
3259 if (dialog.exec() != QDialog::Accepted) return;
3260
3261 const int idB = idsB[static_cast<std::size_t>(comboB->currentIndex())];
3262 const std::vector<Geom> solidsB = canvas_->layerSolids(idB);
3263 const Geom a = Geom::unionOf(solidsA);
3264 const Geom b = Geom::unionOf(solidsB);
3265
3266 Geom result;
3267 switch (operation->currentIndex()) {
3268 case 0: result = a.unite(b); break;
3269 case 1: result = a.difference(b); break;
3270 default: result = a.intersection(b); break;
3271 }
3272 if (!result.valid()) {
3273 showError(tr("La operación no produjo geometría"));
3274 return;
3275 }
3276
3277 const std::vector<Geom> afterA{result};
3278 const bool wasVisibleB = true;
3279 auto applyA = [this, idA](const std::vector<Geom>& solids) {
3280 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(idA, solids, {});
3281 refreshProperties();
3282 };
3283 auto setBVisible = [this, idB](bool visible) {
3284 if (QTreeWidgetItem* candidate = findObjectItem(idB)) {
3285 updatingTree_ = true;
3286 setObjectVisible(candidate, visible);
3287 updatingTree_ = false;
3288 }
3289 };
3290
3291 undoStack_->push(new LambdaCommand(
3292 [applyA, setBVisible, wasVisibleB, solidsA] {
3293 applyA(solidsA);
3294 setBVisible(wasVisibleB);
3295 },
3296 [applyA, setBVisible, afterA] {
3297 applyA(afterA);
3298 setBVisible(false);
3299 },
3300 tr("Operación booleana")));
3301}

3303/// @brief Mueve, rota o escala el objeto activo.
3304void MainWindow::transformSelectedObject() {
3305 QTreeWidgetItem* item = objects_->currentItem();
3306 if (!item) return;
3307
3308 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
3309 if (id <= 0) return;
3310 const Canvas::LayerSnapshot before = canvas_->layerSnapshot(id);
3311 if (before.id == 0) return;
3312
3313 QDialog dialog(this);
3314 dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("Transformar objeto"));
3315 auto* form = new QFormLayout(&dialog);
3316
3317 auto* dx = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
3318 dx->setRange(-1000, 1000);
3319 dx->setDecimals(3);
3320 dx->setSuffix(" mm");
3321 applyTip(dx, tr("Desplazamiento horizontal del objeto."));
3322 form->addRow(tr("Mover X:"), dx);
3323
3324 auto* dy = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
3325 dy->setRange(-1000, 1000);
3326 dy->setDecimals(3);
3327 dy->setSuffix(" mm");
3328 applyTip(dy, tr("Desplazamiento vertical del objeto."));
3329 form->addRow(tr("Mover Y:"), dy);
3330
3331 auto* angle = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
3332 angle->setRange(-360, 360);
3333 angle->setDecimals(2);
3334 angle->setSuffix(" °");
3335 applyTip(angle, tr("Rotación en grados alrededor del centro del objeto."));
3336 form->addRow(tr("Rotar:"), angle);
3337
3338 auto* scale = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
3339 scale->setRange(0.01, 100.0);
3340 scale->setDecimals(3);
3341 scale->setValue(1.0);
3342 applyTip(scale, tr("Factor de escala. 1 = sin cambios, 2 = doble tamaño."));
3343 form->addRow(tr("Escalar:"), scale);
3344
3345 auto* buttons = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::Ok | QDialogButtonBox::Cancel, &dialog);
3346 form->addRow(buttons);
3347 connect(buttons, &QDialogButtonBox::accepted, &dialog, &QDialog::accept);
3348 connect(buttons, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &dialog, &QDialog::reject);
3349 if (dialog.exec() != QDialog::Accepted) return;
3350
3351 const fc::BBox b = canvas_->layerBounds(id);
3352 const double cx = b.valid ? (b.xmin + b.xmax) / 2.0 : 0.0;
3353 const double cy = b.valid ? (b.ymin + b.ymax) / 2.0 : 0.0;
3354
3355 QTransform transform;
3356 transform.translate(dx->value(), dy->value());
3357 transform.translate(cx, cy);
3358 transform.rotate(angle->value());
3359 transform.scale(scale->value(), scale->value());
3360 transform.translate(-cx, -cy);
3361
3362 const std::vector<Geom> beforeSolids = canvas_->layerSolids(id);
3363 const std::vector<Geom> beforeFollows = canvas_->layerFollows(id);
3364 auto applyTransform = [&transform](const std::vector<Geom>& input) {
3365 std::vector<Geom> output;
3366 output.reserve(input.size());
3367 for (const Geom& g : input) {
3368 output.push_back(g.transformXY([&transform](Pt p) {
3369 const QPointF q = transform.map(QPointF(p.x, p.y));
3370 return Pt{q.x(), q.y()};
3371 }));
3372 }
3373 return output;
3374 };
3375 const std::vector<Geom> afterSolids = applyTransform(beforeSolids);
3376 const std::vector<Geom> afterFollows = applyTransform(beforeFollows);
3377 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, afterSolids, afterFollows);
3378 const auto apply = [this, id](const std::vector<Geom>& solids, const std::vector<Geom>& follows) {
3379 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, solids, follows);
3380 refreshProperties();
3381 };
3382 undoStack_->push(new LambdaCommand(
3383 [apply, beforeSolids, beforeFollows] { apply(beforeSolids, beforeFollows); },
3384 [apply, afterSolids, afterFollows] { apply(afterSolids, afterFollows); },
3385 tr("Transformar objeto")));
3386}

3410/// @brief Ejecuta un script JavaScript en el contexto de la aplicación.
3411bool MainWindow::runScriptFile(const QString& path) {
3412 QFile file(path);
3413 if (!file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
3414 showError(tr("No se pudo abrir el script"));
3415 return false;
3416 }
3417 const QString code = QString::fromUtf8(file.readAll());
3418
3419 QJSEngine engine;
3420 fc::ScriptApi api;
3421 api.setLayerSink([this](const QString& name, const QString& kind,
3422 const std::vector<Geom>& solids,
3423 const std::vector<Geom>& follows) {
3424 const int id = canvas_->appendGeometry(solids, follows, true);
3425 canvas_->endGeometry();
3426 addObjectRow(name, kind, "-", id);
3427 if (kind == "gerber") {
3428 GerberResult r;
3429 r.solids = solids;
3430 r.follows = follows;
3431 r.solid = solids.empty() ? Geom() : Geom::unionOf(solids);
3432 r.bounds = r.solid.valid() ? r.solid.bounds() : BBox{};
3433 gerberLayers_[id] = r;
3434 } else if (kind == "excellon") {
3435 ExcellonResult r;
3436 r.geometry = solids;
3437 r.solid = solids.empty() ? Geom() : Geom::unionOf(solids);
3438 r.bounds = r.solid.valid() ? r.solid.bounds() : BBox{};
3439 excellonLayers_[id] = r;
3440 }
3441 if (!canvas_->hasData()) canvas_->fitTo(canvas_->layerBounds(id));
3442 });
3443 fc::installScriptApi(engine, &api);
3444 const QJSValue result = engine.evaluate(code, path);
3445 if (result.isError()) {
3446 info_->setPlainText(info_->toPlainText() + "\n--- SCRIPT ERROR ---\n" + result.toString());
3447 showError(result.toString());
3448 return false;
3449 }
3450
3451 info_->setPlainText(info_->toPlainText() + "\n--- SCRIPT ---\n" + path + "\n" + api.info());
3452 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Script ejecutado: %1").arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName()), 5000);
3453 return true;
3454}

3466/// @brief Editor de texto para scripts, con guardar y ejecutar.
3467void MainWindow::scriptEditor(const QString& initialPath) {
3468 QString path = initialPath;
3469 QString content;
3470 if (!path.isEmpty()) {
3471 QFile file(path);
3472 if (file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text))
3473 content = QString::fromUtf8(file.readAll());
3474 }
3475
3476 QDialog dialog(this);
3477 dialog.resize(900, 640);
3478 dialog.setWindowTitle(path.isEmpty() ? tr("Nuevo script") : tr("Script — %1").arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName()));
3479 auto* layout = new QVBoxLayout(&dialog);
3480 auto* editor = new QPlainTextEdit(&dialog);
3481 editor->setPlainText(content.isEmpty() ? "// Script FlatCAM C++ (Qt JS)\n// flatcam.openGerber(\"...\");\n// flatcam.isolate(0.2, 1, 0);\n" : content);
3482 editor->setStyleSheet("QPlainTextEdit { font-family: Menlo; font-size: 12px; }");
3483 layout->addWidget(editor);
3484 auto* buttons = new QHBoxLayout();
3485 auto* save = new QPushButton(originalIcon("save"), tr("Guardar"), &dialog);
3486 auto* run = new QPushButton(originalIcon("script"), tr("Guardar y ejecutar"), &dialog);
3487 buttons->addStretch();
3488 buttons->addWidget(save);
3489 buttons->addWidget(run);
3490 layout->addLayout(buttons);
3491 auto* box = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::Close, &dialog);
3492 layout->addWidget(box);
3493 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &dialog, &QDialog::reject);
3494
3495 connect(save, &QPushButton::clicked, &dialog, [this, &path, editor, &dialog] {
3496 if (path.isEmpty()) {
3497 path = QFileDialog::getSaveFileName(
3498 this, tr("Guardar script"), QFileInfo(lastDir_).absolutePath() + "/script.js",
3499 tr("JavaScript (*.js)"));
3500 if (path.isEmpty()) return;
3501 }
3502 QFile file(path);
3503 if (!file.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly | QIODevice::Text)) return;
3504 file.write(editor->toPlainText().toUtf8());
3505 dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("Script — %1").arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName()));
3506 });
3507 connect(run, &QPushButton::clicked, &dialog, [this, &path, editor, &dialog] {
3508 if (path.isEmpty()) {
3509 path = QFileDialog::getSaveFileName(
3510 this, tr("Guardar script"), QFileInfo(lastDir_).absolutePath() + "/script.js",
3511 tr("JavaScript (*.js)"));
3512 if (path.isEmpty()) return;
3513 }
3514 QFile file(path);
3515 if (!file.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly | QIODevice::Text)) return;
3516 file.write(editor->toPlainText().toUtf8());
3517 file.close();
3518 runScriptFile(path);
3519 });
3520 dialog.exec();
3521}

3530/// @brief Carga el objeto de proyecto seleccionado.
3531void MainWindow::projectObjectSelected() {
3532 auto* item = objects_->currentItem();
3533 if (!item) return;
3534 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
3535 const auto objectProps = objectProps_.find(id);
3536 if (objectProps != objectProps_.end()) {
3537 const auto tables = objectProps->second.find(QStringLiteral("__toolTables"));
3538 if (tables != objectProps->second.end()) loadToolTablesJson(tables->second);
3539 }
3540
3541 if (gerberLayers_.count(id)) {
3542 lastGerber_ = gerberLayers_[id];
3543 lastExcellon_.reset();
3544 lastDrillJob_.reset();
3545 } else if (excellonLayers_.count(id)) {
3546 lastExcellon_ = excellonLayers_[id];
3547 lastDrillJob_ = fc::drillJobFromExcellon(lastExcellon_.value());
3548 lastGerber_.reset();
3549 }
3550
3551 const fc::BBox b = canvas_->layerBounds(id);
3552 if (b.valid) canvas_->fitTo(b);
3553 refreshProperties();
3554}

3556/// Abre la vista 3D con el cobre visible y los taladros del proyecto.
3557void MainWindow::show3D() {
3558 const std::vector<Geom> solids = canvas_->visibleSolids();
3559 if (solids.empty()) {
3560 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Vista 3D"), tr("No hay capas visibles."));
3561 return;
3562 }
3563 std::vector<Geom> holes;
3564 for (QTreeWidgetItem* item : objectItems()) {
3565 if (!item->data(0, Qt::UserRole + 1).toBool()) continue;
3566 if (item->text(2).toLower() != "excellon") continue;
3567 const auto h = canvas_->layerSolids(item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt());
3568 holes.insert(holes.end(), h.begin(), h.end());
3569 }
3570 auto* dialog = new View3D(solids, holes, this);
3571 dialog->setAttribute(Qt::WA_DeleteOnClose);
3572 dialog->show();
3573 dialog->raise();
3574}

3691/// @brief Adaptador Tcl del comando `open`.
3692bool MainWindow::tclOpen(const QString& path, bool excellon) {

3696 canvas_->endGeometry();
3697 if (!objectItems().empty()) objects_->setCurrentItem(objectItems().back());
3698 }
3699 return ok;
3700 } catch (const std::exception& e) {
3701 showError(QString::fromUtf8(e.what()));
3702 return false;
3703 }
3704}

3734/// @brief Adaptador Tcl del comando `extractdrills`.
3735int MainWindow::tclExtractDrills(double maxDiameter) {
3736 auto* item = objects_ ? objects_->currentItem() : nullptr;
3737 int id = item ? item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt() : 0;
3738 auto it = gerberLayers_.find(id);
3739 GerberResult source;
3740 if (it != gerberLayers_.end()) source = it->second;
3741 else if (lastGerber_) source = *lastGerber_;
3742 else return -1;
3743 const ExcellonResult drills = extractDrills(source, maxDiameter, defaultUnits_, stepsPerCircle_);
3744 if (drills.drillCount == 0) return 0;
3745 const int layerId = addGeneratedSolid(tr("Taladros extraídos"), drills.geometry, id, "excellon");
3746 if (layerId > 0) {
3747 excellonLayers_[layerId] = drills;
3748 lastExcellon_ = drills;
3749 refreshSourceCombos();
3750 }
3751 return static_cast<int>(drills.drillCount);
3752}

3754/// @brief Adaptador Tcl del comando `punch`.
3755int MainWindow::tclPunch(double margin) {
3756 auto* item = objects_ ? objects_->currentItem() : nullptr;
3757 const int id = item ? item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt() : 0;
3758 auto git = gerberLayers_.find(id);
3759 GerberResult source;
3760 if (git != gerberLayers_.end()) source = git->second;
3761 else if (lastGerber_) source = *lastGerber_;
3762 else return -1;
3763 if (!lastExcellon_) return -1;
3764 const Geom punched = punchGerber(source, *lastExcellon_, margin);
3765 if (!punched.valid() || punched.empty()) return 0;
3766 addGeneratedSolid(tr("Punch Gerber"), {punched}, id, "gerber");
3767 return 1;
3768}

3770/// @brief Adaptador Tcl del comando `panelize`.
3771int MainWindow::tclPanelize(int rows, int cols, double gapX, double gapY) {
3772 auto* item = objects_ ? objects_->currentItem() : nullptr;
3773 if (!item || rows < 1 || cols < 1) return -1;
3774 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
3775 const std::vector<Geom> solids = canvas_->layerSolids(id);
3776 const BBox b = canvas_->layerBounds(id);
3777 if (solids.empty() || !b.valid) return -1;
3778 const double dx = b.width() + gapX;
3779 const double dy = b.height() + gapY;
3780 std::vector<Geom> out;
3781 for (int r = 0; r < rows; ++r)
3782 for (int c = 0; c < cols; ++c)
3783 for (const Geom& g : solids)
3784 out.push_back(g.translate(c * dx, r * dy));
3785 addGeneratedSolid(tr("Panel %1x%2").arg(rows).arg(cols), out, id, "panel");
3786 return static_cast<int>(out.size());
3787}

3809/// @brief Adaptador Tcl del comando `optimal`.
3810double MainWindow::tclOptimal(double maxDiameter) {
3811 auto* item = objects_ ? objects_->currentItem() : nullptr;
3812 const int id = item ? item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt() : 0;
3813 auto it = gerberLayers_.find(id);
3814 Geom copper;

3816 else if (lastGerber_) copper = lastGerber_->solid;

3818 const OptimalTool opt = optimalIsolationDiameter(copper, maxDiameter);

3822/// @brief Adaptador Tcl del comando `exportgcode`.
3823bool MainWindow::tclExportGcode(const QString& path) {
3824 std::string code;
3825 if (lastDrillJob_)
3826 code = drillingGCode(*lastDrillJob_, lastDrillHeader_);
3827 else if (!lastIsoMulti_.empty())
3828 code = pathsGCodeMulti(lastIsoMulti_, lastIsoHeader_);
3829 else if (!lastNccMulti_.empty())
3830 code = pathsGCodeMulti(lastNccMulti_, lastNccHeader_);
3831 else if (!lastCutMulti_.empty())
3832 code = pathsGCodeMulti(lastCutMulti_, lastCutHeader_);
3833 else if (!lastPaintMulti_.empty())
3834 code = pathsGCodeMulti(lastPaintMulti_, lastPaintHeader_);
3835 else
3836 return false;
3837 QFile file(path);
3838 if (!file.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly | QIODevice::Text)) return false;
3839 file.write(code.c_str());
3840 return true;
3841}

3919/// @brief Adaptador Tcl del comando `offset`.
3920bool MainWindow::tclOffset(const QString& name, double dx, double dy) {
3921 QTreeWidgetItem* item = findObjectByName(name);
3922 if (!item) return false;
3923 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
3924 std::vector<Geom> solids;
3925 std::vector<Geom> follows;
3926 for (const Geom& g : canvas_->layerSolids(id)) solids.push_back(g.translate(dx, dy));
3927 for (const Geom& g : canvas_->layerFollows(id)) follows.push_back(g.translate(dx, dy));
3928 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, solids, follows);
3929 const auto it = gerberLayers_.find(id);
3930 if (it != gerberLayers_.end()) {
3931 it->second.solids = solids;
3932 it->second.follows = follows;
3933 it->second.solid = Geom::unionOf(solids);
3934 it->second.bounds = it->second.solid.valid() ? it->second.solid.bounds() : BBox{};
3935 }
3936 refreshProperties();
3937 return true;
3938}

3940/// @brief Adaptador Tcl del comando `scale`.
3941bool MainWindow::tclScale(const QString& name, double factor) {
3942 if (factor <= 0.0) return false;
3943 QTreeWidgetItem* item = findObjectByName(name);
3944 if (!item) return false;
3945 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
3946 const BBox b = canvas_->layerBounds(id);
3947 if (!b.valid) return false;
3948 const Pt center{(b.xmin + b.xmax) * 0.5, (b.ymin + b.ymax) * 0.5};
3949 std::vector<Geom> solids;
3950 std::vector<Geom> follows;
3951 for (const Geom& g : canvas_->layerSolids(id)) solids.push_back(g.scale(factor, factor, center));
3952 for (const Geom& g : canvas_->layerFollows(id)) follows.push_back(g.scale(factor, factor, center));
3953 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, solids, follows);
3954 const auto it = gerberLayers_.find(id);
3955 if (it != gerberLayers_.end()) {
3956 it->second.solids = solids;
3957 it->second.follows = follows;
3958 it->second.solid = Geom::unionOf(solids);
3959 it->second.bounds = it->second.solid.valid() ? it->second.solid.bounds() : BBox{};
3960 }
3961 refreshProperties();
3962 return true;
3963}

3965/// @brief Adaptador Tcl del comando `mirror`.
3966bool MainWindow::tclMirror(const QString& name, const QString& axis) {
3967 QTreeWidgetItem* item = findObjectByName(name);
3968 if (!item) return false;
3969 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
3970 const BBox b = canvas_->layerBounds(id);
3971 if (!b.valid) return false;
3972 const Pt center{(b.xmin + b.xmax) * 0.5, (b.ymin + b.ymax) * 0.5};
3973 const bool mirrorX = axis.compare("x", Qt::CaseInsensitive) == 0;
3974 std::vector<Geom> solids;
3975 std::vector<Geom> follows;
3976 for (const Geom& g : canvas_->layerSolids(id))
3977 solids.push_back(mirrorX ? g.scale(-1.0, 1.0, center) : g.scale(1.0, -1.0, center));
3978 for (const Geom& g : canvas_->layerFollows(id))
3979 follows.push_back(mirrorX ? g.scale(-1.0, 1.0, center) : g.scale(1.0, -1.0, center));
3980 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, solids, follows);
3981 const auto it = gerberLayers_.find(id);
3982 if (it != gerberLayers_.end()) {
3983 it->second.solids = solids;
3984 it->second.follows = follows;
3985 it->second.solid = Geom::unionOf(solids);
3986 it->second.bounds = it->second.solid.valid() ? it->second.solid.bounds() : BBox{};
3987 }
3988 refreshProperties();
3989 return true;
3990}

4154/// @brief Adaptador Tcl del comando `rings`.
4155int MainWindow::tclRings(const QString& name, bool holes) {
4156 QTreeWidgetItem* item = findObjectByName(name);
4157 if (!item) return -1;
4158 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
4159 const auto it = gerberLayers_.find(id);
4160 Geom source;
4161 if (it != gerberLayers_.end()) source = it->second.solid;
4162 else source = Geom::unionOf(canvas_->layerSolids(id));
4163 if (!source.valid() || source.empty()) return -1;
4164 std::vector<Geom> rings;
4165 for (const PolygonContours& pc : source.polygons()) {
4166 if (!holes && pc.outer.size() >= 3) rings.push_back(Geom::polygon(pc.outer));
4167 if (holes)
4168 for (const Ring& h : pc.holes)
4169 if (h.size() >= 3) rings.push_back(Geom::polygon(h));
4170 }
4171 if (rings.empty()) return -1;
4172 const QString outName = name + (holes ? "_interiors" : "_exteriors");
4173 const int newId = addGeneratedSolid(outName, rings, id, "geometry");
4174 return newId > 0 ? static_cast<int>(rings.size()) : -1;
4175}

4289/// @brief Convierte las tablas de herramientas entre mm y pulgadas.
4290void MainWindow::convertToolTableUnits(bool toInch) {
4291 const double factor = toInch ? 1.0 / 25.4 : 25.4;
4292 const int decimals = toInch ? 7 : 3;
4293 for (QTableWidget* table : {isoTable_, nccTable_, cutTable_, paintTable_, drillTable_}) {
4294 if (!table) continue;
4295 for (int row = 0; row < table->rowCount(); ++row) {
4296 for (int column : {1, 6, 7}) {
4297 if (auto* item = table->item(row, column)) {
4298 bool ok = false;
4299 const double v = parseNumberText(item->text(), &ok);
4300 if (ok) item->setText(QString::number(v * factor, 'f', decimals));
4301 }
4302 }
4303 }
4304 table->setColumnWidth(1, toInch ? 78 : 42);
4305 table->setColumnWidth(6, toInch ? 84 : 50);
4306 table->setColumnWidth(7, toInch ? 84 : 48);
4307 }
4308}

4333/// @brief Adaptador Tcl del comando `subtractshape`.
4334bool MainWindow::tclSubtractShape(const QString& name, const std::vector<double>& coords,
4335 bool rectangle) {
4336 QTreeWidgetItem* item = findObjectByName(name);
4337 if (!item) return false;
4338 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
4339 const Geom source = Geom::unionOf(canvas_->layerSolids(id));
4340 if (!source.valid() || source.empty()) return false;
4341 Geom cutter;
4342 if (rectangle) {
4343 if (coords.size() < 4) return false;
4344 cutter = Geom::box(std::min(coords[0], coords[2]), std::min(coords[1], coords[3]),
4345 std::max(coords[0], coords[2]), std::max(coords[1], coords[3]));
4346 } else {
4347 if (coords.size() < 6 || coords.size() % 2 != 0) return false;
4348 Ring ring;
4349 for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 1 < coords.size(); i += 2)
4350 ring.push_back({coords[i], coords[i + 1]});
4351 cutter = Geom::polygon(ring).fixed();
4352 }
4353 const Geom result = source.difference(cutter);
4354 if (!result.valid() || result.empty()) return false;
4355 addGeneratedSolid(name + "_sub", {result}, id, "geometry");
4356 return true;
4357}

4372/// @brief Adaptador Tcl del comando `aligndrill`.
4373bool MainWindow::tclAlignDrill(const QString& name, const QString& reference) {
4374 QTreeWidgetItem* item = findObjectByName(name);
4375 if (!item) return false;
4376 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
4377 auto it = excellonLayers_.find(id);
4378 if (it == excellonLayers_.end()) return false;
4379 QTreeWidgetItem* ref = reference.isEmpty() ? nullptr : findObjectByName(reference);
4380 BBox target;
4381 if (ref) target = canvas_->layerBounds(ref->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt());
4382 if (!target.valid) {
4383 for (const auto& [gid, gerber] : gerberLayers_) {
4384 (void)gid;
4385 if (gerber.bounds.valid) { target = gerber.bounds; break; }
4386 }
4387 }
4388 if (!target.valid) return false;
4389 const BBox b = it->second.bounds;
4390 if (!b.valid) return false;
4391 const double dx = target.xmin - b.xmin;
4392 const double dy = target.ymin - b.ymin;
4393 for (auto& [number, tool] : it->second.tools) {
4394 (void)number;
4395 for (Pt& hole : tool.drills) { hole.x += dx; hole.y += dy; }
4396 for (auto& [a, c] : tool.slotSegments) {
4397 a.x += dx; a.y += dy; c.x += dx; c.y += dy;
4398 }
4399 for (Geom& g : tool.geometry) g = g.translate(dx, dy);
4400 }
4401 for (Geom& g : it->second.geometry) g = g.translate(dx, dy);
4402 it->second.solid = Geom::unionOf(it->second.geometry);
4403 it->second.bounds = it->second.solid.valid() ? it->second.solid.bounds() : BBox{};
4404 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, it->second.geometry, {});
4405 lastExcellon_ = it->second;
4406 lastDrillJob_ = drillJobFromExcellon(it->second);
4407 refreshProperties();
4408 return true;
4409}
4410
4411/// @brief Adaptador Tcl del comando `aligndrillgrid`.
4412bool MainWindow::tclAlignDrillGrid(const QString& name, double grid) {
4413 if (grid <= 0.0) return false;
4414 QTreeWidgetItem* item = findObjectByName(name);
4415 if (!item) return false;
4416 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
4417 auto it = excellonLayers_.find(id);
4418 if (it == excellonLayers_.end()) return false;
4419 std::vector<Geom> geometry;
4420 for (auto& [number, tool] : it->second.tools) {
4421 (void)number;
4422 for (Pt& hole : tool.drills) {
4423 hole.x = std::round(hole.x / grid) * grid;
4424 hole.y = std::round(hole.y / grid) * grid;
4425 geometry.push_back(Geom::circle(hole, tool.diameter / 2.0, stepsPerCircle_));
4426 }
4427 for (const auto& [a, b] : tool.slotSegments)
4428 geometry.push_back(Geom::line({{a.x, a.y}, {b.x, b.y}})
4429 .buffer(tool.diameter / 2.0, 16));
4430 }
4431 it->second.geometry = geometry;
4432 it->second.solid = Geom::unionOf(geometry);
4433 it->second.bounds = it->second.solid.valid() ? it->second.solid.bounds() : BBox{};
4434 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, geometry, {});
4435 lastExcellon_ = it->second;
4436 lastDrillJob_ = drillJobFromExcellon(it->second);
4437 refreshProperties();
4438 return true;
4439}

4441/// @brief Adaptador Tcl del comando `createcncjob`.
4442bool MainWindow::tclCreateCncJob(const QString& name, bool drillJob) {
4443 GCodeOptions opt;
4444 opt.units = defaultUnits_;
4445 std::string code;
4446 if (drillJob) {
4447 if (!lastExcellon_) return false;
4448 code = drillingGCode(drillJobFromExcellon(*lastExcellon_), opt);
4449 } else {
4450 if (!lastGerber_) return false;
4451 PathJob job;
4452 job.bounds = lastGerber_->bounds;
4453 for (const Geom& g : lastGerber_->follows) {
4454 Ring ring = g.coords();
4455 if (ring.size() >= 2) job.paths.emplace_back(ring.begin(), ring.end());
4456 }
4457 if (job.paths.empty()) return false;
4458 code = pathsGCode(job, opt);
4459 }
4460 addCncJobObject(name.isEmpty() ? tr("CNCJob") : name, QString::fromStdString(code));
4461 return true;
4462}
4463
4464/// @brief Adaptador Tcl del comando `milldrills`.
4465bool MainWindow::tclMillDrills(const QString& name, double diameter) {
4466 if (!lastExcellon_ || diameter <= 0.0) return false;
4467 PathJob job;
4468 job.toolDiameter = diameter;
4469 BBox bounds;
4470 for (const auto& [number, tool] : lastExcellon_->tools) {
4471 (void)number;
4472 for (const Pt& hole : tool.drills) {
4473 const double radius = tool.diameter / 2.0 + diameter / 2.0;
4474 std::vector<Pt> ring;
4475 for (int i = 0; i < 32; ++i) {
4476 const double a = 2.0 * M_PI * i / 32.0;
4477 ring.push_back({hole.x + radius * std::cos(a), hole.y + radius * std::sin(a)});
4478 }
4479 job.paths.push_back(ring);
4480 if (!bounds.valid) bounds = BBox{hole.x - radius, hole.y - radius,
4481 hole.x + radius, hole.y + radius};
4482 }
4483 }
4484 if (job.paths.empty()) return false;
4485 job.bounds = bounds;
4486 GCodeOptions opt;
4487 opt.units = defaultUnits_;
4488 addCncJobObject(name.isEmpty() ? tr("Mill drills") : name,
4489 QString::fromStdString(pathsGCode(job, opt)));
4490 return true;
4491}
4492
4493/// @brief Adaptador Tcl del comando `millslots`.
4494bool MainWindow::tclMillSlots(const QString& name, double diameter) {
4495 if (!lastExcellon_ || diameter <= 0.0) return false;
4496 PathJob job;
4497 job.toolDiameter = diameter;
4498 for (const auto& [number, tool] : lastExcellon_->tools) {
4499 (void)number;
4500 for (const auto& [a, b] : tool.slotSegments) {
4501 const double radius = tool.diameter / 2.0 + diameter / 2.0;
4502 std::vector<Pt> ring;
4503 const double angle = std::atan2(b.y - a.y, b.x - a.x);
4504 for (int i = 0; i <= 16; ++i) {
4505 const double t = M_PI * i / 16.0;
4506 ring.push_back({b.x + radius * std::cos(angle + t),
4507 b.y + radius * std::sin(angle + t)});
4508 }
4509 for (int i = 0; i <= 16; ++i) {
4510 const double t = M_PI * i / 16.0;
4511 ring.push_back({a.x + radius * std::cos(angle + M_PI + t),
4512 a.y + radius * std::sin(angle + M_PI + t)});
4513 }
4514 job.paths.push_back(ring);
4515 }
4516 }
4517 if (job.paths.empty()) return false;
4518 GCodeOptions opt;
4519 opt.units = defaultUnits_;
4520 addCncJobObject(name.isEmpty() ? tr("Mill slots") : name,
4521 QString::fromStdString(pathsGCode(job, opt)));
4522 return true;
4523}

4542/// @brief Carga los temas de colores del visor desde QSettings.
4543void MainWindow::loadViewThemes() {
4544 QSettings settings;
4545 viewThemes_.clear();
4546 const QJsonDocument doc = QJsonDocument::fromJson(
4547 settings.value("preferences/viewThemes").toByteArray());
4548 if (doc.isArray()) {
4549 for (const QJsonValue& value : doc.array()) {
4550 const QJsonObject obj = value.toObject();
4551 ViewTheme theme;
4552 theme.name = obj.value("name").toString();
4553 theme.background = QColor(obj.value("background").toString());
4554 theme.copper = QColor(obj.value("copper").toString());
4555 theme.follow = QColor(obj.value("follow").toString());
4556 theme.toolpath = QColor(obj.value("toolpath").toString());
4557 theme.grid = QColor(obj.value("grid").toString());
4558 if (theme.name.isEmpty() || !theme.background.isValid()) continue;
4559 if (!theme.grid.isValid()) theme.grid = theme.background.lighter(130);
4560 viewThemes_.push_back(theme);
4561 }
4562 }
4563 if (viewThemes_.empty()) {
4564 viewThemes_ = defaultViewThemes();
4565 // Migración de los colores sueltos de versiones anteriores.
4566 if (settings.contains("preferences/bg") || settings.contains("preferences/copper")) {
4567 ViewTheme custom;
4568 custom.name = tr("Personalizado");
4569 custom.background = settings.value("preferences/bg", QColor("#101418")).value<QColor>();
4570 custom.copper = settings.value("preferences/copper", QColor("#d9a441")).value<QColor>();
4571 custom.follow = settings.value("preferences/follow", QColor("#6fa8dc")).value<QColor>();
4572 custom.toolpath = settings.value("preferences/toolpath", QColor("#66d684")).value<QColor>();
4573 custom.grid = custom.background.lighter(135);
4574 viewThemes_.push_back(custom);
4575 currentViewTheme_ = custom.name;
4576 }
4577 }
4578 QString selected = settings.value("preferences/viewTheme", currentViewTheme_).toString();
4579 int index = -1;
4580 for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(viewThemes_.size()); ++i) {
4581 if (viewThemes_[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)].name == selected) {
4582 index = i;
4583 break;
4584 }
4585 }
4586 if (index < 0) index = 0;
4587 applyViewTheme(viewThemes_[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)]);
4588}

4590/// @brief Sincroniza los colores actuales con el tema seleccionado.
4591void MainWindow::syncCurrentViewTheme() {
4592 for (ViewTheme& theme : viewThemes_) {

4594 theme.background = background_;
4595 theme.copper = copperColor_;
4596 theme.follow = followColor_;
4597 theme.toolpath = toolpathColor_;

4602/// @brief Guarda los temas y el seleccionado en QSettings.
4603void MainWindow::saveViewThemes() {
4604 if (viewThemes_.empty()) return;
4605 syncCurrentViewTheme();
4606 QJsonArray array;
4607 for (const ViewTheme& theme : viewThemes_) {
4608 QJsonObject obj;
4609 obj["name"] = theme.name;
4610 obj["background"] = theme.background.name();
4611 obj["copper"] = theme.copper.name();
4612 obj["follow"] = theme.follow.name();
4613 obj["toolpath"] = theme.toolpath.name();
4614 obj["grid"] = theme.grid.name();
4615 array.append(obj);
4616 }
4617 QSettings settings;
4618 settings.setValue("preferences/viewThemes",
4619 QJsonDocument(array).toJson(QJsonDocument::Compact));
4620 settings.setValue("preferences/viewTheme", currentViewTheme_);
4621 settings.setValue("preferences/bg", background_);
4622 settings.setValue("preferences/copper", copperColor_);
4623 settings.setValue("preferences/follow", followColor_);
4624 settings.setValue("preferences/toolpath", toolpathColor_);
4625}

4691
4692 std::vector<ViewTheme> themes = viewThemes_;
