7376/// @brief Agrega un programa G-code al visor.
7377bool MainWindow::addGCodeLayer(const QString& path) {
7378 QFile file(path);
7379 if (!file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
7380 showError(tr("No se pudo abrir %1").arg(path));
7381 return false;
7382 }
7383 std::vector<Geom> paths;
7384 Ring current;
7385 Pt pos{0.0, 0.0};
7386 bool absolute = true;
7387 bool cutting = false;
7388 int moves = 0;
7389
7390 auto flush = [&] {
7391 if (current.size() >= 2) paths.push_back(Geom::line(current));
7392 current.clear();
7393 };
7394
7395 while (!file.atEnd()) {
7396 QString line = QString::fromUtf8(file.readLine());
7397 line = line.section(';', 0, 0).section('(', 0, 0).trimmed();
7398 if (line.isEmpty()) continue;
7399 const QStringList words = line.split(QRegularExpression("\\s+"), Qt::SkipEmptyParts);
7400 bool hasG1 = false;
7401 bool hasG0 = false;
7402 std::optional<double> x;
7403 std::optional<double> y;
7404 for (const QString& raw : words) {
7405 const QString word = raw.toUpper();
7406 if (word == "G90") absolute = true;
7407 else if (word == "G91") absolute = false;
7408 else if (word == "G0" || word == "G00") hasG0 = true;
7409 else if (word == "G1" || word == "G01" || word == "G2" || word == "G02" ||
7410 word == "G3" || word == "G03") hasG1 = true;
7411 else if (word.startsWith("X")) x = word.mid(1).toDouble();
7412 else if (word.startsWith("Y")) y = word.mid(1).toDouble();
7413 }
7414 if (!hasG0 && !hasG1 && !x && !y) continue;
7415 const Pt target{(x ? (absolute ? *x : pos.x + *x) : pos.x),
7416 (y ? (absolute ? *y : pos.y + *y) : pos.y)};
7417 const bool rapid = hasG0;
7418 if (rapid) {
7419 flush();
7420 pos = target;
7421 cutting = false;
7422 continue;
7423 }
7424 if (current.empty()) current.push_back(pos);
7425 current.push_back(target);
7426 pos = target;
7427 cutting = true;
7428 ++moves;
7429 if (moves % 2000 == 0) QApplication::processEvents();
7430 }
7431 flush();
7432 if (paths.empty()) {
7433 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Abrir G-code"),
7434 tr("El archivo no contiene movimientos lineales G0/G1."));
7435 return false;
7436 }
7437 const int id = canvas_->appendGeometry({}, paths, true);
7438 canvas_->endGeometry();
7439 addObjectRow(QFileInfo(path).fileName(), "gcode", "-", id, true, toolsGroup_);
7440 sourcePaths_[id] = path;
7441 if (toolsGroup_) toolsGroup_->setExpanded(true);
7442 refreshSourceCombos();
7443 if (!canvas_->hasData()) canvas_->fitTo(canvas_->layerBounds(id));
7444 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("G-code cargado: %1 recorridos").arg(paths.size()), 5000);
7445 return true;
7446}
7447
7448/// @brief Asistente de importación Excellon + tabla INF.
7449void MainWindow::pcbWizardImport() {
7450 const QString excellonPath = QFileDialog::getOpenFileName(
7451 this, tr("PcbWizard: archivo Excellon"), lastDir_,
7452 tr("Excellon (*.drl *.xln *.exc *.ncd);;Todos (*)"));
7453 if (excellonPath.isEmpty()) return;
7454 const QString infPath = QFileDialog::getOpenFileName(
7455 this, tr("PcbWizard: archivo INF"), QFileInfo(excellonPath).absolutePath(),
7456 tr("PcbWizard INF (*.INF *.inf);;Todos (*)"));
7457 if (infPath.isEmpty()) return;
7458 try {
7459 fc::ExcellonOptions opt;
7460 opt.appUnits = defaultUnits_;
7461 opt.stepsPerCircle = stepsPerCircle_;
7462 fc::ExcellonResult result = fc::ExcellonParser(opt).parseFile(excellonPath.toStdString());
7463
7464 QFile inf(infPath);
7465 if (!inf.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
7466 showError(tr("No se pudo abrir el INF."));
7467 return;
7468 }
7469 QHash<int, double> diameters;
7470 bool inch = result.fileUnits == Units::Inch;
7471 const QRegularExpression toolRe(R"(^T(\d+)\s+(\d*\.?\d+)$)");
7472 const QRegularExpression formatRe(
7473 R"(^(\d+)\.?(\d+)\s*format,\s*(inches|metric)?,\s*(absolute|incremental)?.*$)",
7474 QRegularExpression::CaseInsensitiveOption);
7475 while (!inf.atEnd()) {
7476 const QString line = QString::fromUtf8(inf.readLine()).trimmed();
7477 auto match = toolRe.match(line);
7478 if (match.hasMatch()) {
7479 diameters[match.captured(1).toInt()] = match.captured(2).toDouble();
7480 continue;
7481 }
7482 match = formatRe.match(line);
7483 if (match.hasMatch())
7484 inch = match.captured(3).compare("inches", Qt::CaseInsensitive) == 0;
7485 }
7486 if (diameters.isEmpty()) {
7487 QMessageBox::warning(this, tr("PcbWizard"),
7488 tr("El INF no contiene herramientas Tn con diámetro."));
7489 return;
7490 }
7491 int applied = 0;
7492 for (auto& [number, tool] : result.tools) {
7493 const auto found = diameters.find(number);
7494 if (found == diameters.end()) continue;
7495 double dia = found.value();
7496 if (inch && defaultUnits_ == Units::Mm) dia *= 25.4;
7497 tool.diameter = dia;
7498 tool.diameterKnown = true;
7499 ++applied;
7500 }
7501 if (applied == 0) {
7502 QMessageBox::warning(this, tr("PcbWizard"),
7503 tr("Ninguna herramienta del INF coincide con el Excellon."));
7504 return;
7505 }
7506 std::vector<Geom> geometry;
7507 for (const auto& [number, tool] : result.tools) {
7508 for (const Pt& hole : tool.drills)
7509 geometry.push_back(Geom::circle(hole, tool.diameter / 2.0, stepsPerCircle_));
7510 for (const auto& [a, b] : tool.slotSegments)
7511 geometry.push_back(Geom::line({{a.x, a.y}, {b.x, b.y}})
7512 .buffer(tool.diameter / 2.0, 16));
7513 }
7514 result.geometry = geometry;
7515 result.solid = geometry.empty() ? Geom() : Geom::unionOf(geometry);
7516 result.bounds = result.solid.valid() ? result.solid.bounds() : BBox{};
7517
7518 const int id = canvas_->appendGeometry(result.geometry, {}, true);
7519 canvas_->endGeometry();
7520 addObjectRow(QFileInfo(excellonPath).fileName(), "excellon",
7521 QString::number(result.solid.area(), 'f', 2), id);
7522 excellonLayers_[id] = result;
7523 lastExcellon_ = result;
7524 lastDrillJob_ = drillJobFromExcellon(result);
7525 refreshDrillTable();
7526 if (!canvas_->hasData()) canvas_->fitTo(canvas_->layerBounds(id));
7527 statusBar()->showMessage(
7528 tr("PcbWizard: %1 herramientas, %2 taladros").arg(applied).arg(result.drillCount),
7529 6000);
7530 refreshObjectToolPage();
7531 } catch (const std::exception& e) {
7532 showError(QString::fromUtf8(e.what()));
7533 }
7534}
7535
7536/// @brief Carga una tabla `.INF` de herramientas.
7537void MainWindow::loadInfFile() {
7538 auto* item = objects_->currentItem();
7539 if (!item) {
7540 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Tabla INF"),
7541 tr("Seleccioná el objeto Excellon al que aplicar la tabla."));
7542 return;
7543 }
7544 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
7545 auto it = excellonLayers_.find(id);
7546 if (it == excellonLayers_.end()) {
7547 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Tabla INF"),
7548 tr("El objeto seleccionado no es un Excellon."));
7549 return;
7550 }
7551 const QString path = QFileDialog::getOpenFileName(
7552 this, tr("Cargar tabla INF"), lastDir_, tr("PcbWizard INF (*.INF *.inf);;Todos (*)"));
7553 if (path.isEmpty()) return;
7554 QFile file(path);
7555 if (!file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
7556 QMessageBox::warning(this, tr("Tabla INF"), tr("No se pudo abrir el archivo."));
7557 return;
7558 }
7559 ExcellonResult result = it->second;
7560 QHash<int, double> diameters;
7561 bool inch = result.fileUnits == Units::Inch;
7562 const QRegularExpression toolRe(R"(^T(\d+)\s+(\d*\.?\d+)$)");
7563 const QRegularExpression formatRe(
7564 R"(^(\d+)\.?(\d+)\s*format,\s*(inches|metric)?,\s*(absolute|incremental)?.*$)",
7565 QRegularExpression::CaseInsensitiveOption);
7566 while (!file.atEnd()) {
7567 const QString line = QString::fromUtf8(file.readLine()).trimmed();
7568 auto match = toolRe.match(line);
7569 if (match.hasMatch()) {
7570 diameters[match.captured(1).toInt()] = match.captured(2).toDouble();
7571 continue;
7572 }
7573 match = formatRe.match(line);
7574 if (match.hasMatch()) {
7575 inch = match.captured(3).compare("inches", Qt::CaseInsensitive) == 0;
7576 }
7577 }
7578 if (diameters.isEmpty()) {
7579 QMessageBox::warning(this, tr("Tabla INF"),
7580 tr("El archivo no contiene una tabla de herramientas T<n> <diámetro>."));
7581 return;
7582 }
7583 int applied = 0;
7584 for (auto& [number, tool] : result.tools) {
7585 const auto found = diameters.find(number);
7586 if (found == diameters.end()) continue;
7587 double dia = found.value();
7588 if (inch && defaultUnits_ == Units::Mm) dia *= 25.4;
7589 tool.diameter = dia;
7590 tool.diameterKnown = true;
7591 ++applied;
7592 }
7593 if (applied == 0) {
7594 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Tabla INF"),
7595 tr("Ninguna herramienta del archivo coincide con el Excellon."));
7596 return;
7597 }
7598
7599 // Rebuild the hole geometry with the corrected diameters.
7600 std::vector<Geom> geometry;
7601 for (const auto& [number, tool] : result.tools) {
7602 for (const Pt& hole : tool.drills) {
7603 geometry.push_back(Geom::circle(hole, tool.diameter / 2.0, stepsPerCircle_));
7604 }
7605 for (const auto& [a, b] : tool.slotSegments) {
7606 geometry.push_back(Geom::line({{a.x, a.y}, {b.x, b.y}})
7607 .buffer(tool.diameter / 2.0, 16));
7608 }
7609 }
7610 result.geometry = geometry;
7611 result.solid = geometry.empty() ? Geom() : Geom::unionOf(geometry);
7612 result.bounds = result.solid.valid() ? result.solid.bounds() : BBox{};
7613
7614 excellonLayers_[id] = result;
7615 if (lastExcellon_ && canvas_->layerIds().size() && !canvas_->layerIds().empty()) {
7616 // Keep the "last" object usable from the Tcl/JS API.
7617 lastExcellon_ = result;
7618 }
7619 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, geometry, {});
7620 lastDrillJob_ = drillJobFromExcellon(result);
7621 refreshDrillTable();
7622 refreshProperties();
7623 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Tabla INF aplicada: %1 herramientas").arg(applied), 5000);
7624}

7638 : importDxf(path.toStdString());
7639 const std::vector<Geom> texts =
7640 svg ? svgTextGeometry(path) : dxfTextGeometry(path);
7641 geoms.insert(geoms.end(), texts.begin(), texts.end());
7642 addVectorGeometry(QFileInfo(path).fileName(), geoms);

7650/// @brief Convierte geometría importada en una capa Gerber.
7651void MainWindow::addVectorGeometry(const QString& name, const std::vector<Geom>& geoms) {
7652 if (geoms.empty()) {
7653 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Importar"), tr("El archivo no tiene geometría."));
7654 return;
7655 }
7656 std::vector<Geom> solids;
7657 std::vector<Geom> follows;
7658 for (const Geom& g : geoms) {
7659 if (!g.valid() || g.empty()) continue;
7660 const Geom geometry = geometrySimplify_
7661 ? g.simplify(geometryTolerance_).fixed()
7662 : g;
7663 const int type = geometry.typeId();
7664 if (type == GEOS_POLYGON || type == GEOS_MULTIPOLYGON) solids.push_back(geometry);
7665 else follows.push_back(geometry);
7666 }
7667 const int id = canvas_->appendGeometry(solids, follows, true);
7668 canvas_->endGeometry();
7669 addObjectRow(name, "gerber", QString::number(Geom::unionOf(solids).area(), 'f', 2), id);
7670 GerberResult r;
7671 r.solids = solids;
7672 r.follows = follows;
7673 r.solid = solids.empty() ? Geom() : Geom::unionOf(solids);
7674 r.bounds = r.solid.valid() ? r.solid.bounds() : BBox{};
7675 r.fileUnits = defaultUnits_;
7676 gerberLayers_[id] = r;
7677 lastGerber_ = r;
7678 if (!canvas_->hasData()) canvas_->fitTo(canvas_->layerBounds(id));
7679 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Importado: %1 objetos").arg(geoms.size()), 5000);
7680}

7696/// @brief Importa un PDF vectorial o rasterizado.
7697bool MainWindow::importPdfPath(const QString& path) {
7698 try {
7699 const std::vector<Geom> geoms = fc::importPdfVector(path.toStdString());
7700 if (!geoms.empty()) {
7701 addVectorGeometry(QFileInfo(path).fileName(), geoms);
7702 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("PDF vectorial importado: %1 objetos")
7703 .arg(geoms.size()), 5000);
7704 return true;
7705 }
7706 } catch (const std::exception&) {
7707 // Fall through to the raster conversion below.
7708 }
7709#ifdef __APPLE__
7710 QVector<QSizeF> pageSizes;
7711 const QVector<QImage> pages = renderPdfPages(path, 200, &pageSizes);
7712 if (!pages.isEmpty()) {
7713 for (int i = 0; i < pages.size(); ++i) {
7714 const double widthMm = i < pageSizes.size() ? pageSizes[i].width() : 200.0;
7715 addImageGeometry(pages[i], tr("%1 p%2").arg(QFileInfo(path).baseName()).arg(i + 1),
7716 widthMm, 128, false);
7717 }
7718 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("PDF importado: %1 páginas").arg(pages.size()), 5000);
7719 return true;
7720 }
7721#endif
7722 return false;
7723}

7729/// @brief Abre el diálogo de importación de PDF.
7730void MainWindow::importPdfFile() {
7731 const QString path = QFileDialog::getOpenFileName(
7732 this, tr("Importar PDF"), lastDir_, tr("PDF (*.pdf);;Todos (*)"));
7733 if (path.isEmpty()) return;
7734 if (importPdfPath(path)) {
7735 recordRecent(path);
7736 return;
7737 }
7738 const QString temp = QDir::tempPath() + "/flatcam_pdf_import.png";
7739 QProcess process;
7740 process.start("/usr/bin/sips", {"-s", "format", "png", path, "--out", temp});
7741 if (!process.waitForFinished(30000) || process.exitCode() != 0) {
7742 showError(tr("No se pudo convertir el PDF a imagen."));
7743 return;
7744 }
7745 QImage image(temp);
7746 QFile::remove(temp);
7747 if (image.isNull()) {
7748 showError(tr("No se pudo leer el PDF convertido."));
7749 return;
7750 }
7751 bool ok = false;
7752 const QString unit = displayInch_ ? "in" : "mm";
7753 const double width = lengthToMm(QInputDialog::getDouble(
7754 this, tr("Importar PDF"), tr("Ancho de la página (%1):").arg(unit),
7755 displayLength(200.0), displayLength(1.0), displayLength(2000.0),
7756 displayInch_ ? 5 : 2, &ok));
7757 if (!ok) return;
7758 addImageGeometry(image, QFileInfo(path).baseName(), width, 128, false);
7759}

7843/// @brief Importa una imagen y la vectoriza.
7844void MainWindow::importImage() {
7845 const QString path = QFileDialog::getOpenFileName(
7846 this, tr("Importar imagen"), lastDir_,
7847 tr("Imágenes (*.png *.jpg *.jpeg *.bmp *.gif *.tif *.tiff);;Todos (*)"));
7848 if (path.isEmpty()) return;
7849 QImage image(path);
7850 if (image.isNull()) {
7851 QMessageBox::warning(this, tr("Importar imagen"), tr("No se pudo leer la imagen."));
7852 return;
7853 }
7854 image = image.convertToFormat(QImage::Format_Grayscale8);
7855 while (image.width() > 320 || image.height() > 320) {
7856 image = image.scaled(image.width() / 2, image.height() / 2, Qt::KeepAspectRatio,
7857 Qt::SmoothTransformation);
7858 }
7859
7860 QDialog dialog(this);
7861 dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("Importar imagen"));
7862 auto* form = new QFormLayout(&dialog);
7863 auto* width = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
7864 width->setRange(1.0, 1000.0);
7865 width->setDecimals(2);
7866 width->setValue(50.0);
7867 width->setSuffix(" mm");
7868 auto* threshold = new QSpinBox(&dialog);
7869 threshold->setRange(0, 255);
7870 threshold->setValue(128);
7871 auto* invert = new QCheckBox(tr("Invertir (blanco = cobre)"), &dialog);
7872 auto* colorMode = new QComboBox(&dialog);
7873 colorMode->addItems({tr("Blanco y negro"), tr("Color")});
7874 auto* colorButton = new QPushButton(tr("Color objetivo"), &dialog);
7875 QColor targetColor = Qt::black;
7876 colorButton->setStyleSheet("background:#000000; color:white;");
7877 auto* colorTolerance = new QSpinBox(&dialog);
7878 colorTolerance->setRange(0, 765);
7879 colorTolerance->setValue(60);
7880 auto* maskEnabled = new QCheckBox(tr("Máscara de color"), &dialog);
7881 auto* maskButton = new QPushButton(tr("Color de máscara"), &dialog);
7882 QColor maskColor = Qt::white;
7883 maskButton->setStyleSheet("background:#ffffff; color:black;");
7884 auto* maskTolerance = new QSpinBox(&dialog);
7885 maskTolerance->setRange(0, 765);
7886 maskTolerance->setValue(30);
7887 connect(maskButton, &QPushButton::clicked, &dialog, [&] {
7888 const QColor chosen = QColorDialog::getColor(maskColor, &dialog, tr("Color de máscara"));
7889 if (!chosen.isValid()) return;
7890 maskColor = chosen;
7891 maskButton->setStyleSheet(QString("background:%1; color:%2;")
7892 .arg(chosen.name(),
7893 chosen.lightness() > 128 ? "black" : "white"));
7894 });
7895 connect(colorButton, &QPushButton::clicked, &dialog, [&] {
7896 const QColor chosen = QColorDialog::getColor(targetColor, &dialog, tr("Color objetivo"));
7897 if (!chosen.isValid()) return;
7898 targetColor = chosen;
7899 colorButton->setStyleSheet(QString("background:%1; color:%2;")
7900 .arg(chosen.name(),
7901 chosen.lightness() > 128 ? "black" : "white"));
7902 });
7903 auto* dpi = new QSpinBox(&dialog);
7904 dpi->setRange(1, 2400);
7905 dpi->setValue(96);
7906 auto* useDpi = new QCheckBox(tr("Calcular ancho desde DPI"), &dialog);
7907 connect(useDpi, &QCheckBox::toggled, width, [width](bool on) { width->setEnabled(!on); });
7908 auto* preview = new QLabel(&dialog);
7909 preview->setPixmap(QPixmap::fromImage(image));
7910 form->addRow(tr("Ancho:"), width);
7911 form->addRow(tr("DPI:"), dpi);
7912 form->addRow(QString(), useDpi);
7913 form->addRow(tr("Modo:"), colorMode);
7914 form->addRow(tr("Color:"), colorButton);
7915 form->addRow(tr("Tolerancia color:"), colorTolerance);
7916 form->addRow(QString(), maskEnabled);
7917 form->addRow(tr("Máscara:"), maskButton);
7918 form->addRow(tr("Tolerancia máscara:"), maskTolerance);
7919 form->addRow(tr("Umbral:"), threshold);
7920 form->addRow(QString(), invert);
7921 form->addRow(preview);
7922 auto* box = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::Ok | QDialogButtonBox::Cancel, &dialog);
7923 form->addRow(box);
7924 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::accepted, &dialog, &QDialog::accept);
7925 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &dialog, &QDialog::reject);
7926 if (dialog.exec() != QDialog::Accepted) return;
7927
7928 const double widthMm = useDpi->isChecked()
7929 ? image.width() * 25.4 / std::max(1, dpi->value())
7930 : width->value();
7931 addImageGeometry(image, QFileInfo(path).baseName(), widthMm, threshold->value(),
7932 invert->isChecked(), colorMode->currentIndex() == 1, targetColor,
7933 colorTolerance->value(), maskEnabled->isChecked(), maskColor,
7934 maskTolerance->value());
7935}

7937/// @brief Convierte una imagen en capa de cobre.
7938void MainWindow::addImageGeometry(const QImage& image, const QString& name, double widthMm,
7939 int threshold, bool invert, bool colorMode,
7940 const QColor& target, int tolerance,
7941 bool maskEnabled, const QColor& maskColor,
7942 int maskTolerance) {
7943 if (image.isNull() || image.width() <= 0) return;
7944 QImage work = image;
7945 if (work.format() != QImage::Format_Grayscale8)
7946 work = work.convertToFormat(QImage::Format_Grayscale8);
7947 while (work.width() > 480 || work.height() > 480) {
7948 work = work.scaled(work.width() / 2, work.height() / 2, Qt::KeepAspectRatio,
7949 Qt::SmoothTransformation);
7950 }
7951 const double pixel = widthMm / work.width();
7952 std::vector<Geom> rects;
7953 rects.reserve(static_cast<std::size_t>(work.width() * work.height() / 4));
7954 for (int y = 0; y < work.height(); ++y) {
7955 int start = -1;
7956 const double yb = (work.height() - y - 1) * pixel;
7957 for (int x = 0; x <= work.width(); ++x) {
7958 bool on = false;
7959 if (x < work.width()) {
7960 if (colorMode) {
7961 const QColor pixel = work.pixelColor(x, y);
7962 const int distance = std::abs(pixel.red() - target.red()) +
7963 std::abs(pixel.green() - target.green()) +
7964 std::abs(pixel.blue() - target.blue());
7965 on = distance <= tolerance;
7966 if (invert) on = !on;
7967 } else {
7968 const int gray = qGray(work.pixel(x, y));
7969 on = invert ? gray > threshold : gray < threshold;
7970 }
7971 if (on && maskEnabled) {
7972 const QColor pixel = work.pixelColor(x, y);
7973 const int distance = std::abs(pixel.red() - maskColor.red()) +
7974 std::abs(pixel.green() - maskColor.green()) +
7975 std::abs(pixel.blue() - maskColor.blue());
7976 if (distance <= maskTolerance) on = false;
7977 }
7978 }
7979 if (on && start < 0) start = x;
7980 if (!on && start >= 0) {
7981 rects.push_back(Geom::box(start * pixel, yb, x * pixel, yb + pixel));
7982 start = -1;
7983 }
7984 }
7985 }
7986 if (rects.empty()) {
7987 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Importar imagen"),
7988 tr("La imagen no tiene píxeles dentro del umbral."));
7989 return;
7990 }
7991 const Geom united = Geom::unionOf(rects);
7992 const int id = addGeneratedSolid(name, {united}, 0, "gerber");
7993 if (id > 0) {
7994 GerberResult r;
7995 r.solids = {united};
7996 r.solid = united;
7997 r.bounds = united.bounds();
7998 r.fileUnits = defaultUnits_;
7999 gerberLayers_[id] = r;
8000 lastGerber_ = r;
8001 refreshSourceCombos();
8002 }
8003 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Imagen importada: %1 polígonos").arg(united.numGeometries()), 5000);
8004}

8025/// @brief Comprueba reglas de diseño (traza, taladro, anillo...).
8026void MainWindow::rulesCheck() {
8027 QDialog dialog(this);
8028 dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("Comprobar reglas"));
8029 auto* layout = new QVBoxLayout(&dialog);
8030 auto* form = new QFormLayout();
8031 auto* clearance = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
8032 clearance->setRange(0.0, 10.0);
8033 clearance->setDecimals(3);
8034 clearance->setValue(0.2);
8035 clearance->setSuffix(" mm");
8036 auto* traceCheck = new QCheckBox(tr("Ancho mínimo de traza"), &dialog);
8037 auto* traceMin = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
8038 traceMin->setRange(0.0, 10.0);
8039 traceMin->setDecimals(3);
8040 traceMin->setValue(0.15);
8041 traceMin->setSuffix(" mm");
8042 auto* holeCheck = new QCheckBox(tr("Diámetro mínimo de taladro"), &dialog);
8043 auto* holeMin = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
8044 holeMin->setRange(0.0, 10.0);
8045 holeMin->setDecimals(3);
8046 holeMin->setValue(0.3);
8047 holeMin->setSuffix(" mm");
8048 auto* holeCopperCheck = new QCheckBox(tr("Clearance taladro-cobre"), &dialog);
8049 auto* holeCopperMin = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
8050 holeCopperMin->setRange(0.0, 10.0);
8051 holeCopperMin->setDecimals(3);
8052 holeCopperMin->setValue(0.2);
8053 holeCopperMin->setSuffix(" mm");
8054 auto* holeClearCheck = new QCheckBox(tr("Separación entre taladros"), &dialog);
8055 auto* holeClearMin = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
8056 holeClearMin->setRange(0.0, 10.0);
8057 holeClearMin->setDecimals(3);
8058 holeClearMin->setValue(0.3);
8059 holeClearMin->setSuffix(" mm");
8060 auto* ringCheck = new QCheckBox(tr("Anillo anular mínimo"), &dialog);
8061 auto* ringMin = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
8062 ringMin->setRange(0.0, 10.0);
8063 ringMin->setDecimals(3);
8064 ringMin->setValue(0.15);
8065 ringMin->setSuffix(" mm");
8066 traceCheck->setChecked(true);
8067 holeCheck->setChecked(true);
8068 ringCheck->setChecked(false);
8069 form->addRow(tr("Separación mínima:"), clearance);
8070 form->addRow(traceCheck, traceMin);
8071 form->addRow(holeCheck, holeMin);
8072 form->addRow(holeCopperCheck, holeCopperMin);
8073 form->addRow(holeClearCheck, holeClearMin);
8074 form->addRow(ringCheck, ringMin);
8075 layout->addLayout(form);
8076 auto* table = new QTableWidget(0, 4, &dialog);
8077 table->setHorizontalHeaderLabels({tr("Objeto"), tr("Regla"), tr("Valor"), tr("Estado")});
8078 table->horizontalHeader()->setStretchLastSection(true);
8079 table->verticalHeader()->setVisible(false);
8080 layout->addWidget(table);
8081 auto* run = new QPushButton(tr("Comprobar"), &dialog);
8082 layout->addWidget(run);
8083 auto* box = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::Close, &dialog);
8084 layout->addWidget(box);
8085 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &dialog, &QDialog::reject);
8086
8087 connect(run, &QPushButton::clicked, this,
8088 [this, table, clearance, traceCheck, traceMin, holeCheck, holeMin,
8089 holeCopperCheck, holeCopperMin, holeClearCheck, holeClearMin, ringCheck, ringMin] {
8090 table->setRowCount(0);
8091 auto addResult = [table](const QString& object, const QString& rule, double value,
8092 bool violation) {
8093 const int row = table->rowCount();
8094 table->insertRow(row);
8095 table->setItem(row, 0, new QTableWidgetItem(object));
8096 table->setItem(row, 1, new QTableWidgetItem(rule));
8097 table->setItem(row, 2, new QTableWidgetItem(
8098 QString::number(value, 'f', 4) + " mm"));
8099 auto* status = new QTableWidgetItem(violation ? tr("Violación") : tr("OK"));
8100 status->setForeground(violation ? QColor(180, 40, 40) : QColor(40, 140, 60));
8101 table->setItem(row, 3, status);
8102 };
8103
8104 const auto items = objectItems();
8105 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < items.size(); ++i) {
8106 const int idA = items[i]->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
8107 const QString kindA = items[i]->text(2).toLower();
8108 if (kindA != "gerber" && kindA != "excellon") continue;
8109 const auto ga = layerGeometries(idA);
8110 if (ga.empty()) continue;
8111 for (std::size_t j = i + 1; j < items.size(); ++j) {
8112 const int idB = items[j]->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
8113 const QString kindB = items[j]->text(2).toLower();
8114 if (kindB != "gerber" && kindB != "excellon") continue;
8115 const auto gb = layerGeometries(idB);
8116 if (gb.empty()) continue;
8117 const double d = layersDistance(ga, gb);
8118 if (d < 0.0) continue;
8119 if (d < clearance->value())
8120 addResult(items[i]->text(1) + " / " + items[j]->text(1),
8121 tr("Separación"), d, true);
8122 }
8123 }
8124
8125 for (QTreeWidgetItem* item : items) {
8126 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
8127 const QString kind = item->text(2).toLower();
8128 if (traceCheck->isChecked() && kind == "gerber") {
8129 const auto it = gerberLayers_.find(id);
8130 if (it != gerberLayers_.end()) {
8131 double minimum = -1.0;
8132 for (const auto& [code, aperture] : it->second.apertures) {
8133 if (aperture.kind != GerberAperture::Kind::Circle) continue;
8134 if (aperture.geometry.empty()) continue;
8135 const double size = aperture.size > 0.0 ? aperture.size : aperture.diameter;
8136 if (size <= 0.0) continue;
8137 if (minimum < 0.0 || size < minimum) minimum = size;
8138 }
8139 if (minimum > 0.0 && minimum < traceMin->value())
8140 addResult(item->text(1), tr("Ancho de traza"), minimum, true);
8141 }
8142 }
8143 if (holeCheck->isChecked() && kind == "excellon") {
8144 const auto it = excellonLayers_.find(id);
8145 if (it != excellonLayers_.end()) {
8146 double minimum = -1.0;
8147 for (const auto& [number, tool] : it->second.tools) {
8148 if (tool.drills.empty() && tool.slotSegments.empty()) continue;
8149 if (minimum < 0.0 || tool.diameter < minimum) minimum = tool.diameter;
8150 }
8151 if (minimum > 0.0 && minimum < holeMin->value())
8152 addResult(item->text(1), tr("Taladro"), minimum, true);
8153 }
8154 }
8155 if (holeCopperCheck->isChecked() && kind == "excellon") {
8156 const auto eit = excellonLayers_.find(id);
8157 if (eit != excellonLayers_.end()) {
8158 std::vector<Geom> copper;
8159 for (const auto& [gid, gerber] : gerberLayers_) {
8160 (void)gid;
8161 for (const PolygonContours& pc : gerber.solid.polygons()) {
8162 if (pc.outer.size() >= 3)
8163 copper.push_back(Geom::polygon(pc.outer, pc.holes));
8164 }
8165 }
8166 double minimum = 1e9;
8167 for (const auto& [number, tool] : eit->second.tools) {
8168 (void)number;
8169 for (const Pt& hole : tool.drills) {
8170 const Geom holePoint = Geom::point(hole.x, hole.y);
8171 const Geom holeCircle = Geom::circle(hole, tool.diameter / 2.0, 16);
8172 for (const Geom& poly : copper) {
8173 if (poly.intersects(holePoint)) continue;
8174 minimum = std::min(minimum, holeCircle.distance(poly));
8175 }
8176 }
8177 }
8178 if (minimum < 1e9 && minimum < holeCopperMin->value())
8179 addResult(item->text(1), tr("Clearance taladro-cobre"), minimum, true);
8180 }
8181 }
8182 if (holeClearCheck->isChecked() && kind == "excellon") {
8183 const auto eit = excellonLayers_.find(id);
8184 if (eit != excellonLayers_.end()) {
8185 std::vector<std::pair<Pt, double>> holes;
8186 for (const auto& [number, tool] : eit->second.tools) {
8187 (void)number;
8188 for (const Pt& hole : tool.drills)
8189 holes.push_back({hole, tool.diameter / 2.0});
8190 }
8191 double minimum = 1e9;
8192 for (std::size_t a = 0; a < holes.size(); ++a) {
8193 for (std::size_t b = a + 1; b < holes.size(); ++b) {
8194 const double d = std::hypot(holes[a].first.x - holes[b].first.x,
8195 holes[a].first.y - holes[b].first.y);
8196 minimum = std::min(minimum, d - holes[a].second - holes[b].second);
8197 }
8198 }
8199 if (minimum < 1e9 && minimum < holeClearMin->value())
8200 addResult(item->text(1), tr("Separación de taladros"), minimum, true);
8201 }
8202 }
8203 if (ringCheck->isChecked() && kind == "excellon") {
8204 const auto eit = excellonLayers_.find(id);
8205 if (eit == excellonLayers_.end()) continue;
8206 double worst = 1e9;
8207 QString holeLabel;
8208 for (const auto& [number, tool] : eit->second.tools) {
8209 for (const Pt& hole : tool.drills) {
8210 for (const auto& [gid, gerber] : gerberLayers_) {
8211 if (!gerber.solid.valid() || gerber.solid.empty()) continue;
8212 double boundary = 1e9;
8213 const Geom point = Geom::point(hole.x, hole.y);
8214 for (const PolygonContours& pc : gerber.solid.polygons()) {
8215 if (pc.outer.size() >= 2)
8216 boundary = std::min(boundary,
8217 point.distance(Geom::line(pc.outer)));
8218 for (const Ring& h : pc.holes)
8219 boundary = std::min(boundary,
8220 point.distance(Geom::line(h)));
8221 }
8222 if (boundary >= 1e9) continue;
8223 const double ring = boundary - tool.diameter / 2.0;
8224 if (ring < worst) {
8225 worst = ring;
8226 holeLabel = tr("T%1 en %2").arg(number).arg(item->text(1));
8227 }
8228 }
8229 }
8230 }
8231 if (worst < 1e9 && worst < ringMin->value())
8232 addResult(holeLabel, tr("Anillo anular"), worst, true);
8233 }
8234 }
8235 if (table->rowCount() == 0) {
8236 table->insertRow(0);
8237 table->setItem(0, 0, new QTableWidgetItem(tr("Sin violaciones")));
8238 }
8239 });
8240 dialog.resize(820, 520);
8241 dialog.exec();
8242}

8264/// @brief Reconstruye el menú de marcadores.
8265void MainWindow::rebuildBookmarksMenu() {
8266 if (!bookmarksMenu_) return;
8267 // Keep the first action (Add) and the separator.
8268 const auto actions = bookmarksMenu_->actions();
8269 for (int i = actions.size() - 1; i >= 2; --i) bookmarksMenu_->removeAction(actions[i]);
8270 const QStringList list = QSettings().value("bookmarks/list").toStringList();
8271 for (const QString& entry : list) {
8272 const QStringList parts = entry.split('|');
8273 if (parts.size() != 4) continue;
8274 const QString name = parts[0];
8275 const double x = parts[1].toDouble();
8276 const double y = parts[2].toDouble();
8277 const double scale = parts[3].toDouble();
8278 QAction* action = bookmarksMenu_->addAction(name);
8279 connect(action, &QAction::triggered, this, [this, x, y, scale] {
8280 canvas_->setView(scale, QPointF(x, y));
8281 });
8282 QAction* remove = bookmarksMenu_->addAction(tr(" Quitar «%1»").arg(name));
8283 connect(remove, &QAction::triggered, this, [this, entry] {
8284 QSettings settings;
8285 QStringList list = settings.value("bookmarks/list").toStringList();
8286 list.removeAll(entry);
8287 settings.setValue("bookmarks/list", list);
8288 rebuildBookmarksMenu();
8289 });
8290 }
8291 if (list.isEmpty()) {
8292 QAction* empty = bookmarksMenu_->addAction(tr("Sin marcadores"));
8293 empty->setEnabled(false);
8294 }
8295}

8297/// @brief Agrega un archivo a la lista de recientes.
8298void MainWindow::recordRecent(const QString& path) {
8299 if (path.isEmpty()) return;
8300 const QString absolute = QFileInfo(path).absoluteFilePath();

8303 list.removeAll(absolute);
8304 list.prepend(absolute);
8305 const int limit = settings.value("preferences/recentLimit", 12).toInt();

8307 settings.setValue("recent/files", list);
8308 rebuildRecentMenu();

8359/// @brief Exporta las preferencias a JSON.
8360void MainWindow::saveConfiguration() {
8361 const QString path = QFileDialog::getSaveFileName(
8362 this, tr("Guardar configuración"),
8363 QFileInfo(lastDir_).absolutePath() + "/flatcam_config.json",
8364 tr("Configuración (*.json)"));
8365 if (path.isEmpty()) return;
8366 QJsonObject root;
8367 QSettings settings;
8368 for (const QString& key : settings.allKeys()) {
8369 if (key.startsWith("recent/") || key.startsWith("bookmarks/") ||
8370 key.startsWith("toolsdb/"))
8371 continue;
8372 const QVariant value = settings.value(key);
8373 switch (value.typeId()) {
8374 case QMetaType::Bool: root[key] = value.toBool(); break;
8375 case QMetaType::Int:
8376 case QMetaType::LongLong: root[key] = value.toInt(); break;
8377 case QMetaType::Double: root[key] = value.toDouble(); break;
8378 case QMetaType::QStringList: {
8379 QJsonArray array;
8380 for (const QString& item : value.toStringList()) array.append(item);
8381 root[key] = array;
8382 break;
8383 }
8384 default: root[key] = value.toString(); break;
8385 }
8386 }
8387 QFile file(path);
8388 if (!file.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
8389 showError(tr("No se pudo guardar la configuración."));
8390 return;
8391 }
8392 file.write(QJsonDocument(root).toJson(QJsonDocument::Indented));
8393 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Configuración guardada: %1").arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName()), 5000);
8394}
8395
8396/// @brief Importa preferencias desde JSON.
8397void MainWindow::loadConfiguration() {
8398 const QString path = QFileDialog::getOpenFileName(
8399 this, tr("Abrir configuración"), lastDir_, tr("Configuración (*.json)"));
8400 if (path.isEmpty()) return;
8401 QFile file(path);
8402 if (!file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
8403 showError(tr("No se pudo abrir la configuración."));
8404 return;
8405 }
8406 const QJsonDocument doc = QJsonDocument::fromJson(file.readAll());
8407 if (!doc.isObject()) return;
8408 QSettings settings;
8409 const QJsonObject root = doc.object();
8410 for (auto it = root.begin(); it != root.end(); ++it) {
8411 const QJsonValue value = it.value();
8412 if (value.isBool()) settings.setValue(it.key(), value.toBool());
8413 else if (value.isDouble()) settings.setValue(it.key(), value.toDouble());
8414 else if (value.isArray()) {
8415 QStringList list;
8416 for (const QJsonValue& item : value.toArray()) list << item.toString();
8417 settings.setValue(it.key(), list);
8418 } else {
8419 const QString text = value.toString();
8420 if (it.key().endsWith("/bg") || it.key().endsWith("/copper") ||
8421 it.key().endsWith("/follow") || it.key().endsWith("/toolpath"))
8422 settings.setValue(it.key(), QColor(text));
8423 else
8424 settings.setValue(it.key(), text);
8425 }
8426 }
8427 loadPreferences();
8428 if (canvas_) canvas_->setColors(background_, copperColor_, followColor_, toolpathColor_);
8429 refreshProperties();
8430 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Configuración cargada"), 5000);
8431}

8443/**
8444 * @brief Pregunta si se deben guardar los cambios antes de cerrar.
8445 *
8446 * @param event Evento de cierre; se ignora si el usuario cancela o si falla
8447 * el guardado.
8448 */
8449void MainWindow::closeEvent(QCloseEvent* event) {
8450 savePreferences();
8451 if (!projectDirty_ || objectItems().empty()) {
8452 QMainWindow::closeEvent(event);
8453 return;
8454 }
8455 const auto answer = QMessageBox::question(
8456 this, tr("Salir de FlatCAM C++"),
8457 tr("Hay archivos o cambios sin guardar.\n¿Querés guardar el proyecto antes de salir?"),
8458 QMessageBox::Save | QMessageBox::Discard | QMessageBox::Cancel,
8459 QMessageBox::Save);
8460 if (answer == QMessageBox::Cancel) {
8461 event->ignore();
8462 return;
8463 }
8464 if (answer == QMessageBox::Save) {
8465 QString path = projectPath_;
8466 if (path.isEmpty()) {
8467 path = QFileDialog::getSaveFileName(
8468 this, tr("Guardar proyecto"),
8469 QFileInfo(lastDir_).absolutePath() + "/proyecto.FlatPrj",
8470 tr("Proyecto FlatCAM (*.FlatPrj);;Todos (*)"));
8471 }
8472 if (path.isEmpty() || !saveProjectToPath(path)) {
8473 event->ignore();
8474 return;
8475 }
8476 }
8477 QMainWindow::closeEvent(event);
8478}

8489/// @brief Escribe el proyecto en una ruta concreta.
8490bool MainWindow::saveProjectToPath(const QString& path) {
8491 Project project;
8492 for (QTreeWidgetItem* item : objectItems()) {
8493 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
8494 ProjectObject object;
8495 object.name = item->text(1).toStdString();
8496 object.kind = item->text(2).toStdString();
8497 object.units = defaultUnits_;
8498 const auto source = sourcePaths_.find(id);
8499 if (source != sourcePaths_.end()) object.sourceFile = source->second.toStdString();
8500 object.solids = canvas_->layerSolids(id);
8501 object.follows = canvas_->layerFollows(id);
8502 const auto text = objectText_.find(id);
8503 if (text != objectText_.end()) object.text = text->second.toStdString();
8504 if (item->text(2).toLower() == "gerber") {
8505 objectProps_[id][QStringLiteral("__toolTables")] = toolTablesJson();
8506 }
8507 const auto props = objectProps_.find(id);
8508 if (props != objectProps_.end()) {
8509 QJsonObject json;
8510 for (const auto& [key, value] : props->second) json[key] = value;
8511 object.properties = QJsonDocument(json).toJson(QJsonDocument::Compact).toStdString();
8512 }
8513 if (object.solids.empty() && object.follows.empty() && object.text.empty()) continue;
8514 project.objects.push_back(std::move(object));
8515 }
8516 project.options = toolTablesJson().toStdString();
8517 try {
8518 saveProject(path.toStdString(), project);
8519 projectPath_ = path;
8520 projectDirty_ = false;
8521 return true;
8522 } catch (const std::exception& e) {
8523 showError(QString::fromUtf8(e.what()));
8524 return false;
8525 }
8526}

8528/// @brief Traslada el objeto activo en X/Y.
8529void MainWindow::moveObject() {
8530 auto* item = objects_->currentItem();
8531 if (!item) return;
8532 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
8533 const auto solids = canvas_->layerSolids(id);
8534 const auto follows = canvas_->layerFollows(id);
8535 if (solids.empty() && follows.empty()) return;
8536
8537 QDialog dialog(this);
8538 dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("Mover objeto"));
8539 auto* form = new QFormLayout(&dialog);
8540 auto* dx = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
8541 dx->setRange(-1000, 1000);
8542 dx->setDecimals(3);
8543 dx->setSuffix(" mm");
8544 auto* dy = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
8545 dy->setRange(-1000, 1000);
8546 dy->setDecimals(3);
8547 dy->setSuffix(" mm");
8548 form->addRow(tr("ΔX:"), dx);
8549 form->addRow(tr("ΔY:"), dy);
8550 auto* box = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::Ok | QDialogButtonBox::Cancel, &dialog);
8551 form->addRow(box);
8552 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::accepted, &dialog, &QDialog::accept);
8553 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &dialog, &QDialog::reject);
8554 if (dialog.exec() != QDialog::Accepted) return;
8555
8556 std::vector<Geom> afterSolids;
8557 for (const Geom& g : solids) afterSolids.push_back(g.translate(dx->value(), dy->value()));
8558 std::vector<Geom> afterFollows;
8559 for (const Geom& g : follows) afterFollows.push_back(g.translate(dx->value(), dy->value()));
8560 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, afterSolids, afterFollows);
8561 refreshProperties();
8562 undoStack_->push(new LambdaCommand(
8563 [this, id, solids, follows] { canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, solids, follows); },
8564 [this, id, afterSolids, afterFollows] {
8565 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, afterSolids, afterFollows);
8566 },
8567 tr("Mover objeto")));
8568}

8580/// @brief Serializa las tablas de herramientas a JSON.
8581QString MainWindow::toolTablesJson() const {
8582 QJsonObject root;
8583 auto addTable = [&root](const QString& key, QTableWidget* table) {
8584 if (!table) return;
8585 QJsonArray rows;
8586 for (int row = 0; row < table->rowCount(); ++row) {
8587 QJsonArray cells;
8588 for (int col = 0; col < table->columnCount(); ++col) {
8589 auto* item = table->item(row, col);
8590 cells.append(item ? item->text() : QString());
8591 }
8592 rows.append(cells);
8593 }
8594 root[key] = rows;
8595 };
8596 addTable("iso", isoTable_);
8597 addTable("ncc", nccTable_);
8598 addTable("cut", cutTable_);
8599 addTable("paint", paintTable_);
8600 addTable("drill", drillTable_);
8601 return QString::fromUtf8(QJsonDocument(root).toJson(QJsonDocument::Compact));
8602}
8603
8604/// @brief Restaura las tablas de herramientas desde JSON.
8605void MainWindow::loadToolTablesJson(const QString& json) {
8606 const QJsonDocument doc = QJsonDocument::fromJson(json.toUtf8());
8607 if (!doc.isObject()) return;
8608 const QJsonObject root = doc.object();
8609 auto applyTable = [&root](const QString& key, QTableWidget* table) {
8610 if (!table || !root.contains(key) || !root[key].isArray()) return;
8611 const QJsonArray rows = root[key].toArray();
8612 table->setRowCount(0);
8613 for (const QJsonValue& rowValue : rows) {
8614 const QJsonArray cells = rowValue.toArray();
8615 const int row = table->rowCount();
8616 table->insertRow(row);
8617 for (int col = 0; col < cells.size(); ++col) {
8618 auto* item = new QTableWidgetItem(cells[col].toString());
8619 if (col == 0) item->setFlags(item->flags() & ~Qt::ItemIsEditable);
8620 table->setItem(row, col, item);
8621 }
8622 }
8623 };
8624 applyTable("iso", isoTable_);
8625 applyTable("ncc", nccTable_);
8626 applyTable("cut", cutTable_);
8627 applyTable("paint", paintTable_);
8628 applyTable("drill", drillTable_);
8629}

8632double MainWindow::snapValue(double value) const {

8634 double step = canvas_ ? canvas_->gridStep() : 0.0;

8649/// @brief Crea un documento o script de texto.
8650void MainWindow::createTextObject(const QString& kind) {
8651 bool ok = false;
8652 const QString title = kind == "script" ? tr("Nuevo script de proyecto")
8653 : tr("Nuevo documento");
8654 const QString text = QInputDialog::getMultiLineText(
8655 this, title, kind == "script" ? tr("Contenido del script:") : tr("Contenido:"),
8656 kind == "script" ? "// Script FlatCAM C++\n" : "", &ok);
8657 if (!ok) return;
8658 static int counter = 0;
8659 ++counter;
8660 const QString name = kind == "script" ? tr("Script %1").arg(counter)
8661 : tr("Documento %1").arg(counter);
8662 const int id = canvas_->appendGeometry({}, {}, true);
8663 canvas_->endGeometry();
8664 addObjectRow(name, kind, "-", id);
8665 objectText_[id] = text;
8666 objectProps_[id][tr("Tipo")] = kind == "script" ? tr("Script") : tr("Documento");
8667 objects_->setCurrentItem(findObjectItem(id));
8668 openTextObject(id);
8669}

8671/// @brief Abre el editor del objeto de texto.
8672void MainWindow::openTextObject(int layerId) {
8673 auto it = objectText_.find(layerId);
8674 if (it == objectText_.end()) {
8675 QTreeWidgetItem* item = findObjectItem(layerId);
8676 if (!item) return;
8677 it = objectText_.insert({layerId, QString()}).first;
8678 }
8679 QTreeWidgetItem* item = findObjectItem(layerId);
8680 QDialog dialog(this);
8681 dialog.resize(900, 650);
8682 dialog.setWindowTitle(item ? item->text(1) : tr("Texto"));
8683 auto* layout = new QVBoxLayout(&dialog);
8684 auto* editor = new QPlainTextEdit(&dialog);
8685 editor->setPlainText(it->second);
8686 editor->setStyleSheet("QPlainTextEdit { font-family: Menlo; font-size: 12px; }");
8687 layout->addWidget(editor);
8688 auto* box = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::Save | QDialogButtonBox::Close, &dialog);
8689 if (item && item->text(2).toLower() == "script") {
8690 auto* run = new QPushButton(tr("Ejecutar script"), &dialog);
8691 box->addButton(run, QDialogButtonBox::ActionRole);
8692 connect(run, &QPushButton::clicked, &dialog, [this, editor] {
8693 const QString temp = QDir::tempPath() + "/flatcam_project_script.js";
8694 QFile file(temp);
8695 if (!file.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly | QIODevice::Text)) return;
8696 file.write(editor->toPlainText().toUtf8());
8697 file.close();
8698 runScriptFile(temp);
8699 QFile::remove(temp);
8700 });
8701 }
8702 layout->addWidget(box);
8703 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &dialog, &QDialog::reject);
8704 const bool isCncJob = item && item->text(2).compare("cncjob", Qt::CaseInsensitive) == 0;
8705 connect(box->button(QDialogButtonBox::Save), &QPushButton::clicked, &dialog,
8706 [this, layerId, editor, item, isCncJob, &dialog] {
8707 objectText_[layerId] = editor->toPlainText();
8708 if (!isCncJob) {
8709 dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("%1 — guardado en el proyecto")
8710 .arg(item ? item->text(1) : tr("Texto")));
8711 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Texto guardado en el proyecto"), 3000);
8712 markProjectDirty();
8713 return;
8714 }
8715 QString path = item ? item->data(0, Qt::UserRole + 2).toString() : QString();
8716 if (path.isEmpty()) {
8717 path = QFileDialog::getSaveFileName(
8718 this, tr("Guardar G-code"),
8719 QFileInfo(lastDir_).absolutePath() + "/cncjob.nc",
8720 tr("G-code (*.nc *.gcode);;Todos (*)"));
8721 }
8722 if (path.isEmpty()) return;
8723 QFile out(path);
8724 if (!out.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
8725 showError(tr("No se pudo escribir %1").arg(path));
8726 return;
8727 }
8728 const QByteArray data = editor->toPlainText().toUtf8();
8729 if (out.write(data) != data.size() || !out.flush()) {
8730 showError(tr("No se pudo escribir todo el archivo %1").arg(path));
8731 return;
8732 }
8733 out.close();
8734 lastDir_ = QFileInfo(path).absolutePath();
8735 if (item) {
8736 item->setData(0, Qt::UserRole + 2, path);
8737 objectProps_[layerId][tr("Archivo")] = path;
8738 dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("%1 — guardado").arg(item->text(1)));
8739 }
8740 statusBar()->showMessage(
8741 tr("G-code guardado: %1").arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName()), 4000);
8742 markProjectDirty();
8743 });
8744 dialog.exec();
8745}

8784/// @brief Mide distancias entre objetos seleccionados.
8785void MainWindow::distanceMeasure() {
8786 QDialog dialog(this);
8787 dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("Medir distancia"));
8788 auto* form = new QFormLayout(&dialog);
8789 auto* x1 = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
8790 x1->setRange(-100000, 100000);
8791 x1->setDecimals(3);
8792 auto* y1 = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
8793 y1->setRange(-100000, 100000);
8794 y1->setDecimals(3);
8795 auto* x2 = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
8796 x2->setRange(-100000, 100000);
8797 x2->setDecimals(3);
8798 auto* y2 = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
8799 y2->setRange(-100000, 100000);
8800 y2->setDecimals(3);
8801 auto* result = new QLabel(tr("—"), &dialog);
8802 form->addRow(tr("X1:"), x1);
8803 form->addRow(tr("Y1:"), y1);
8804 form->addRow(tr("X2:"), x2);
8805 form->addRow(tr("Y2:"), y2);
8806 form->addRow(tr("Distancia:"), result);
8807 auto* draw = new QPushButton(tr("Dibujar"), &dialog);
8808 form->addRow(draw);
8809 auto* box = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::Close, &dialog);
8810 form->addRow(box);
8811 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &dialog, &QDialog::reject);
8812 connect(draw, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this, x1, y1, x2, y2, result] {
8813 const Pt a{snapValue(x1->value()), snapValue(y1->value())};
8814 const Pt b{snapValue(x2->value()), snapValue(y2->value())};
8815 const double d = std::hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y);
8816 result->setText(QString("%1 mm").arg(d, 0, 'f', 4));
8817 addGeneratedLayer(tr("Distancia"), {Geom::line({a, b})}, 0);
8818 });
8819 dialog.exec();
8820}

8831/// @brief Genera un CNCJob a partir de una capa de herramienta ya creada.
8832void MainWindow::generateGCodeFromObject(int layerId) {
8833 QTreeWidgetItem* item = findObjectItem(layerId);
8834 if (!item) return;
8835 const QString name = item->text(1);
8836 std::string code;
8837 GCodeOptions props;
8838 props.units = defaultUnits_;
8839 if (name.startsWith(tr("Taladrado")) && lastDrillJob_ && !lastDrillJob_->tools.empty()) {
8840 code = drillingGCode(*lastDrillJob_, lastDrillHeader_);
8841 props = lastDrillHeader_;
8842 } else if (name.startsWith(tr("Aislamiento")) && !lastIsoMulti_.empty()) {
8843 code = pathsGCodeMulti(lastIsoMulti_, lastIsoHeader_);
8844 props = lastIsoHeader_;
8845 } else if (name.startsWith(tr("NCC")) && !lastNccMulti_.empty()) {
8846 code = pathsGCodeMulti(lastNccMulti_, lastNccHeader_);
8847 props = lastNccHeader_;
8848 } else if (name.startsWith(tr("Corte")) && !lastCutMulti_.empty()) {
8849 code = pathsGCodeMulti(lastCutMulti_, lastCutHeader_);
8850 props = lastCutHeader_;
8851 } else if (name.startsWith(tr("Pintura")) && !lastPaintMulti_.empty()) {
8852 code = pathsGCodeMulti(lastPaintMulti_, lastPaintHeader_);
8853 props = lastPaintHeader_;
8854 } else if (lastMillJob_ && name.startsWith(tr("Fresado"))) {
8855 code = pathsGCode(*lastMillJob_, lastMillOptions_);
8856 props = lastMillOptions_;
8857 } else {
8858 std::vector<std::vector<Pt>> paths;
8859 auto append = [&paths](const std::vector<Geom>& geoms) {
8860 for (const Geom& g : geoms) {
8861 if (!g.valid() || g.empty()) continue;
8862 if (g.typeId() == GEOS_LINESTRING || g.typeId() == GEOS_LINEARRING) {
8863 Ring ring = g.coords();
8864 if (ring.size() >= 2) paths.emplace_back(ring.begin(), ring.end());
8865 } else {
8866 for (const PolygonContours& pc : g.polygons()) {
8867 if (pc.outer.size() >= 2)
8868 paths.emplace_back(pc.outer.begin(), pc.outer.end());
8869 }
8870 }
8871 }
8872 };
8873 append(canvas_->layerFollows(layerId));
8874 append(canvas_->layerSolids(layerId));
8875 if (paths.empty()) {
8876 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("G-code"),
8877 tr("La capa no tiene recorridos para generar G-code."));
8878 return;
8879 }
8880 GCodeOptions opt;
8881 opt.units = defaultUnits_;
8882 opt.feedXY = cncDefaultFeedXY_;
8883 opt.feedZ = cncDefaultFeedZ_;
8884 opt.spindleSpeed = cncDefaultRPM_;
8885 opt.zCut = cncDefaultZCut_;
8886 fc::PathToolJob job;
8887 job.number = 1;
8888 job.diameter = 0.2;
8889 job.options = opt;
8890 job.paths = paths;
8891 code = pathsGCodeMulti({job}, opt);
8892 props = opt;
8893 }
8894 if (code.empty()) {
8895 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("G-code"),
8896 tr("No se pudo generar G-code para este objeto."));
8897 return;
8898 }
8899 addCncJobObject(name, QString::fromStdString(code), cncProps(props, tr("Herramienta")));
8900 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("CNCJob generado para %1").arg(name), 4000);
8901}

8903/// @return Caja envolvente de todos los objetos con geometría.
8904fc::BBox MainWindow::pcbBounds() const {
8905 BBox all;
8906 for (QTreeWidgetItem* item : objectItems()) {
8907 if (item->parent() != filesGroup_) continue;
8908 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
8909 if (id <= 0) continue;
8910 const BBox b = canvas_->layerBounds(id);
8911 if (!b.valid) continue;
8912 if (!all.valid) {
8913 all = b;
8914 } else {
8915 all.xmin = std::min(all.xmin, b.xmin);
8916 all.ymin = std::min(all.ymin, b.ymin);
8917 all.xmax = std::max(all.xmax, b.xmax);
8918 all.ymax = std::max(all.ymax, b.ymax);
8919 }
8920 }
8921 if (!all.valid) {
8922 for (QTreeWidgetItem* item : objectItems()) {
8923 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
8924 if (id <= 0) continue;
8925 const BBox b = canvas_->layerBounds(id);
8926 if (!b.valid) continue;
8927 if (!all.valid) {
8928 all = b;
8929 } else {
8930 all.xmin = std::min(all.xmin, b.xmin);
8931 all.ymin = std::min(all.ymin, b.ymin);
8932 all.xmax = std::max(all.xmax, b.xmax);
8933 all.ymax = std::max(all.ymax, b.ymax);
8934 }
8935 }
8936 }
8937 return all;
8938}

8940/// @brief Mueve el objeto conservando su posición relativa al centro de la PCB.
8941void MainWindow::moveToOrigin() {
8942 auto* item = objects_->currentItem();
8943 if (!item) return;
8944 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
8945 const BBox pcb = pcbBounds();
8946 if (!pcb.valid || id <= 0) return;
8947 const std::vector<Geom> solids = canvas_->layerSolids(id);
8948 const std::vector<Geom> follows = canvas_->layerFollows(id);
8949 const double dx = -(pcb.xmin + pcb.xmax) / 2.0;
8950 const double dy = -(pcb.ymin + pcb.ymax) / 2.0;
8951 std::vector<Geom> afterSolids;
8952 std::vector<Geom> afterFollows;
8953 for (const Geom& g : solids) afterSolids.push_back(g.translate(dx, dy));
8954 for (const Geom& g : follows) afterFollows.push_back(g.translate(dx, dy));
8955 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, afterSolids, afterFollows);
8956 const auto apply = [this, id](const std::vector<Geom>& s, const std::vector<Geom>& f) {
8957 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, s, f);
8958 refreshProperties();
8959 };
8960 undoStack_->push(new LambdaCommand([apply, solids, follows] { apply(solids, follows); },
8961 [apply, afterSolids, afterFollows] {
8962 apply(afterSolids, afterFollows);
8963 },
8964 tr("Mover a origen")));
8965 canvas_->setToolpaths({});
8966 canvas_->fitTo(canvas_->layerBounds(id));
8967 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Objeto llevado a su posición relativa al centro de la PCB"), 4000);
8968}
8969
8970/// @brief Lleva toda la PCB a (0,0) usando la esquina inferior izquierda.
8971void MainWindow::movePcbToOrigin() {
8972 struct Entry {
8973 int id = 0;
8974 std::vector<Geom> solids;
8975 std::vector<Geom> follows;
8976 };
8977 std::vector<Entry> before;
8978 for (QTreeWidgetItem* item : objectItems()) {
8979 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
8980 if (id <= 0) continue;
8981 const BBox b = canvas_->layerBounds(id);
8982 if (!b.valid) continue;
8983 before.push_back({id, canvas_->layerSolids(id), canvas_->layerFollows(id)});
8984 }
8985 const BBox board = pcbBounds();
8986 if (!board.valid || before.empty()) return;
8987
8988 const double dx = -(board.xmin + board.xmax) / 2.0;
8989 const double dy = -(board.ymin + board.ymax) / 2.0;
8990 std::vector<Entry> after;
8991 after.reserve(before.size());
8992 for (const Entry& entry : before) {
8993 Entry moved{entry.id, {}, {}};
8994 for (const Geom& g : entry.solids) moved.solids.push_back(g.translate(dx, dy));
8995 for (const Geom& g : entry.follows) moved.follows.push_back(g.translate(dx, dy));
8996 after.push_back(std::move(moved));
8997 }
8998 auto apply = [this](const std::vector<Entry>& entries) {
8999 for (const Entry& entry : entries)
9000 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(entry.id, entry.solids, entry.follows);
9001 refreshProperties();
9002 };
9003 undoStack_->push(new LambdaCommand([apply, before] { apply(before); },
9004 [apply, after] { apply(after); },
9005 tr("Centrar PCB en (0, 0)")));
9006 canvas_->setToolpaths({});
9007 canvas_->fitWithOrigin();
9008 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Centro de la PCB llevado a (0, 0)"), 4000);
9009}

9011/// @brief Une varios objetos en una capa.
9012void MainWindow::joinObjects() {
9013 auto* item = objects_->currentItem();
9014 if (!item) return;
9015 const int idA = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
9016 QDialog dialog(this);
9017 dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("Unir objetos"));
9018 auto* form = new QFormLayout(&dialog);
9019 auto* combo = new QComboBox(&dialog);
9020 std::vector<int> ids;
9021 for (QTreeWidgetItem* row : objectItems()) {
9022 const int id = row->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
9023 if (id == idA) continue;
9024 combo->addItem(row->text(1));
9025 ids.push_back(id);
9026 }
9027 if (ids.empty()) {
9028 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Unir objetos"),
9029 tr("No hay otro objeto para unir."));
9030 return;
9031 }
9032 form->addRow(tr("Unir con:"), combo);
9033 auto* box = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::Ok | QDialogButtonBox::Cancel, &dialog);
9034 form->addRow(box);
9035 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::accepted, &dialog, &QDialog::accept);
9036 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &dialog, &QDialog::reject);
9037 if (dialog.exec() != QDialog::Accepted) return;
9038 const int idB = ids[static_cast<std::size_t>(combo->currentIndex())];
9039 std::vector<Geom> solids = canvas_->layerSolids(idA);
9040 std::vector<Geom> follows = canvas_->layerFollows(idA);
9041 const auto sb = canvas_->layerSolids(idB);
9042 const auto fb = canvas_->layerFollows(idB);
9043 solids.insert(solids.end(), sb.begin(), sb.end());
9044 follows.insert(follows.end(), fb.begin(), fb.end());
9045 const int id = canvas_->appendGeometry(solids, follows, true);
9046 canvas_->endGeometry();
9047 addObjectRow(tr("Unión de objetos"), "herramienta", "-", id, true, toolsGroup_);
9048 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Objetos unidos"), 4000);
9049}

9097/// @brief Alinea objetos contra el origen o entre sí.
9098void MainWindow::alignObjects() {
9099 auto* item = objects_->currentItem();
9100 if (!item) return;
9101 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
9102 const std::vector<Geom> solids = canvas_->layerSolids(id);
9103 const BBox source = canvas_->layerBounds(id);
9104 if (solids.empty() || !source.valid) {
9105 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Alinear"), tr("El objeto no tiene geometría editable."));
9106 return;
9107 }
9108
9109 QDialog dialog(this);
9110 dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("Alinear objeto"));
9111 auto* form = new QFormLayout(&dialog);
9112 auto* reference = new QComboBox(&dialog);
9113 reference->addItem(tr("Origen (0, 0)"), -1);
9114 std::vector<int> ids;
9115 for (const int other : canvas_->layerIds()) {
9116 if (other == id || canvas_->layerSolids(other).empty()) continue;
9117 for (QTreeWidgetItem* candidate : objectItems()) {
9118 if (candidate->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt() == other) {
9119 reference->addItem(candidate->text(1), other);
9120 ids.push_back(other);
9121 break;
9122 }
9123 }
9124 }
9125 auto* mode = new QComboBox(&dialog);
9126 mode->addItems({tr("Izquierda"), tr("Centro horizontal"), tr("Derecha"),
9127 tr("Arriba"), tr("Centro vertical"), tr("Abajo")});
9128 form->addRow(tr("Referencia:"), reference);
9129 form->addRow(tr("Alineación:"), mode);
9130 auto* box = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::Ok | QDialogButtonBox::Cancel, &dialog);
9131 form->addRow(box);
9132 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::accepted, &dialog, &QDialog::accept);
9133 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &dialog, &QDialog::reject);
9134 if (dialog.exec() != QDialog::Accepted) return;
9135
9136 BBox ref{0, 0, 0, 0};
9137 const int refId = reference->currentData().toInt();
9138 if (refId >= 0) {
9139 ref = canvas_->layerBounds(refId);
9140 }
9141 if (!ref.valid) return;
9142
9143 double dx = 0.0;
9144 double dy = 0.0;
9145 switch (mode->currentIndex()) {
9146 case 0: dx = ref.xmin - source.xmin; break;
9147 case 1: dx = (ref.xmin + ref.xmax) / 2.0 - (source.xmin + source.xmax) / 2.0; break;
9148 case 2: dx = ref.xmax - source.xmax; break;
9149 case 3: dy = ref.ymax - source.ymax; break;
9150 case 4: dy = (ref.ymin + ref.ymax) / 2.0 - (source.ymin + source.ymax) / 2.0; break;
9151 default: dy = ref.ymin - source.ymin; break;
9152 }
9153
9154 std::vector<Geom> after;
9155 after.reserve(solids.size());
9156 for (const Geom& g : solids) after.push_back(g.translate(dx, dy));
9157 const auto before = solids;
9158 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, after, canvas_->layerFollows(id));
9159 refreshProperties();
9160 undoStack_->push(new LambdaCommand(
9161 [this, id, before] { canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, before, canvas_->layerFollows(id)); },
9162 [this, id, after] { canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, after, canvas_->layerFollows(id)); },
9163 tr("Alinear objeto")));
9164}

9166/// @brief Crea una copia espejada para doble faz.
9167void MainWindow::doubleSided() {
9168 auto* item = objects_->currentItem();
9169 if (!item) return;
9170 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
9171 const std::vector<Geom> solids = canvas_->layerSolids(id);
9172 const BBox b = canvas_->layerBounds(id);
9173 if (solids.empty() || !b.valid) {
9174 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Doble faz"),
9175 tr("El objeto no tiene geometría editable."));
9176 return;
9177 }
9178
9179 QDialog dialog(this);

9185 offsetX->setRange(-10000, 10000);

9187 offsetX->setValue(b.width());
9188 offsetX->setSuffix(" mm");

9190 offsetY->setRange(-10000, 10000);
9191 offsetY->setDecimals(3);

9196 form->addRow(tr("Desplazamiento Y:"), offsetY);
9197 auto* box = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::Ok | QDialogButtonBox::Cancel, &dialog);
9198 form->addRow(box);
9199 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::accepted, &dialog, &QDialog::accept);
9200 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &dialog, &QDialog::reject);
9201 if (dialog.exec() != QDialog::Accepted) return;
9202
9203 if (mirrorLayerToNew(id, axis->currentIndex() == 0, offsetX->value(), offsetY->value()) >= 0)
9204 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Copia espejada creada"), 4000);
9205}
9206
9207/// @brief Crea una copia espejada alrededor del centro de una capa.
9208int MainWindow::mirrorLayerToNew(int sourceId, bool mirrorX, double offsetX, double offsetY) {
9209 const BBox b = canvas_->layerBounds(sourceId);
9210 if (!b.valid) return -1;
9211 return mirrorLayerAround(sourceId, mirrorX, (b.xmin + b.xmax) / 2.0,
9212 (b.ymin + b.ymax) / 2.0, offsetX, offsetY);
9213}
9214
9215/// @brief Crea una copia espejada alrededor de un punto de referencia.
9216int MainWindow::mirrorLayerAround(int sourceId, bool mirrorX, double refX, double refY,
9217 double offsetX, double offsetY) {
9218 QTreeWidgetItem* item = findObjectItem(sourceId);
9219 const BBox b = canvas_->layerBounds(sourceId);
9220 if (!item || !b.valid) return -1;
9221 const std::vector<Geom> solids = canvas_->layerSolids(sourceId);
9222 const std::vector<Geom> follows = canvas_->layerFollows(sourceId);
9223 const double cx = refX;
9224 const double cy = refY;
9225 auto transform = [&](const std::vector<Geom>& source) {
9226 std::vector<Geom> out;
9227 out.reserve(source.size());
9228 for (const Geom& g : source) {
9229 Geom t = mirrorX ? g.scale(-1.0, 1.0, {cx, cy}) : g.scale(1.0, -1.0, {cx, cy});
9230 out.push_back(t.translate(offsetX, offsetY));
9231 }
9232 return out;
9233 };
9234 const int newId = canvas_->appendGeometry(transform(solids), transform(follows), true);
9235 canvas_->endGeometry();
9236 addObjectRow(tr("2 lados · %1").arg(item->text(1)), item->text(2), "-", newId, true,
9237 toolsGroup_);
9238 return newId;
9239}
9240
9241/// @brief Regenera el Gerber con nuevos tamaños de apertura.
9242bool MainWindow::applyApertureSizes(int layerId, const std::map<QString, double>& sizes) {
9243 const auto source = sourcePaths_.find(layerId);
9244 if (source == sourcePaths_.end()) {
9245 QMessageBox::information(
9246 this, tr("Aperturas"),
9247 tr("Este objeto no tiene un archivo Gerber de origen. Guardalo como Gerber "
9248 "y volvé a abrirlo para editar sus aperturas."));
9249 return false;
9250 }
9251 QFile file(source->second);
9252 if (!file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
9253 showError(tr("No se pudo leer el Gerber de origen."));
9254 return false;
9255 }
9256 std::string text = file.readAll().toStdString();
9257 file.close();
9258 int changed = 0;
9259 for (const auto& [code, diameter] : sizes) {
9260 int count = 0;
9261 text = editApertureSize(text, code.toStdString(), diameter, 4, &count);
9262 changed += count;
9263 }
9264 if (changed == 0) {
9265 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Aperturas"),
9266 tr("No se encontraron definiciones ADD de esos círculos."));
9267 return false;
9268 }
9269
9270 try {
9271 GerberOptions opt;
9272 opt.appUnits = defaultUnits_;
9273 opt.stepsPerCircle = stepsPerCircle_;
9274 const GerberResult fresh = GerberParser(opt).parseString(text);
9275 const GerberResult before = gerberLayers_[layerId];
9276 const GerberResult after = fresh;
9277
9278 auto apply = [this, layerId](const GerberResult& result) {
9279 gerberLayers_[layerId] = result;
9280 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(layerId, result.solids, result.follows);
9281 if (QTreeWidgetItem* item = findObjectItem(layerId))
9282 item->setText(3, QString::number(result.solid.area(), 'f', 2));
9283 refreshProperties();
9284 };
9285 apply(after);
9286 lastGerber_ = after;
9287 undoStack_->push(new LambdaCommand([apply, before] { apply(before); },
9288 [apply, after] { apply(after); },
9289 tr("Editar aperturas")));
9290 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Aperturas actualizadas"), 5000);
9291 return true;
9292 } catch (const std::exception& e) {
9293 showError(QString::fromUtf8(e.what()));
9294 return false;
9295 }
9296}
9297
9298/// @brief Regenera el Gerber con una macro editada.
9299bool MainWindow::applyMacroDefinition(int layerId, const QString& name, const QString& raw) {
9300 const auto source = sourcePaths_.find(layerId);
9301 if (source == sourcePaths_.end()) {
9302 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Macros"),
9303 tr("Este objeto no tiene un Gerber de origen editable."));
9304 return false;
9305 }
9306 QFile file(source->second);
9307 if (!file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text)) return false;
9308 QString text = QString::fromUtf8(file.readAll());
9309 file.close();
9310 const QRegularExpression re("%AM" + QRegularExpression::escape(name) + "\\*([^%]*)%");
9311 if (!text.contains(re)) {
9312 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Macros"),
9313 tr("No se encontró la definición de la macro en el archivo."));
9314 return false;
9315 }
9316 text.replace(re, "%AM" + name + "*" + raw + "%");
9317 try {
9318 GerberOptions opt;
9319 opt.appUnits = defaultUnits_;
9320 opt.stepsPerCircle = stepsPerCircle_;
9321 const GerberResult fresh = GerberParser(opt).parseString(text.toStdString());
9322 const GerberResult before = gerberLayers_[layerId];
9323 const GerberResult after = fresh;
9324 auto apply = [this, layerId](const GerberResult& result) {
9325 gerberLayers_[layerId] = result;
9326 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(layerId, result.solids, result.follows);
9327 if (QTreeWidgetItem* item = findObjectItem(layerId))
9328 item->setText(3, QString::number(result.solid.area(), 'f', 2));
9329 refreshProperties();
9330 };
9331 apply(after);
9332 lastGerber_ = after;
9333 undoStack_->push(new LambdaCommand([apply, before] { apply(before); },
9334 [apply, after] { apply(after); },
9335 tr("Editar macro")));
9336 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Macro actualizada"), 5000);
9337 return true;
9338 } catch (const std::exception& e) {
9339 showError(QString::fromUtf8(e.what()));
9340 return false;
9341 }
9342}

9714 const auto it = gerberLayers_.find(id);

9744 auto* apply = new QPushButton(tr("Aplicar cambios"), &apertures);

9747 layout->addWidget(macrosButton);

9749 layout->addWidget(box);
9750 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &apertures, &QDialog::reject);
9751 connect(macrosButton, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this, id, &apertures] {
9752 const auto it = gerberLayers_.find(id);

9754 QMessageBox::information(&apertures, tr("Macros"),
9755 tr("Este Gerber no tiene macros."));

9763 auto* editor = new QPlainTextEdit(&macroDialog);

9765 auto update = [&] {
9766 const QString name = combo->currentText();
9767 const auto macro = it->second.macros.find(name.toStdString());
9768 editor->setPlainText(macro != it->second.macros.end()
9769 ? QString::fromStdString(macro->second.raw)
9770 : QString());
9771 };
9772 connect(combo, QOverload<int>::of(&QComboBox::currentIndexChanged), &macroDialog,
9773 [&](int) { update(); });
9774 update();
9775 layout->addWidget(combo);
9776 layout->addWidget(editor);
9777 auto* buttons = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::Ok | QDialogButtonBox::Cancel,
9778 &macroDialog);
9779 layout->addWidget(buttons);
9780 connect(buttons, &QDialogButtonBox::accepted, &macroDialog, &QDialog::accept);
9781 connect(buttons, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &macroDialog, &QDialog::reject);
9782 macroDialog.resize(700, 500);
9783 if (macroDialog.exec() == QDialog::Accepted) {
9784 if (applyMacroDefinition(id, combo->currentText(), editor->toPlainText()))
9785 apertures.accept();
9786 }
9787 });
9788 connect(apply, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this, id, table, &apertures] {
9789 std::map<QString, double> sizes;
9790 for (int row = 0; row < table->rowCount(); ++row) {
9791 auto* codeItem = table->item(row, 0);
9792 auto* sizeItem = table->item(row, 2);
9793 if (!codeItem || !sizeItem) continue;
9794 if (!(sizeItem->flags() & Qt::ItemIsEditable)) continue;
9795 const double oldSize = codeItem->data(Qt::UserRole).toDouble();
9796 const double newSize = sizeItem->text().toDouble();
9797 if (newSize <= 0.0 || std::fabs(newSize - oldSize) < 1e-9) continue;
9798 sizes[codeItem->text()] = newSize;
9799 }
9800 if (sizes.empty()) {
9801 apertures.accept();
9802 return;
9803 }
9804 if (applyApertureSizes(id, sizes)) apertures.accept();
9805 });
9806 apertures.resize(680, 440);
9807 apertures.exec();
9808 });

9810 connect(add, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [&] {
9811 pushHistory();
9812 const int type = kind->currentIndex();
9813 if (type == 0) {
9814 solids.push_back(Geom::circle({px->value(), py->value()}, pw->value() / 2.0, 32));
9815 } else if (type == 1) {
9816 solids.push_back(Geom::box(px->value(), py->value(),
9817 px->value() + pw->value(), py->value() + ph->value()));
9818 } else if (type == 2) {
9819 solids.push_back(Geom::line({{px->value(), py->value()},
9820 {ph->value(), py->value()}})
9821 .buffer(pw->value() / 2.0, 8));
9822 } else if (type == 3) {
9823 const int sides = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(ph->value()), 3, 64);
9824 solids.push_back(Geom::regularPolygon({px->value(), py->value()},
9825 pw->value(), sides, 0.0));
9826 } else if (type == 4) {
9827 QPainterPath path;
9828 QFont font("Helvetica");
9829 font.setPixelSize(100);
9830 path.addText(0, 0, font, textEntry->text().isEmpty() ? "FlatCAM" : textEntry->text());
9831 if (path.isEmpty()) {
9832 refresh();
9833 return;
9834 }
9835 const QRectF br = path.boundingRect();
9836 if (br.height() <= 0.0) return;
9837 const double scale = pw->value() / br.height();
9838 QTransform transform;
9839 transform.translate(px->value(), py->value() - br.height() * scale);
9840 transform.scale(scale, -scale);
9841 const QPainterPath mapped = transform.map(path);
9842 const QList<QPolygonF> polys = mapped.toSubpathPolygons();
9843 for (const QPolygonF& poly : polys) {
9844 if (poly.size() < 3) continue;
9845 Ring ring;
9846 ring.reserve(static_cast<std::size_t>(poly.size()));
9847 for (const QPointF& pt : poly) ring.push_back({pt.x(), pt.y()});
9848 solids.push_back(Geom::polygon(ring));
9849 }
9850 }
9851 if (type == 5) {
9852 const double radius = pw->value() / 2.0;
9853 const double cx = px->value();
9854 const double cy = py->value();
9855 Ring arc;
9856 for (int step = 0; step <= 36; ++step) {
9857 const double angle = M_PI * step / 36.0;
9858 arc.push_back({cx + radius * std::cos(angle), cy + radius * std::sin(angle)});
9859 }
9860 follows.push_back(Geom::line(arc));
9861 }
9862 refresh();
9863 });
9864 connect(saveGerber, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [&] {
9865 const QString path = QFileDialog::getSaveFileName(
9866 this, tr("Guardar como Gerber"), QFileInfo(lastDir_).absolutePath() + "/edited.gbr",
9867 tr("Gerber (*.gbr *.gtl *.gbl);;Todos (*)"));
9868 if (path.isEmpty()) return;
9869 try {
9870 writeGerber(path.toStdString(), solids, follows, defaultUnits_);
9871 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Gerber guardado: %1").arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName()), 5000);
9872 } catch (const std::exception& e) {
9873 showError(QString::fromUtf8(e.what()));
9874 }
9875 });
9876
9877 if (dialog.exec() != QDialog::Accepted) return;
9878
9879 const std::vector<Geom> beforeSolids = canvas_->layerSolids(id);
9880 const std::vector<Geom> beforeFollows = canvas_->layerFollows(id);
9881
9882 GerberResult r;
9883 r.solids = solids;
9884 r.follows = follows;
9885 r.solid = Geom::unionOf(solids);
9886 r.bounds = r.solid.bounds();
9887 r.fileUnits = defaultUnits_;
9888 gerberLayers_[id] = r;
9889 lastGerber_ = r;
9890 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, solids, follows);
9891 item->setText(2, QString::number(r.solid.area(), 'f', 2));
9892 refreshProperties();
9893
9894 auto apply = [this, id](const std::vector<Geom>& s, const std::vector<Geom>& f) {
9895 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, s, f);
9896 refreshProperties();
9897 };
9898 undoStack_->push(new LambdaCommand([apply, beforeSolids, beforeFollows] {
9899 apply(beforeSolids, beforeFollows);
9900 },
9901 [apply, solids, follows] { apply(solids, follows); },
9902 tr("Editar Gerber")));
9903 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Gerber editado"), 4000);
9904}

9906/// @brief Edita el archivo Gerber/Excellon fuente.
9907void MainWindow::editSource() {
9908 auto* item = objects_->currentItem();
9909 if (!item) {
9910 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Editor de fuente"), tr("Seleccione un objeto."));
9911 return;
9912 }
9913 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
9914 const auto it = sourcePaths_.find(id);
9915 if (it == sourcePaths_.end()) {
9916 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Editor de fuente"),
9917 tr("Este objeto no tiene un archivo fuente asociado."));
9918 return;
9919 }
9920 const QString path = it->second;
9921 QFile file(path);
9922 if (!file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
9923 showError(tr("No se pudo leer el archivo"));
9924 return;
9925 }
9926 const QString original = QString::fromUtf8(file.readAll());
9927 file.close();
9928
9929 QDialog dialog(this);
9930 dialog.resize(900, 700);
9931 dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("Editor de fuente — %1").arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName()));
9932 auto* layout = new QVBoxLayout(&dialog);
9933 auto* editor = new QPlainTextEdit(&dialog);
9934 editor->setPlainText(original);
9935 editor->setStyleSheet("QPlainTextEdit { font-family: Menlo; font-size: 12px; }");
9936 layout->addWidget(editor);
9937 auto* box = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::Ok | QDialogButtonBox::Cancel, &dialog);
9938 box->button(QDialogButtonBox::Ok)->setText(tr("Guardar y reprocesar"));
9939 layout->addWidget(box);
9940 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::accepted, &dialog, &QDialog::accept);
9941 connect(box, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &dialog, &QDialog::reject);
9942 if (dialog.exec() != QDialog::Accepted) return;
9943
9944 QFile out(path);
9945 if (!out.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
9946 showError(tr("No se pudo guardar el archivo"));
9947 return;
9948 }
9949 out.write(editor->toPlainText().toUtf8());
9950 out.close();
9951
9952 try {
9953 if (gerberLayers_.count(id)) {
9954 GerberOptions opt;
9955 opt.appUnits = defaultUnits_;
9956 opt.stepsPerCircle = stepsPerCircle_;
9957 const GerberResult r = GerberParser(opt).parseFile(path.toStdString());
9958 gerberLayers_[id] = r;
9959 lastGerber_ = r;
9960 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, r.solids, r.follows);
9961 item->setText(2, QString::number(r.solid.area(), 'f', 2));
9962 } else if (excellonLayers_.count(id)) {
9963 ExcellonOptions opt;
9964 opt.appUnits = defaultUnits_;
9965 opt.stepsPerCircle = stepsPerCircle_;
9966 const ExcellonResult r = ExcellonParser(opt).parseFile(path.toStdString());
9967 excellonLayers_[id] = r;
9968 lastExcellon_ = r;
9969 lastDrillJob_ = drillJobFromExcellon(r);
9970 canvas_->setLayerGeometry(id, r.geometry, {});
9971 item->setText(2, QString::number(r.solid.area(), 'f', 2));
9972 refreshDrillTable();
9973 } else {
9974 return;
9975 }
9976 refreshProperties();
9977 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Fuente guardada y reprocesada"), 5000);
9978 } catch (const std::exception& e) {
9979 showError(QString::fromUtf8(e.what()));
9980 }
9981}

10264 auto updateZ = [c, table, form] {
10265 const bool laser = isLaserFlavorIndex(c.pre->currentIndex());
10266 const bool ignore = c.noZ->isChecked();
10267 c.zMove->setEnabled(!ignore);
10268 c.zTool->setEnabled(!ignore);
10269 c.zEnd->setEnabled(!ignore);
10270 auto grayLabel = [form](QWidget* field, bool enabled) {
10271 if (QWidget* label = form->labelForField(field)) label->setEnabled(enabled);
10272 };
10273 grayLabel(c.zMove, !ignore);
10274 grayLabel(c.zTool, !ignore);
10275 grayLabel(c.zEnd, !ignore);
10276 if (table) {
10277 table->setColumnHidden(3, ignore); // Av. Z
10278 table->setColumnHidden(4, ignore || laser); // RPM no aplica sin Z ni en láser
10279 table->setColumnHidden(5, !laser); // S sólo en modo láser
10280 table->setColumnHidden(6, ignore); // Z corte
10281 table->setColumnHidden(7, ignore); // Prof.
10282 if (auto* header = table->horizontalHeaderItem(5))
10283 header->setText(tr("Pot. láser"));
10284 }
10285 };
10286 connect(c.pre, QOverload<int>::of(&QComboBox::currentIndexChanged), this,
10287 [c, updateZ](int index) {
10288 if (isLaserFlavorIndex(index) && !c.noZ->isChecked()) {
10289 const QSignalBlocker blocker(c.noZ);
10290 c.noZ->setChecked(true);
10291 }
10292 updateZ();
10293 });
10294 connect(c.noZ, &QCheckBox::toggled, this, [updateZ](bool) { updateZ(); });
10295
10296 addRow(form, tr("Altura Z p/recorr.:"), c.zMove);
10297 addRow(form, tr("Cambio herram. Z:"), c.zTool);
10298 addRow(form, tr("Fin del mov. Z:"), c.zEnd);
10299 addRow(form, tr("Dwell:"), c.dwell);
10300 addRow(form, tr("X final:"), c.endX);
10301 addRow(form, tr("Y final:"), c.endY);
10302 addRow(form, tr("Postprocesador:"), c.pre);
10303 form->addRow(QString(), c.noZ);
10304 updateZ();
10305 return c;
10306 };

10308 auto optionsFor = [](const ToolRow& row, const Common& c) {
10309 fc::GCodeOptions opt;
10310 opt.units = fc::Units::Mm;
10311 opt.toolDiameter = row.dia;
10312 opt.feedXY = row.fxy;
10313 opt.feedZ = row.fz;
10314 opt.spindleSpeed = row.rpm;
10315 opt.laserPower = row.laser;
10316 const bool ignoreZ = c.noZ->isChecked();
10317 opt.zCut = ignoreZ ? 0.0 : row.zcut;
10318 opt.depthPerPass = ignoreZ ? 0.0 : row.depth;
10319 opt.zMove = ignoreZ ? 0.0 : c.zMove->value();
10320 opt.zToolchange = ignoreZ ? 0.0 : c.zTool->value();
10321 opt.zEnd = ignoreZ ? 0.0 : c.zEnd->value();
10322 opt.dwellTime = c.dwell->value();
10323 if (c.endX->value() != 0.0 || c.endY->value() != 0.0)
10324 opt.endXY = fc::Pt{c.endX->value(), c.endY->value()};
10325 opt.flavor = gcodeFlavorFromIndex(c.pre->currentIndex());
10326 opt.customToolchange = c.customTc ? c.customTc->toPlainText().toStdString() : std::string();
10327 return opt;
10328 };

10393 auto* isoPreview = new QPushButton(originalIcon("geometry"), tr("Generar geometría"), this);
10394 auto* isoCnc = new QPushButton(originalIcon("cnc"), tr("Generar CNCJob"), this);
10395 isoCnc->setProperty("primary", true);
10396 auto* isoExport = new QPushButton(originalIcon("save_as"), tr("Exportar G-code"), this);
10397 isoForm->addRow(isoPreview);
10398 isoForm->addRow(isoCnc);
