10400 connect(isoPreview, &QPushButton::clicked, this,
10401 [this, camName, isoTable, isoPasses, isoOverlap, isoInvert, isoOrder, isoType, isoAngle,
10402 isoDepth, isoFollow, isoCombine, isoRest, isoCommon, optionsFor, readTable] {
10403 fc::GerberResult* src = sourceGerber(isoSource_);
10404 if (!src) return;
10405 auto rows = readTable(isoTable);
10406 if (rows.empty()) return;
10407 if (isoRest->isChecked()) {
10408 std::sort(rows.begin(), rows.end(),
10409 [](const ToolRow& a, const ToolRow& b) { return a.dia > b.dia; });
10410 } else if (isoOrder->currentIndex() == 1) {
10411 std::sort(rows.begin(), rows.end(),
10412 [](const ToolRow& a, const ToolRow& b) { return a.dia < b.dia; });
10413 } else if (isoOrder->currentIndex() == 2) {
10414 std::sort(rows.begin(), rows.end(),
10415 [](const ToolRow& a, const ToolRow& b) { return a.dia > b.dia; });
10416 }
10417 lastIsoMulti_.clear();
10418 std::vector<Geom> preview;
10419 Geom covered;
10420 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < rows.size(); ++i) {
10421 IsolationOptions o;
10422 double effective = rows[i].dia;
10423 if (isoType->currentIndex() == 1) {
10424 effective = 2.0 * isoDepth->value() *
10425 std::tan(isoAngle->value() * M_PI / 360.0);
10426 }
10427 if (effective <= 0.0) effective = rows[i].dia;
10428 o.toolDiameter = effective;
10429 o.passes = isoPasses->value();
10430 o.overlap = isoOverlap->value() / 100.0;
10431 o.invert = isoInvert->isChecked();
10432 const IsolationResult res = isolateCopper(src->solid, o);
10433 fc::PathToolJob job;
10434 job.number = static_cast<int>(i) + 1;
10435 job.diameter = effective;
10436 job.options = optionsFor(rows[i], isoCommon);
10437 job.options.toolDiameter = effective;
10438 job.options.connectPaths = isoCombine->isChecked();
10439 job.bounds = res.bounds;
10440 for (const Geom& g : res.paths) {
10441 if (isoRest->isChecked() && covered.valid() && !covered.empty()) {
10442 const Geom probe = g.buffer(0.01, 8);
10443 if (probe.valid() && probe.difference(covered).empty()) continue;
10444 }
10445 Ring ring = g.coords();
10446 if (ring.size() >= 2) job.paths.emplace_back(ring.begin(), ring.end());
10447 preview.push_back(g);
10448 if (isoRest->isChecked()) {
10449 const Geom area = g.buffer(effective / 2.0, 8);
10450 covered = covered.valid() ? covered.unite(area) : area;
10451 }
10452 }
10453 if (isoFollow->isChecked() && i == 0) {
10454 for (const PolygonContours& pc : src->solid.polygons()) {
10455 std::vector<Ring> rings;
10456 rings.push_back(pc.outer);
10457 for (const Ring& hole : pc.holes) rings.push_back(hole);
10458 for (const Ring& ring : rings) {
10459 if (ring.size() < 2) continue;
10460 job.paths.push_back(ring);
10461 preview.push_back(Geom::line(ring));
10462 }
10463 }
10464 }
10465 lastIsoMulti_.push_back(std::move(job));
10466 }
10467 lastIsoHeader_ = optionsFor(rows.front(), isoCommon);
10468 if (!lastIsoMulti_.empty())
10469 lastIsoHeader_.headerComments = lastIsoMulti_.front().options.headerComments;
10470 const int sourceId = isoSource_ ? isoSource_->currentData().toInt() : 0;
10471 addGeneratedLayer(camName(tr("Aislamiento"), isoSource_), preview, sourceId);
10472 {
10473 std::vector<std::vector<Pt>> moves;
10474 for (const auto& job : lastIsoMulti_)
10475 for (const auto& path : job.paths) moves.push_back(path);
10476 setPathToolpaths(canvas_, moves);
10477 }
10478 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Aislamiento: %1 herramientas").arg(lastIsoMulti_.size()), 4000);
10479 });
10480 connect(isoCnc, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this, camName] {
10481 if (lastIsoMulti_.empty()) {
10482 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Aislamiento"),
10483 tr("Genere primero la geometría de aislamiento."));
10484 return;
10485 }
10486 const std::string code = pathsGCodeMulti(lastIsoMulti_, lastIsoHeader_);
10487 addCncJobObject(camName(tr("Aislamiento"), isoSource_), QString::fromStdString(code),
10488 cncProps(lastIsoHeader_, tr("Aislamiento")));
10489 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("CNCJob de aislamiento generado"), 4000);
10490 });
10491 connect(isoExport, &QPushButton::clicked, this, &MainWindow::exportIsolationGCode);
10492 toolTabs_[tr("Herramienta de aislamiento")] = wrapScroll(isoPage);

10570 nccForm->addRow(nccPreview);

10573 connect(nccPreview, &QPushButton::clicked, this,
10574 [this, camName, nccTable, nccStep, nccClear, nccAngle, nccMargin, nccBorder,
10575 nccStrategy, nccClimb, nccCompensate, nccComp, nccConnect, nccRest, nccCommon,
10576 optionsFor, readTable] {
10577 fc::GerberResult* src = sourceGerber(nccSource_);
10578 if (!src) return;
10579 auto rows = readTable(nccTable);
10580 if (rows.empty()) return;
10581 if (nccRest->isChecked())
10582 std::sort(rows.begin(), rows.end(),
10583 [](const ToolRow& a, const ToolRow& b) { return a.dia > b.dia; });
10584 lastNccMulti_.clear();
10585 std::vector<Geom> preview;
10586 Geom covered;
10587 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < rows.size(); ++i) {
10588 Geom toolCovered;
10589 NccOptions o;
10590 o.toolDiameter = rows[i].dia;
10591 o.stepOver = (100.0 - nccStep->value()) / 100.0;
10592 o.clearance = nccClear->value();
10593 o.angleDeg = nccAngle->value();
10594 o.margin = nccMargin->value();
10595 o.border = nccBorder->value();
10596 switch (nccStrategy->currentIndex()) {
10597 case 1: o.strategy = NccStrategy::Seed; break;
10598 case 2: o.strategy = NccStrategy::Lines; break;
10599 case 3: o.strategy = NccStrategy::Combo; break;
10600 default: o.strategy = NccStrategy::Hatch; break;
10601 }
10602 o.climb = nccClimb->currentIndex() == 0;
10603 o.compensation = nccCompensate->isChecked() ? nccComp->value() : 0.0;
10604 const BBox b = src->bounds.expanded(nccMargin->value());
10605 const Geom area = b.valid ? Geom::box(b.xmin, b.ymin, b.xmax, b.ymax) : Geom();
10606 const NccResult res = clearCopper(src->solid, area, o);
10607 fc::PathToolJob job;
10608 job.number = static_cast<int>(i) + 1;
10609 job.diameter = rows[i].dia;
10610 job.options = optionsFor(rows[i], nccCommon);
10611 job.options.connectPaths = nccConnect->isChecked();
10612 addHeaderComments(job.options, {
10613 tr("Operation: NCC"),
10614 tr("Strategy: %1").arg(nccStrategy->currentText()),
10615 tr("Overlap: %1 %").arg(nccStep->value()),
10616 tr("Copper clearance: %1 mm").arg(nccClear->value()),
10617 tr("Area margin: %1 mm").arg(nccMargin->value()),
10618 tr("Unprocessed border: %1 mm").arg(nccBorder->value()),
10619 tr("Hatch angle: %1 deg").arg(nccAngle->value()),
10620 tr("Milling type: %1").arg(nccClimb->currentText()),
10621 tr("Compensation: %1 mm").arg(nccCompensate->isChecked()
10622 ? nccComp->value()
10623 : 0.0),
10624 tr("Connect paths: %1").arg(nccConnect->isChecked() ? tr("yes") : tr("no")),
10625 tr("Rest machining: %1").arg(nccRest->isChecked() ? tr("yes") : tr("no")),
10626 });
10627 job.bounds = res.bounds;
10628 for (const Geom& g : res.paths) {
10629 if (nccRest->isChecked() && covered.valid() && !covered.empty()) {
10630 const Geom probe = g.buffer(0.01, 8);
10631 if (probe.valid() && probe.difference(covered).empty()) continue;
10632 }
10633 Ring ring = g.coords();
10634 if (ring.size() >= 2) job.paths.emplace_back(ring.begin(), ring.end());
10635 preview.push_back(g);
10636 if (nccRest->isChecked()) {
10637 const Geom area = g.buffer(rows[i].dia / 2.0, 8);
10638 toolCovered = toolCovered.valid() ? toolCovered.unite(area) : area;
10639 }
10640 }
10641 if (nccRest->isChecked() && toolCovered.valid())
10642 covered = covered.valid() ? covered.unite(toolCovered) : toolCovered;
10643 lastNccMulti_.push_back(std::move(job));
10644 }
10645 lastNccHeader_ = optionsFor(rows.front(), nccCommon);
10646 if (!lastNccMulti_.empty())
10647 lastNccHeader_.headerComments = lastNccMulti_.front().options.headerComments;
10648 const int sourceId = nccSource_ ? nccSource_->currentData().toInt() : 0;
10649 addGeneratedLayer(camName(tr("NCC"), nccSource_), preview, sourceId);
10650 {
10651 std::vector<std::vector<Pt>> moves;
10652 for (const auto& job : lastNccMulti_)
10653 for (const auto& path : job.paths) moves.push_back(path);
10654 setPathToolpaths(canvas_, moves);
10655 }
10656 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("NCC: %1 herramientas").arg(lastNccMulti_.size()), 4000);
10657 });

10659 if (lastNccMulti_.empty()) {
10660 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("NCC"),
10661 tr("Genere primero la geometría NCC."));
10662 return;
10663 }
10664 const std::string code = pathsGCodeMulti(lastNccMulti_, lastNccHeader_);
10665 addCncJobObject(camName(tr("NCC"), nccSource_), QString::fromStdString(code),
10666 cncProps(lastNccHeader_, tr("NCC")));
10667 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("CNCJob NCC generado"), 4000);
10668 });

10997 auto buildDrill = [this, drillCommon, drillOffsetX, drillOffsetY, drillOrder, optionsFor,
10998 readTable]() -> bool {
10999 fc::ExcellonResult* src = sourceExcellon(drillSource_);
11000 if (!src) {
11001 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Taladrado"), tr("Cargá un Excellon primero."));
11002 return false;
11003 }
11004 const auto rows = readTable(drillTable_);
11005 fc::DrillJob job;
11006 std::vector<int> numbers;
11007 for (const auto& [number, tool] : src->tools) {
11008 if (tool.drills.empty() && tool.slotSegments.empty()) continue;
11009 numbers.push_back(number);
11010 }
11011 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < numbers.size() && i < rows.size(); ++i) {
11012 const int number = numbers[i];
11013 const auto& source = src->tools.at(number);
11014 fc::DrillTool tool;
11015 tool.number = number;
11016 tool.diameter = source.diameter;
11017 tool.holes = source.drills;
11018 tool.slotSegments = source.slotSegments;
11019 tool.zCut = rows[i].zcut;
11020 tool.feedZ = rows[i].fz;
11021 tool.feedXY = rows[i].fxy;
11022 tool.spindleSpeed = rows[i].rpm;
11023 tool.dwell = drillCommon.dwell->value();
11024 tool.offsetX = drillOffsetX->value();
11025 tool.offsetY = drillOffsetY->value();
11026 job.tools.push_back(std::move(tool));
11027 }
11028 if (job.tools.empty()) return false;
11029 lastDrillJob_ = job;
11030 lastDrillHeader_ = optionsFor(rows.front(), drillCommon);
11031 addHeaderComments(lastDrillHeader_, {
11032 tr("Operation: Drilling"),
11033 tr("X offset: %1 mm").arg(drillOffsetX->value()),
11034 tr("Y offset: %1 mm").arg(drillOffsetY->value()),
11035 tr("Optimize order: %1").arg(drillOrder->isChecked() ? tr("yes") : tr("no")),
11036 });
11037 lastDrillGCode_ = lastDrillHeader_;
11038 if (drillOrder->isChecked()) optimizeDrillOrder(*lastDrillJob_);
11039 return true;
11040 };
11041
11042 connect(drillGeometry, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this, buildDrill, camName] {
11043 if (!buildDrill()) return;
11044 std::vector<Geom> preview;
11045 for (const fc::DrillTool& tool : lastDrillJob_->tools) {
11046 const double radius = std::max(0.05, tool.diameter / 2.0);
11047 for (const Pt& hole : tool.holes) {
11048 const Geom circle = Geom::circle(hole, radius, std::max(12, stepsPerCircle_));
11049 const Ring ring = circle.coords();
11050 if (ring.size() >= 2) preview.push_back(Geom::line(ring));
11051 }
11052 for (const auto& [start, stop] : tool.slotSegments)
11053 preview.push_back(Geom::line({start, stop}));
11054 }
11055 const int sourceId = drillSource_ ? drillSource_->currentData().toInt() : 0;
11056 addGeneratedLayer(camName(tr("Taladrado"), drillSource_), preview, sourceId);
11057 setDrillToolpaths(canvas_, *lastDrillJob_);
11058 statusBar()->showMessage(
11059 tr("Taladrado: %1 herramientas · trazado generado").arg(lastDrillJob_->tools.size()),
11060 4000);
11061 });
11062 connect(drillPreview, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this, buildDrill, camName] {
11063 if (!buildDrill()) return;
11064 const std::string code = drillingGCode(*lastDrillJob_, lastDrillHeader_);
11065 addCncJobObject(camName(tr("Taladrado"), drillSource_), QString::fromStdString(code),
11066 cncProps(lastDrillHeader_, tr("Taladrado")));
11067 statusBar()->showMessage(
11068 tr("Taladrado: %1 herramientas · CNCJob generado").arg(lastDrillJob_->tools.size()),
11069 4000);
11070 });
11071 connect(drillExport, &QPushButton::clicked, this, &MainWindow::exportDrillGCode);
11072 toolTabs_[tr("Herramienta de perforación")] = wrapScroll(drillPage);

11286 [this, millDia, millFeed, millFeedZ, millZ, millZMove, millDepth, millSpindle] {
11287 fc::GerberResult* src = sourceGerber(millSource_);
11288 if (!src) return;
11289 std::vector<std::vector<Pt>> lines;
11290 for (const Geom& g : src->follows) {
11291 if (!g.valid() || g.empty()) continue;
11292 if (g.typeId() == GEOS_LINESTRING || g.typeId() == GEOS_LINEARRING) {
11293 Ring ring = g.coords();
11294 if (ring.size() >= 2) lines.emplace_back(ring.begin(), ring.end());
11295 } else {
11296 for (int i = 0; i < g.numGeometries(); ++i) {
11297 const Geom part = g.geometryN(i);
11298 if (part.typeId() == GEOS_LINESTRING || part.typeId() == GEOS_LINEARRING) {
11299 Ring ring = part.coords();
11300 if (ring.size() >= 2) lines.emplace_back(ring.begin(), ring.end());
11301 }
11302 }
11303 }
11304 }
11305 lastMillJob_ = PathJob{};

11328 });

11365 thiefRef->addItem(row->text(1), row->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt());
11366 auto* thiefPpm = new QSpinBox(this);

11374 auto* thiefPattern = new QComboBox(this);

11378 auto* thiefGenerate = new QPushButton(originalIcon("geometry"), tr("Generar capa de puntos"), this);
11379 thiefForm->addRow(thiefGenerate);
11380 connect(thiefGenerate, &QPushButton::clicked, this,
11381 [this, thiefDia, thiefSpacing, thiefClear, thiefMargin, thiefRef, thiefPpm,
11382 thiefPattern] {
11383 fc::GerberResult* src = sourceGerber(thiefSource_);
11384 if (!src) return;
11385 ThievingOptions opt;
11386 opt.dotDiameter = thiefDia->value();
11387 opt.spacing = thiefSpacing->value();
11388 if (thiefPpm->value() > 0)
11389 opt.spacing = std::sqrt(1000000.0 / thiefPpm->value());
11390 opt.clearance = thiefClear->value();
11391 opt.margin = thiefMargin->value();
11392 BBox area = src->bounds;
11393 const int refId = thiefRef->currentData().toInt();
11394 if (refId > 0) {
11395 const BBox rb = canvas_->layerBounds(refId);
11396 if (rb.valid) area = rb;
11397 }
11398 const std::vector<Pt> dots = thievingPoints(src->solid, area, opt);
11399 std::vector<Geom> cells;
11400 for (const Pt& p : dots) {
11401 if (thiefPattern->currentIndex() == 1) {
11402 const double h = opt.dotDiameter / 2.0;
11403 cells.push_back(Geom::box(p.x - h, p.y - h, p.x + h, p.y + h));
11404 } else if (thiefPattern->currentIndex() == 2) {
11405 const double h = opt.dotDiameter / 2.0;
11406 cells.push_back(Geom::line({{p.x - h, p.y}, {p.x + h, p.y}})
11407 .buffer(opt.dotDiameter / 2.0, 8));
11408 } else {
11409 cells.push_back(Geom::circle(p, opt.dotDiameter / 2.0, 16));
11410 }
11411 }
11412 const int newId = canvas_->appendGeometry(cells, {}, true);
11413 canvas_->endGeometry();
11414 addObjectRow(tr("Copper Thieving"), "gerber", "-", newId, true, toolsGroup_);
11415 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Thieving: %1 puntos").arg(dots.size()), 4000);
11416 });

11488 for (int row = 0; row < nozzleTable->rowCount(); ++row) {
11489 auto* dia = nozzleTable->item(row, 0);
11490 auto* dwell = nozzleTable->item(row, 1);
11491 if (!dia) continue;
11492 nozzleDias.push_back(parseNumberText(dia->text()));
11493 nozzleDwells.push_back(dwell ? parseNumberText(dwell->text())
11494 : pasteDwell->value());
11495 }
11496 if (nozzleDias.empty()) {
11497 nozzleDias.push_back(pasteNozzle->value());
11498 nozzleDwells.push_back(pasteDwell->value());
11499 }
11500 job.nozzleDiameters = nozzleDias;
11501 std::set<std::pair<long long, long long>> seen;
11502 for (const Geom& g : src->solids) {
11503 if (!g.valid() || g.empty()) continue;
11504 const BBox b = g.bounds();
11505 if (!b.valid) continue;
11506 const Pt c{(b.xmin + b.xmax) * 0.5, (b.ymin + b.ymax) * 0.5};
11507 const double padSize = std::max(b.width(), b.height());
11508 const auto key = std::make_pair(std::llround(c.x * 100.0),
11509 std::llround(c.y * 100.0));
11510 if (!seen.insert(key).second) continue;
11511 int nozzle = 0;
11512 for (std::size_t n = 0; n < nozzleDias.size(); ++n) {
11513 if (nozzleDias[n] >= padSize) { nozzle = static_cast<int>(n); break; }
11514 nozzle = static_cast<int>(n);
11515 }
11516 job.points.push_back(c);
11517 job.padSizes.push_back(padSize);
11518 job.nozzles.push_back(nozzle);
11519 job.nozzleDwells.push_back(nozzleDwells[static_cast<std::size_t>(nozzle)]);
11520 }
11521 if (job.points.empty()) {
11522 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("El Gerber no tiene pads"), 4000);
11523 return;
11524 }
11525 BBox b;
11526 for (const Pt& p : job.points) {
11527 if (!b.valid) b = BBox{p.x, p.y, p.x, p.y};
11528 else {
11529 b.xmin = std::min(b.xmin, p.x);
11530 b.ymin = std::min(b.ymin, p.y);
11531 b.xmax = std::max(b.xmax, p.x);
11532 b.ymax = std::max(b.ymax, p.y);
11533 }
11534 }
11535 job.bounds = b;
11536 lastPasteJob_ = job;
11537 lastPasteOptions_ = GCodeOptions{};
11538 lastPasteOptions_.units = defaultUnits_;
11539 lastPasteOptions_.zMove = pasteTravel->value();
11540 lastPasteOptions_.zStart = pasteTravel->value();
11541 lastPasteOptions_.zCut = pasteDispense->value();
11542 lastPasteOptions_.zEnd = pasteRetract->value();
11543 lastPasteOptions_.feedZ = pasteFeedZ->value();
11544 lastPasteOptions_.toolDiameter = job.nozzleDiameter;
11545 lastPasteOptions_.dwellTime = pasteDwell->value();
11546 addHeaderComments(lastPasteOptions_, {
11547 tr("Operation: Solder Paste"),
11548 tr("Nozzle diameter: %1 mm").arg(pasteNozzle->value()),
11549 tr("Dispense Z: %1 mm").arg(pasteDispense->value()),
11550 tr("Retract Z: %1 mm").arg(pasteRetract->value()),
11551 tr("Dwell: %1 s").arg(pasteDwell->value()),
11552 });
11553 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Pasta: %1 puntos").arg(job.points.size()), 4000);
11554 });
11555 connect(pasteExport, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this] {
11556 if (!lastPasteJob_) return;
11557 const QString path = QFileDialog::getSaveFileName(
11558 this, tr("Exportar G-code de pasta"),
11559 QFileInfo(lastDir_).absolutePath() + "/solderpaste.nc", tr("G-code (*.nc *.gcode)"));
11560 if (path.isEmpty()) return;
11561 std::ofstream out(path.toStdString());
11562 const std::string pasteCode = pasteGCode(*lastPasteJob_, lastPasteOptions_);
11563 out << pasteCode;
11564 addCncJobObject(QFileInfo(path).fileName(), QString::fromStdString(pasteCode),
11565 cncProps(lastPasteOptions_, tr("Solder Paste")));
11566 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("G-code de pasta guardado"), 5000);
11567 });
11568 toolTabs_[tr("Solder Paste")] = wrapScroll(pastePage);
11569
11570 // --- QR Code
11571 auto* qrPage = new QWidget(this);
11572 auto* qrForm = new QFormLayout(qrPage);
11573 pageTitle(qrForm, tr("QR Code"), tr("Genera un código QR como cobre Gerber."));
11574 section(qrForm, tr("Contenido"));
11575 auto* qrText = new QPlainTextEdit(this);
11576 qrText->setPlainText("https://flatcam.org");
11577 qrText->setMaximumHeight(90);

11579 section(qrForm, tr("Parámetros"));
11580 auto* qrModule = makeSpin(0.05, 10.0, 1.0, 3, " mm",
11581 tr("<b>Tamaño de módulo</b><br>Lado de cada cuadro del QR."));
11582 auto* qrBorder = new QSpinBox(this);
11583 qrBorder->setRange(0, 20);
11584 qrBorder->setValue(4);
11585 qrBorder->setToolTip(tr("Cantidad de módulos de margen alrededor del código."));
11586 auto* qrEcc = new QComboBox(this);

11591 qrEcc->setCurrentIndex(1);
11592 auto* qrX = makeSpin(-10000.0, 10000.0, 0.0, 3, " mm", tr("<b>X</b><br>Origen del QR."));
11593 auto* qrY = makeSpin(-10000.0, 10000.0, 0.0, 3, " mm", tr("<b>Y</b><br>Origen del QR."));

11599 auto* qrGenerate = new QPushButton(originalIcon("qrcode"), tr("Generar QR"), this);

11601 qrForm->addRow(qrGenerate);

11645/// @brief Aplica NCC (hatch o paint) al objeto activo.
11646bool MainWindow::applyNcc(double toolDiameter, double stepOverPercent, double clearance,
11647 double angle, double margin, bool paintStrategy,
11648 const fc::GCodeOptions& gcode, double border, bool climb,
11649 double compensation) {
11650 if (!lastGerber_) return false;
11651 NccOptions opt;
11652 opt.toolDiameter = toolDiameter;
11653 opt.stepOver = stepOverPercent / 100.0;
11654 opt.clearance = clearance;
11655 opt.angleDeg = angle;
11656 opt.margin = margin;
11657 opt.border = border;
11658 opt.climb = climb;
11659 opt.compensation = compensation;
11660 opt.strategy = paintStrategy ? NccStrategy::Paint : NccStrategy::Hatch;
11661
11662 const BBox b = lastGerber_->bounds.expanded(margin);
11663 const Geom area = b.valid ? Geom::box(b.xmin, b.ymin, b.xmax, b.ymax) : Geom();
11664 lastNcc_ = clearCopper(lastGerber_->solid, area, opt);
11665 lastNccGCode_ = gcode;
11666 lastNccGCode_.toolDiameter = toolDiameter;
11667 lastNccHeader_ = gcode;
11668 lastNccHeader_.toolDiameter = toolDiameter;
11669 lastNccMulti_.clear();
11670 {
11671 fc::PathToolJob job;
11672 job.number = 1;
11673 job.diameter = toolDiameter;
11674 job.options = gcode;
11675 job.bounds = lastNcc_->bounds;
11676 for (const Geom& g : lastNcc_->paths) {
11677 Ring ring = g.coords();
11678 if (ring.size() >= 2) job.paths.emplace_back(ring.begin(), ring.end());
11679 }
11680 lastNccMulti_.push_back(std::move(job));
11681 }
11682 int sourceId = 0;
11683 if (auto* cur = objects_->currentItem()) sourceId = cur->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
11684 addGeneratedLayer(toolLayerName(tr("NCC")), lastNcc_->paths, sourceId);
11685 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("NCC: %1 recorridos").arg(lastNcc_->paths.size()), 4000);
11686 return true;
11687}

11827/// @brief Actualiza los selectores de objeto de cada herramienta.
11828void MainWindow::refreshSourceCombos() {
11829 auto fill = [this](QComboBox* combo, const QString& kind) {
11830 if (!combo) return;
11831 const int keep = combo->currentData().toInt();
11832 combo->blockSignals(true);
11833 combo->clear();
11834 for (QTreeWidgetItem* item : objectItems()) {
11835 if (item->text(2).compare(kind, Qt::CaseInsensitive) != 0) continue;
11836 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
11837 if (id <= 0) continue;
11838 combo->addItem(item->text(1), id);
11839 }
11840 const int index = combo->findData(keep);
11841 if (index >= 0) combo->setCurrentIndex(index);
11842 combo->blockSignals(false);
11843 };
11844 fill(isoSource_, "gerber");
11845 fill(nccSource_, "gerber");
11846 fill(cutSource_, "gerber");
11847 fill(paintSource_, "gerber");
11848 fill(drillSource_, "excellon");
11849 fill(millSource_, "gerber");
11850 fill(thiefSource_, "gerber");
11851 fill(pasteSource_, "gerber");
11852 if (dblSource_) {
11853 const int keep = dblSource_->currentData().toInt();
11854 const int filter = dblKind_ ? dblKind_->currentIndex() : 0;
11855 dblSource_->blockSignals(true);
11856 dblSource_->clear();
11857 for (QTreeWidgetItem* item : objectItems()) {
11858 const int id = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
11859 if (id <= 0) continue;
11860 const QString kind = item->text(2).toLower();
11861 const bool match = filter == 2 ? kind == "excellon"
11862 : filter == 1 ? (kind == "herramienta" || kind == "geometry")
11863 : kind == "gerber";
11864 if (match) dblSource_->addItem(item->text(1), id);
11865 }
11866 const int index = dblSource_->findData(keep);
11867 if (index >= 0) dblSource_->setCurrentIndex(index);
11868 dblSource_->blockSignals(false);
11869 }
11870}

11872/// @brief Llena la tabla de taladrado desde el Excellon.
11873void MainWindow::refreshDrillTable() {
11874 if (!drillTable_) return;
11875 drillTable_->setRowCount(0);
11876 if (!lastExcellon_) return;
11877 for (const auto& [number, tool] : lastExcellon_->tools) {
11878 if (tool.drills.empty() && tool.slotSegments.empty()) continue;
11879 const int row = drillTable_->rowCount();
11880 drillTable_->insertRow(row);
11881 auto set = [&](int col, const QString& text, bool editable = true) {
11882 auto* item = new QTableWidgetItem(text);
11883 if (!editable) item->setFlags(item->flags() & ~Qt::ItemIsEditable);
11884 drillTable_->setItem(row, col, item);
11885 };
11886 set(0, QString::number(number), false);
11887 set(1, lengthText(tool.diameter, 3), false);
11888 set(2, "100.0");
11889 set(3, "20.0");
11890 set(4, "10000");
11891 set(5, "0.0");
11892 set(6, lengthText(-2.4, 3));
11893 set(7, lengthText(0.0, 3));
11894 }
11895}

11925/// @brief Agrega un Gerber al canvas y al árbol.
11926void MainWindow::showGerber(const QString& path) {

11929 const fc::GerberResult r = fc::GerberParser(opt).parseFile(path.toStdString());
11930 lastExcellon_.reset();
11931 lastGerber_ = r;
11932 lastIsolation_.reset();
11933 lastCutout_.reset();
11934 lastNcc_.reset();

11936 resetObjectGroups();
11937 canvas_->setGeometryData(r.solids, r.follows);

11939 QString::number(r.solid.area(), 'f', 2),
11940 canvas_->layerIds().front());

11942
11943 std::ostringstream os;
11944 os << "GERBER\n";
11945 os << "archivo : " << QFileInfo(path).fileName().toStdString() << "\n";
11946 os << "unidades : " << fc::toString(r.fileUnits) << " (visualización "

11955 << ", " << r.bounds.ymax << "\n";

11960 switch (ap.kind) {
11961 case fc::GerberAperture::Kind::Circle:
11962 os << "círculo Ø" << ap.size;

11964 case fc::GerberAperture::Kind::Rectangle:
11965 os << "rectángulo " << ap.width << " x " << ap.height;

11967 case fc::GerberAperture::Kind::Obround:

11969 break;
11970 case fc::GerberAperture::Kind::Polygon:
11971 os << "polígono Ø" << ap.diameter << " (" << ap.vertices << " lados)";
11972 break;
11973 case fc::GerberAperture::Kind::Macro:
11974 os << "macro " << ap.macroName;
11975 break;
11976 default:
11977 os << "región";
11978 break;
11979 }
11980 os << "\n";
11981 }
11982 os << "colores : cobre (ámbar), recorridos (azul), rejilla (gris)\n";
11983 os << "advertencias: " << r.warnings.size() << "\n";
11984 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < r.warnings.size() && i < 15; ++i) os << " - " << r.warnings[i] << "\n";
11985 setInfo(QString::fromStdString(os.str()));
11986
11987 statusLabel_->setText(tr("%1 · %2 · %3 objetos")
11988 .arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName())
11989 .arg(fc::toString(r.fileUnits).c_str())
11990 .arg(r.apertures.size() + r.flashes));
11991 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Gerber cargado"), 3000);

11994/// @brief Agrega un Excellon al canvas y al árbol.
11995void MainWindow::showExcellon(const QString& path) {
11996 fc::ExcellonOptions opt;
11997 opt.appUnits = fc::Units::Mm;
11998 const fc::ExcellonResult r = fc::ExcellonParser(opt).parseFile(path.toStdString());
11999 lastExcellon_ = r;
12000 lastGerber_.reset();
12001 lastIsolation_.reset();
12002 lastCutout_.reset();
12003 lastNcc_.reset();
12004 lastPaint_.reset();
12005 resetObjectGroups();
12006 canvas_->setGeometryData(r.geometry, {});
12007 auto* item = addObjectRow(QFileInfo(path).fileName(), "excellon",
12008 QString::number(r.solid.area(), 'f', 2),
12009 canvas_->layerIds().front());
12010 canvas_->setToolpaths({});
12011
12012 std::ostringstream os;
12013 os << "EXCELLON\n";
12014 os << "archivo : " << QFileInfo(path).fileName().toStdString() << "\n";
12015 os << "unidades : " << fc::toString(r.fileUnits) << " (visualización "
12016 << fc::toString(opt.appUnits) << ")\n";
12017 os << "herramientas: " << r.tools.size() << "\n";
12018 os << "perforaciones: " << r.drillCount << "\n";
12019 os << "ranuras : " << r.slotCount << "\n";
12020 os << "área : " << r.solid.area() << "\n";
12021 if (r.bounds.valid) {
12022 os << "límites : " << r.bounds.xmin << ", " << r.bounds.ymin << " .. " << r.bounds.xmax
12023 << ", " << r.bounds.ymax << "\n";
12024 }
12025 for (const auto& [num, tool] : r.tools) {
12026 os << " T" << num << " Ø" << tool.diameter << " (" << tool.drills.size() << " taladros, "
12027 << tool.slotSegments.size() << " ranuras)\n";
12028 }
12029 for (const std::string& w : r.warnings) os << " aviso: " << w << "\n";
12030 setInfo(QString::fromStdString(os.str()));
12031
12032 statusLabel_->setText(tr("%1 · %2 · %3 taladros")
12033 .arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName())
12034 .arg(fc::toString(r.fileUnits).c_str())
12035 .arg(r.drillCount));
12036 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Excellon cargado"), 3000);
12037}

12080 overlap->setValue(0.0);

12103/**
12104 * @brief Ejecuta el aislamiento sobre el Gerber activo.
12105 * @param toolDiameter Diámetro de fresa.
12106 * @param passes Pasadas.
12107 * @param overlapPercent Solape en porcentaje.
12108 * @param invert Invierte el sentido.
12109 * @param gcode Parámetros de G-code opcionales.
12110 * @return `true` si se generaron recorridos.
12111 */
12112bool MainWindow::applyIsolation(double toolDiameter, int passes, double overlapPercent, bool invert,
12113 const fc::GCodeOptions& gcode) {
12114 if (!lastGerber_) return false;
12115
12116 fc::IsolationOptions opt;
12117 opt.toolDiameter = toolDiameter;
12118 opt.passes = passes;
12119 opt.overlap = overlapPercent / 100.0;
12120 opt.invert = invert;
12121
12122 lastIsoToolDiameter_ = opt.toolDiameter;
12123 lastIsolation_ = fc::isolateCopper(lastGerber_->solid, opt);
12124 lastCutout_.reset();
12125 lastIsoHeader_ = gcode;
12126 lastIsoHeader_.toolDiameter = toolDiameter;
12127 lastIsoMulti_.clear();
12128 {
12129 fc::PathToolJob job;
12130 job.number = 1;
12131 job.diameter = opt.toolDiameter;
12132 job.options = gcode;
12133 job.bounds = lastIsolation_->bounds;
12134 for (const Geom& g : lastIsolation_->paths) {
12135 Ring ring = g.coords();
12136 if (ring.size() >= 2) job.paths.emplace_back(ring.begin(), ring.end());
12137 }
12138 lastIsoMulti_.push_back(std::move(job));
12139 }
12140 int sourceId = 0;
12141 if (auto* cur = objects_->currentItem()) sourceId = cur->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
12142 addGeneratedLayer(toolLayerName(tr("Aislamiento")), lastIsolation_->paths, sourceId);
12143
12144 std::ostringstream os;
12145 os << "\n--- AISLAMIENTO ---\n";
12146 os << "herramienta : Ø" << opt.toolDiameter << " mm\n";
12147 os << "pasadas : " << opt.passes << "\n";
12148 os << "solape : " << overlapPercent << " %\n";
12149 os << "recorridos : " << lastIsolation_->paths.size() << "\n";
12150 os << "longitud : " << lastIsolation_->totalLength << " mm\n";
12151 info_->setPlainText(info_->toPlainText() + QString::fromStdString(os.str()));
12152
12153 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Aislamiento generado: %1 recorridos")
12154 .arg(lastIsolation_->paths.size()),
12155 5000);
12156 return true;
12157}

12221/// Aplica corte de contorno con margen y lado externo/interno.
12222bool MainWindow::applyCutout(double toolDiameter, double margin, bool external,
12223 const fc::GCodeOptions& gcode, int tabCount, double tabWidth,
12224 fc::TabSides tabSides,
12225 const std::vector<double>& tabPositions) {
12226 if (!lastGerber_) return false;
12227
12228 fc::CutoutOptions opt;
12229 opt.toolDiameter = toolDiameter;
12230 opt.margin = margin;
12231 opt.external = external;
12232 opt.tabCount = tabCount;
12233 opt.tabWidth = tabWidth;
12234 opt.tabSides = tabSides;
12235 opt.tabPositions = tabPositions;
12236
12237 lastCutoutOptions_ = opt;
12238 lastCutoutGCode_ = gcode;
12239
12240 lastCutout_ = fc::cutoutGeometry(lastGerber_->solid, opt);
12241 lastCutHeader_ = gcode;
12242 lastCutHeader_.toolDiameter = toolDiameter;
12243 lastCutMulti_.clear();
12244 {
12245 fc::PathToolJob job;
12246 job.number = 1;
12247 job.diameter = opt.toolDiameter;
12248 job.options = gcode;
12249 job.bounds = lastCutout_->bounds;
12250 for (const Geom& g : lastCutout_->paths) {
12251 Ring ring = g.coords();
12252 if (ring.size() >= 2) job.paths.emplace_back(ring.begin(), ring.end());
12253 }
12254 lastCutMulti_.push_back(std::move(job));
12255 }
12256 int sourceId = 0;
12257 if (auto* cur = objects_->currentItem()) sourceId = cur->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
12258 addGeneratedLayer(toolLayerName(tr("Corte")), lastCutout_->paths, sourceId);
12259
12260 std::ostringstream os;
12261 os << "\n--- CORTE DE CONTORNO ---\n";
12262 os << "herramienta : Ø" << toolDiameter << " mm\n";
12263 os << "margen : " << margin << " mm\n";
12264 os << "tipo : " << (external ? "externo" : "interno") << "\n";
12265 os << "corte Z : " << gcode.zCut << " mm (por pasada " << gcode.depthPerPass << " mm)\n";
12266 os << "recorridos : " << lastCutout_->paths.size() << "\n";
12267 os << "longitud : " << lastCutout_->totalLength << " mm\n";
12268 info_->setPlainText(info_->toPlainText() + QString::fromStdString(os.str()));
12269
12270 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("Corte generado: %1 recorridos").arg(lastCutout_->paths.size()),
12271 5000);
12272 return true;
12273}

12275/// @brief Exporta el último corte a G-code.
12276void MainWindow::exportCutoutGCode() {
12277 if (lastCutMulti_.empty()) {
12278 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Exportar G-code de corte"),
12279 tr("Genere primero un corte desde Herramientas → Cortar contorno."));
12280 return;
12281 }
12282
12283 const QString path = QFileDialog::getSaveFileName(
12284 this, tr("Guardar G-code de corte"),
12285 QFileInfo(lastDir_).absolutePath() + "/cutout.nc",
12286 tr("G-code (*.nc *.gcode *.tap);;Todos (*)"));
12287 if (path.isEmpty()) return;
12288
12289 fc::PathJob job;
12290 job.toolDiameter = lastCutoutOptions_.toolDiameter;
12291 job.bounds = lastCutout_->bounds;
12292 for (const fc::Geom& geom : lastCutout_->paths) {
12293 fc::Ring ring = geom.coords();
12294 if (ring.size() < 2) continue;
12295 job.paths.emplace_back(ring.begin(), ring.end());
12296 }
12297
12298 const fc::GCodeOptions opt = cutOptions_ ? cutOptions_() : lastCutoutGCode_;
12299 const std::string code = fc::pathsGCode(job, opt);
12300 std::ofstream out(path.toStdString(), std::ios::binary);
12301 if (!out) {
12302 showError(tr("No se pudo escribir el archivo"));
12303 return;
12304 }
12305 out << code;
12306 addCncJobObject(QFileInfo(path).fileName(), QString::fromStdString(code),
12307 cncProps(opt, tr("Corte")));
12308 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("G-code de corte guardado: %1").arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName()),
12309 5000);
12310}

12312/// @brief Abre la herramienta NCC.
12313void MainWindow::nccDialog() {
12314 if (!lastGerber_) {
12315 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("NCC"),
12316 tr("Abra primero una capa Gerber para despejar el cobre."));
12317 return;
12318 }
12319
12320 QDialog dialog(this);
12321 dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("Despejar cobre (NCC)"));
12322 auto* form = new QFormLayout(&dialog);
12323
12324 auto* diameter = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
12325 diameter->setRange(0.01, 20.0);
12326 diameter->setDecimals(3);
12327 diameter->setValue(0.5);
12328 diameter->setSuffix(" mm");
12329 applyTip(diameter, tr("Diámetro de la herramienta de despeje."));
12330 form->addRow(tr("Diámetro de herramienta:"), diameter);
12331
12332 auto* step = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
12333 step->setRange(5.0, 95.0);
12334 step->setDecimals(1);
12335 step->setValue(80.0);
12336 step->setSuffix(" %");
12337 applyTip(step, tr("Superposición entre pasadas. El paso real es diámetro × (100 − "
12338 "superposición) %. Si en FlatCAM usabas 80 %, dejá 80 acá."));
12339 form->addRow(tr("Superposición:"), step);
12340
12341 auto* clearance = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
12342 clearance->setRange(0.0, 10.0);
12343 clearance->setDecimals(3);
12344 clearance->setValue(0.1);
12345 clearance->setSuffix(" mm");
12346 applyTip(clearance, tr("Margen de seguridad respecto al cobre a conservar."));
12347 form->addRow(tr("Distancia al cobre:"), clearance);
12348
12349 auto* angle = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
12350 angle->setRange(-90.0, 90.0);
12351 angle->setDecimals(1);
12352 angle->setValue(0.0);
12353 angle->setSuffix(" °");
12354 applyTip(angle, tr("Dirección del hatch; 45° suele dar mejor acabado."));
12355 form->addRow(tr("Ángulo del hatch:"), angle);
12356
12357 auto* margin = new UnitSpinBox(&dialog);
12358 margin->setRange(0.0, 50.0);
12359 margin->setDecimals(2);
12360 margin->setValue(1.0);
12361 margin->setSuffix(" mm");
12362 applyTip(margin,
12363 tr("<b>Margen del área</b><br>"
12364 "Expande el área a despejar más allá del rectángulo que contiene el cobre.<br><br>"
12365 "• 0 mm: se despeja sólo dentro de los límites del cobre.<br>"
12366 "• 1 mm: agrega 1 mm alrededor (útil para limpiar hasta el borde de "
12367 "la placa o dejar lugar al corte).<br>"
12368 "• Ejemplo: cobre de −35 a +35 mm con margen 1 → NCC de −36 a +36 mm.<br><br>"
12369 "No cambia la distancia de seguridad al cobre; para eso está "
12370 "«Distancia al cobre»."));
12371 form->addRow(tr("Margen del área:"), margin);
12372
12373 auto* strategy = new QComboBox(&dialog);
12374 strategy->addItems({tr("Hatch (líneas)"), tr("Paint (contornos)")});
12375 applyTip(strategy, tr("Hatch: líneas paralelas. Paint: contornos concéntricos."));
12376 form->addRow(tr("Estrategia:"), strategy);
12377
12378 auto* buttons = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::Ok | QDialogButtonBox::Cancel, &dialog);
12379 form->addRow(buttons);
12380 connect(buttons, &QDialogButtonBox::accepted, &dialog, &QDialog::accept);
12381 connect(buttons, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, &dialog, &QDialog::reject);
12382 if (dialog.exec() != QDialog::Accepted) return;
12383
12384 fc::NccOptions opt;
12385 opt.toolDiameter = diameter->value();
12386 opt.stepOver = (100.0 - step->value()) / 100.0;
12387 opt.clearance = clearance->value();
12388 opt.angleDeg = angle->value();
12389 opt.margin = margin->value();
12390 opt.strategy = strategy->currentIndex() == 1 ? fc::NccStrategy::Paint : fc::NccStrategy::Hatch;
12391
12392 const fc::BBox b = lastGerber_->bounds.expanded(margin->value());
12393 const fc::Geom area = b.valid ? fc::Geom::box(b.xmin, b.ymin, b.xmax, b.ymax) : fc::Geom();
12394
12395 lastNcc_ = fc::clearCopper(lastGerber_->solid, area, opt);
12396 lastNccGCode_ = fc::GCodeOptions{};
12397 lastNccGCode_.units = fc::Units::Mm;
12398 lastNccGCode_.toolDiameter = opt.toolDiameter;
12399 int sourceId = 0;
12400 if (auto* cur = objects_->currentItem()) sourceId = cur->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
12401 addGeneratedLayer(toolLayerName(tr("NCC")), lastNcc_->paths, sourceId);
12402
12403 std::ostringstream os;
12404 os << "\n--- NCC ---\n";
12405 os << "herramienta : Ø" << opt.toolDiameter << " mm\n";
12406 os << "estrategia : " << (opt.strategy == fc::NccStrategy::Paint ? "paint" : "hatch") << "\n";
12407 os << "paso : " << step->value() << " %\n";
12408 os << "recorridos : " << lastNcc_->paths.size() << "\n";
12409 os << "longitud : " << lastNcc_->totalLength << " mm\n";
12410 info_->setPlainText(info_->toPlainText() + QString::fromStdString(os.str()));
12411 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("NCC generado: %1 recorridos").arg(lastNcc_->paths.size()), 5000);
12412}

12513 tr("G-code (*.nc *.gcode);;Todos (*)"));
12514 if (path.isEmpty()) return;
12515
12516 const std::string code = fc::pathsGCodeMulti(lastPaintMulti_, lastPaintHeader_);
12517 std::ofstream out(path.toStdString(), std::ios::binary);
12518 if (!out) {
12519 showError(tr("No se pudo escribir el archivo"));
12520 return;
12521 }
12522 out << code;
12523 addCncJobObject(QFileInfo(path).fileName(), QString::fromStdString(code),
12524 cncProps(lastPaintHeader_, tr("Pintura")));
12525 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("G-code de pintado guardado: %1").arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName()), 5000);
12526}

12528/// @brief Exporta el último aislamiento a G-code.
12529void MainWindow::exportIsolationGCode() {
12530 if (lastIsoMulti_.empty()) {
12531 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Exportar G-code de aislamiento"),
12532 tr("Genere primero un aislamiento desde Herramientas → Aislar cobre."));
12533 return;
12534 }
12535
12536 const QString path = QFileDialog::getSaveFileName(
12537 this, tr("Guardar G-code de aislamiento"),
12538 QFileInfo(lastDir_).absolutePath() + "/isolation.nc",
12539 tr("G-code (*.nc *.gcode *.tap);;Todos (*)"));
12540 if (path.isEmpty()) return;
12541
12542 fc::PathJob job;
12543 job.toolDiameter = lastIsoToolDiameter_;
12544 if (lastGerber_) job.bounds = lastGerber_->bounds;
12545 for (const fc::Geom& geom : lastIsolation_->paths) {
12546 fc::Ring ring = geom.coords();
12547 if (ring.size() < 2) continue;
12548 job.paths.emplace_back(ring.begin(), ring.end());
12549 }
12550
12551 const fc::GCodeOptions opt = isoOptions_ ? isoOptions_() : fc::GCodeOptions{};
12552 const std::string code = fc::pathsGCode(job, opt);
12553 std::ofstream out(path.toStdString(), std::ios::binary);
12554 if (!out) {
12555 showError(tr("No se pudo escribir el archivo"));
12556 return;
12557 }
12558 out << code;
12559 addCncJobObject(QFileInfo(path).fileName(), QString::fromStdString(code),
12560 cncProps(lastIsoHeader_, tr("Aislamiento")));
12561 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("G-code de aislamiento guardado: %1")
12562 .arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName()),
12563 5000);
12564}
12565
12566/// @brief Exporta el CNCJob activo a G-code.
12567void MainWindow::exportGCode() {
12568 if (!lastExcellon_) {
12569 QMessageBox::information(this, tr("Exportar G-code"),
12570 tr("Abra primero un archivo Excellon (.drl/.xln) para exportar "
12571 "el taladrado.\n\nLa exportación de aislamiento y corte "
12572 "llegará con el hito M4."));
12573 return;
12574 }
12575
12576 const QString suggested = QFileInfo(lastDir_).absolutePath() + "/drill.nc";
12577 const QString path = QFileDialog::getSaveFileName(
12578 this, tr("Guardar G-code"), suggested,
12579 tr("G-code (*.nc *.gcode *.tap);;Todos (*)"));
12580 if (path.isEmpty()) return;
12581
12582 try {
12583 const fc::DrillJob job = fc::drillJobFromExcellon(*lastExcellon_);
12584 fc::GCodeOptions opt;
12585 opt.units = fc::Units::Mm;
12586 const std::string code = fc::drillingGCode(job, opt);
12587 std::ofstream out(path.toStdString(), std::ios::binary);
12588 if (!out) throw std::runtime_error("no se pudo escribir el archivo");
12589 out << code;
12590 statusBar()->showMessage(tr("G-code guardado: %1").arg(QFileInfo(path).fileName()), 5000);
12591 } catch (const std::exception& e) {
12592 showError(QString::fromUtf8(e.what()));
12593 }
12594}

12601/// @brief Abre los archivos arrastrados.
12602void MainWindow::dropEvent(QDropEvent* event) {
12603 const QList<QUrl> urls = event->mimeData()->urls();
12604 if (urls.isEmpty()) return;
12605 QStringList paths;
12606 for (const QUrl& url : urls) {
12607 if (url.isLocalFile()) paths << url.toLocalFile();
12608 }
12609 if (!paths.isEmpty()) openFiles(paths);
12610 event->acceptProposedAction();
12611}
